units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|name|16|0
units.english: Follow-up Observations
units.italian: Osservazioni successive

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|description|17|0
units.english: Plume would like you to use a "gaslined" ship to do a follow-up visit to the planets in Nenia.
units.italian: Plume vorrebbe che usassi una nave "con rivestimento per gas" per fare una visita successiva ai pianeti di Nenia.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|blocked|21|0
units.english: The Remnant researcher has another job for you, but you're going to have to free up <tons> cargo space in order to take it on.
units.italian: Il ricercatore dei Remnant ha un altro lavoro per te, ma dovrai liberare <tons> di spazio nel carico per accettarlo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|A familiar face is waiting for you as you step into the crowded spaceport on Aventine. "Captain <first>!" signs Plume. "I have been hoping you would stop by." He gestures for you to sit down on the bench next to him.|29|0
units.english: A familiar face is waiting for you as you step into the crowded spaceport on Aventine. "Captain <first>!" signs Plume. "I have been hoping you would stop by." He gestures for you to sit down on the bench next to him.
units.italian: Un volto familiare ti aspetta quando entri nello spazioporto affollato di Aventine. "Capitano <first>!" segna Plume. "Speravo che passassi di qui." Ti fa cenno di sederti sulla panca accanto a lui.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|	"Now that most of the cocoons have been returned, I would like you to return to Nasqueron and Slylandro to observe the void sprites' behavior. It is my hope that we can gain far greater insight into their life cycle."|30|0
units.english: "Now that most of the cocoons have been returned, I would like you to return to Nasqueron and Slylandro to observe the void sprites' behavior. It is my hope that we can gain far greater insight into their life cycle."
units.italian: "Ora che la maggior parte dei bozzoli è stata riportata, vorrei che tornassi su Nasqueron e Slylandro per osservare il comportamento degli spettri del vuoto. Spero che possiamo ottenere un quadro molto più chiaro del loro ciclo vitale."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|	"Sure, I could do that."|32|0
units.english: "Sure, I could do that."
units.italian: "Certo, potrei farlo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|	"Not right now, but I could later."|34|0
units.english: "Not right now, but I could later."
units.italian: "Non adesso, ma potrei più tardi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|	"How much will I get paid?"|36|0
units.english: "How much will I get paid?"
units.italian: "Quanto verrò pagato?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|	"Once the research is published, you will receive one million credits."|37|0
units.english: "Once the research is published, you will receive one million credits."
units.italian: "Una volta pubblicata la ricerca, riceverai un milione di crediti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|	"I accept."|39|0
units.english: "I accept."
units.italian: "Accetto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|	"Not right now, but I could later."|40|0
units.english: "Not right now, but I could later."
units.italian: "Non adesso, ma potrei più tardi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|	"Excellent. As before, please visit both Nasqueron and Slylandro, record the void sprites there, and return here."|43|0
units.english: "Excellent. As before, please visit both Nasqueron and Slylandro, record the void sprites there, and return here."
units.italian: "Eccellente. Come prima, visita sia Nasqueron sia Slylandro, registra gli spettri del vuoto che trovi e torna qui."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|As you scan the system, the first thing you notice is that the void sprites' behavior seems different: there are fewer of them flying around, and the few that you see seem to be almost timid - floating quietly, and dropping down into the cloud deck whenever your ship moves towards them. You recall that Plume asked you to visit both planets.|62|0
units.english: As you scan the system, the first thing you notice is that the void sprites' behavior seems different: there are fewer of them flying around, and the few that you see seem to be almost timid - floating quietly, and dropping down into the cloud deck whenever your ship moves towards them. You recall that Plume asked you to visit both planets.
units.italian: Mentre scansioni il sistema, la prima cosa che noti è che il comportamento degli spettri del vuoto sembra diverso: ce ne sono meno in volo, e quelli che vedi sembrano quasi timidi - fluttuano in silenzio e si tuffano nello strato di nuvole ogni volta che la nave si avvicina. Ricordi che Plume ti ha chiesto di visitare entrambi i pianeti.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|The void sprites here prove to be elusive. You spend quite a while chasing radar signatures before you finally manage to get a small flock of them into visual range. You record them from a distance for several minutes, until they suddenly disperse into a storm and vanish.|65|0
units.english: The void sprites here prove to be elusive. You spend quite a while chasing radar signatures before you finally manage to get a small flock of them into visual range. You record them from a distance for several minutes, until they suddenly disperse into a storm and vanish.
units.italian: Gli spettri del vuoto qui si rivelano sfuggenti. Passi parecchio tempo a inseguire tracce radar prima di riuscire finalmente a portare un piccolo stormo nel raggio visivo. Li riprendi da lontano per diversi minuti, finché all'improvviso si disperdono in una tempesta e svaniscono.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|dialog|67|0
units.english: You've returned to Aventine without the scans from both gas giants in Nenia. Make sure you have visited both and that the ship carrying the scanning equipment has returned here.
units.italian: Sei tornato su Aventine senza le scansioni di entrambi i giganti gassosi di Nenia. Assicurati di averli visitati entrambi e che la nave con l'apparecchiatura di scansione sia tornata qui.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|Disappointed in the void sprites' behavior, you deliver the recordings to Plume's lab without fanfare. Plume quickly takes and reviews the footage before making a gesture that you think means "curious dejection." Then he seems to notice something, and resumes his usual intent bearing.|70|0
units.english: Disappointed in the void sprites' behavior, you deliver the recordings to Plume's lab without fanfare. Plume quickly takes and reviews the footage before making a gesture that you think means "curious dejection." Then he seems to notice something, and resumes his usual intent bearing.
units.italian: Deluso dal comportamento degli spettri del vuoto, consegni le registrazioni al laboratorio di Plume senza clamore. Plume prende e rivede in fretta il filmato, poi fa un gesto che interpreti come "delusione incuriosita". Poi sembra notare qualcosa e riprende il suo solito contegno concentrato.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 1|	"Here, look!" He rewinds the recording and gestures curtly at the projection in front of you. "There. That one is injured. Some kind of burn in a long, straight line." He zips through the footage further. "And here, a scattering of scorch marks." He looks up at you and snaps out a series of gestures: "This is outside my expertise; I will need to consult an expert. Meet me in the spaceport in an hour."|71|0
units.english: "Here, look!" He rewinds the recording and gestures curtly at the projection in front of you. "There. That one is injured. Some kind of burn in a long, straight line." He zips through the footage further. "And here, a scattering of scorch marks." He looks up at you and snaps out a series of gestures: "This is outside my expertise; I will need to consult an expert. Meet me in the spaceport in an hour."
units.italian: "Qui, guarda!" Riavvolge la registrazione e indica con un gesto secco la proiezione davanti a te. "Lì. Quello è ferito. Una specie di ustione, in una linea lunga e dritta." Scorre ancora veloce il filmato. "E qui, una serie di segni di bruciatura." Alza lo sguardo su di te e snocciola una serie di gesti: "Questo esula dalle mie competenze; dovrò consultare un esperto. Incontrami allo spazioporto tra un'ora."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|name|76|0
units.english: Eliminate Korath Ship
units.italian: Elimina la nave Korath

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|description|77|0
units.english: Plume ordered you to eliminate the Korath ship in the <waypoints> system.
units.italian: Plume ti ha ordinato di eliminare la nave Korath nel sistema <waypoints>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|You arrive in the spaceport to find Plume pacing quickly along a walkway. He gestures a quick greeting and jumps straight to the point. "We have never seen marks like these naturally appear on void sprites, but they match the weapon scoring patterns we have seen delivered by Korath ships. As such, we believe the Korath have begun hunting void sprites."|84|0
units.english: You arrive in the spaceport to find Plume pacing quickly along a walkway. He gestures a quick greeting and jumps straight to the point. "We have never seen marks like these naturally appear on void sprites, but they match the weapon scoring patterns we have seen delivered by Korath ships. As such, we believe the Korath have begun hunting void sprites."
units.italian: Arrivi allo spazioporto e trovi Plume che va su e giù in fretta lungo una passerella. Ti saluta con un gesto rapido e va subito al punto. "Non abbiamo mai visto segni simili comparire naturalmente sugli spettri del vuoto, ma corrispondono ai segni lasciati dalle armi delle navi Korath. Perciò crediamo che i Korath abbiano cominciato a dare la caccia agli spettri del vuoto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	He looks at you with a surprising amount of vigor. "I will not have our work ruined by reptilian warmongers. Destroy the Korath hunters responsible, then we can continue the research."|85|0
units.english: He looks at you with a surprising amount of vigor. "I will not have our work ruined by reptilian warmongers. Destroy the Korath hunters responsible, then we can continue the research."
units.italian: Ti guarda con un vigore sorprendente. "Non permetterò che dei bellicosi rettiliani rovinino il nostro lavoro. Distruggi i cacciatori Korath responsabili, poi potremo proseguire la ricerca."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	"Okay, I will destroy the Korath hunters' ship."|87|0
units.english: "Okay, I will destroy the Korath hunters' ship."
units.italian: "D'accordo, distruggerò la nave dei cacciatori Korath."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	"Do you have the authority to order that?"|89|0
units.english: "Do you have the authority to order that?"
units.italian: "Hai l'autorità per ordinarlo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	He nods curtly. "I do not have the authority to raise a fleet or order a captain to destroy the ship, but I can declare this Korath a threat to Remnant interests. It is up to you to decide how to respond to the identification of that threat."|90|0
units.english: He nods curtly. "I do not have the authority to raise a fleet or order a captain to destroy the ship, but I can declare this Korath a threat to Remnant interests. It is up to you to decide how to respond to the identification of that threat."
units.italian: Annuisce secco. "Non ho l'autorità di radunare una flotta né di ordinare a un capitano di distruggere la nave, ma posso dichiarare che questo Korath è una minaccia agli interessi dei Remnant. Sta a te decidere come rispondere a questa segnalazione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	(Accept his explanation.)|92|0
units.english: (Accept his explanation.)
units.italian: (Accetta la sua spiegazione.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	"Could you explain?"|94|0
units.english: "Could you explain?"
units.italian: "Potresti spiegarmi?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	"While the Remnant have an all-encompassing hierarchy to ensure everyone answers to someone, we saw fit to keep all facets of our society merged to prevent fragmentation into 'civilian' or 'military' branches. Two aspects of this merging are the decision of when to invoke military force and what amount of force is worthwhile. According to my position as a researcher, I have the authority to designate something a threat to my projects or to the Remnant as a whole. I could even order someone to act on it. However, given that I am of low status in terms of military proficiency, I cannot dictate the magnitude of the military response, and I am subject to being overruled by those with higher military qualifications."|95|0
units.english: "While the Remnant have an all-encompassing hierarchy to ensure everyone answers to someone, we saw fit to keep all facets of our society merged to prevent fragmentation into 'civilian' or 'military' branches. Two aspects of this merging are the decision of when to invoke military force and what amount of force is worthwhile. According to my position as a researcher, I have the authority to designate something a threat to my projects or to the Remnant as a whole. I could even order someone to act on it. However, given that I am of low status in terms of military proficiency, I cannot dictate the magnitude of the military response, and I am subject to being overruled by those with higher military qualifications."
units.italian: "Sebbene i Remnant abbiano una gerarchia onnicomprensiva che garantisce che ognuno risponda a qualcuno, abbiamo ritenuto opportuno tenere unite tutte le sfaccettature della nostra società per evitare che si frammentasse in rami 'civili' e 'militari'. Due aspetti di questa unione sono la decisione su quando ricorrere alla forza militare e su quanta forza valga la pena impiegare. In base al mio ruolo di ricercatore, ho l'autorità di designare qualcosa come minaccia ai miei progetti o ai Remnant nel loro insieme. Potrei persino ordinare a qualcuno di agire. Tuttavia, dato che il mio status in fatto di competenza militare è basso, non posso stabilire l'entità della risposta militare, e posso essere scavalcato da chi ha qualifiche militari superiori."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	"In our particular situation, I have higher xenobiology qualifications than you, so I can dictate to you, and most other xenobiologists, for that matter, that protecting the void sprites is a priority. However, you are more skilled at combat and military matters than I am. Therefore it is your decision as to how important it is relative to other military tasks. Likewise, it is your decision as to what amount of force is required, tactics used, or other such military considerations."|96|0
units.english: "In our particular situation, I have higher xenobiology qualifications than you, so I can dictate to you, and most other xenobiologists, for that matter, that protecting the void sprites is a priority. However, you are more skilled at combat and military matters than I am. Therefore it is your decision as to how important it is relative to other military tasks. Likewise, it is your decision as to what amount of force is required, tactics used, or other such military considerations."
units.italian: "Nella nostra situazione particolare, io ho qualifiche in xenobiologia superiori alle tue, quindi posso dettare a te, e in realtà alla maggior parte degli altri xenobiologi, che proteggere gli spettri del vuoto è una priorità. Tuttavia tu sei più abile di me nel combattimento e nelle questioni militari. Perciò spetta a te decidere quanto questo sia importante rispetto ad altri compiti militari. Allo stesso modo spetta a te decidere quanta forza serva, quali tattiche usare e altre considerazioni militari del genere."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	"This is one of the aspects that set prefects apart: they are Remnant who have demonstrated excellence in their field, sound judgment across a variety of fields, and an affinity for balancing a multitude of demands on Remnant resources. Humility is also a requirement, as they must always recognize that while their particular combination of skills may be unique, there is always someone else who is better than them at any one thing. As such, prefects are the adjudicators in determining the priorities of our various tasks and the leaders who keep the Remnant unified."|97|0
units.english: "This is one of the aspects that set prefects apart: they are Remnant who have demonstrated excellence in their field, sound judgment across a variety of fields, and an affinity for balancing a multitude of demands on Remnant resources. Humility is also a requirement, as they must always recognize that while their particular combination of skills may be unique, there is always someone else who is better than them at any one thing. As such, prefects are the adjudicators in determining the priorities of our various tasks and the leaders who keep the Remnant unified."
units.italian: "Questo è uno degli aspetti che distinguono i prefetti: sono Remnant che hanno dimostrato eccellenza nel proprio campo, giudizio solido in campi diversi e una predisposizione a bilanciare le molteplici richieste sulle risorse dei Remnant. È richiesta anche l'umiltà, perché devono sempre riconoscere che, per quanto la loro particolare combinazione di competenze possa essere unica, c'è sempre qualcun altro più bravo di loro in una singola cosa. Perciò i prefetti sono gli arbitri che stabiliscono le priorità dei nostri vari compiti e i capi che tengono uniti i Remnant."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	"Thanks for the explanation!"|99|0
units.english: "Thanks for the explanation!"
units.italian: "Grazie della spiegazione!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	"I thought prefects were specialists."|101|0
units.english: "I thought prefects were specialists."
units.italian: "Pensavo che i prefetti fossero specialisti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	"Well, they are and are not. Most prefects are assigned particular tasks that they are expected to devote themselves to. Often, this task relates to their area of expertise, but it is not always the case. Generally speaking, a prefect is considered to be the ultimate authority on tasks that they have been assigned to, but they are expected to take into account the suggestions from other prefects and the specialists in the fields relevant to the task.|102|0
units.english: "Well, they are and are not. Most prefects are assigned particular tasks that they are expected to devote themselves to. Often, this task relates to their area of expertise, but it is not always the case. Generally speaking, a prefect is considered to be the ultimate authority on tasks that they have been assigned to, but they are expected to take into account the suggestions from other prefects and the specialists in the fields relevant to the task.
units.italian: "Beh, lo sono e non lo sono. Alla maggior parte dei prefetti vengono assegnati compiti specifici ai quali ci si aspetta che si dedichino. Spesso il compito riguarda il loro campo di competenza, ma non sempre è così. In generale, un prefetto è considerato l'autorità suprema sui compiti che gli sono stati assegnati, ma ci si aspetta che tenga conto dei suggerimenti degli altri prefetti e degli specialisti nei campi pertinenti al compito.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	"Given your own skills, I suspect that the prefects you are most likely to interact with would be Prefect Chilia, who coordinates the military defense of the Remnant, and Prefect Taely, who integrates our latest innovations into usable ships."|103|0
units.english: "Given your own skills, I suspect that the prefects you are most likely to interact with would be Prefect Chilia, who coordinates the military defense of the Remnant, and Prefect Taely, who integrates our latest innovations into usable ships."
units.italian: "Viste le tue capacità, suppongo che i prefetti con cui avrai più probabilmente a che fare siano il Prefetto Chilia, che coordina la difesa militare dei Remnant, e la Prefetto Taely, che integra le nostre ultime innovazioni in navi utilizzabili."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	"Thanks! That was more detail than I was expecting."|105|0
units.english: "Thanks! That was more detail than I was expecting."
units.italian: "Grazie! Era più dettagliato di quanto mi aspettassi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	"Okay, that satisfied my curiosity for now."|106|0
units.english: "Okay, that satisfied my curiosity for now."
units.italian: "Va bene, per ora la mia curiosità è soddisfatta."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|	"Excellent. You deal with the Korath, and I will file a report about this threat. Please inform me immediately once you have taken care of it." He pauses, then continues, "Oh, and remember to record the battle. It may be useful in understanding what they are doing there."|108|0
units.english: "Excellent. You deal with the Korath, and I will file a report about this threat. Please inform me immediately once you have taken care of it." He pauses, then continues, "Oh, and remember to record the battle. It may be useful in understanding what they are doing there."
units.italian: "Eccellente. Tu occupati dei Korath, io presenterò un rapporto su questa minaccia. Informami subito quando te ne sarai occupato." Si ferma, poi continua: "Oh, e ricordati di registrare la battaglia. Potrebbe servire a capire cosa stanno facendo laggiù."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|As you spot the Korath hunters, you recall Plume's request and tap the "Record" button as your ship prepares for combat.|112|0
units.english: As you spot the Korath hunters, you recall Plume's request and tap the "Record" button as your ship prepares for combat.
units.italian: Quando avvisti i cacciatori Korath, ricordi la richiesta di Plume e premi il pulsante "Registra" mentre la nave si prepara al combattimento.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|dialog|123|0
units.english: You have destroyed the Korath hunters. You can now return to <planet> to collect your payment.
units.italian: Hai distrutto i cacciatori Korath. Ora puoi tornare su <planet> per riscuotere il pagamento.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 2|When you return to <planet>, you find Plume waiting for you. He eagerly reviews the recording of the combat. "Thank you for eliminating this hunter-" he is interrupted by a flashing light on his commlink. He briefly reads something, and then looks back up to you. "Apparently, something about the Korath hunting the void sprites has concerned the defense prefect. Chilia has requested that you meet with him on Caelian immediately."|129|0
units.english: When you return to <planet>, you find Plume waiting for you. He eagerly reviews the recording of the combat. "Thank you for eliminating this hunter-" he is interrupted by a flashing light on his commlink. He briefly reads something, and then looks back up to you. "Apparently, something about the Korath hunting the void sprites has concerned the defense prefect. Chilia has requested that you meet with him on Caelian immediately."
units.italian: Quando torni su <planet>, trovi Plume che ti aspetta. Rivede con impazienza la registrazione del combattimento. "Grazie per aver eliminato questo cacciatore-" viene interrotto da una luce lampeggiante sul suo commlink. Legge brevemente qualcosa, poi alza di nuovo lo sguardo su di te. "A quanto pare, la faccenda dei Korath che cacciano gli spettri del vuoto ha allarmato il prefetto della difesa. Chilia ti chiede di incontrarlo subito su Caelian."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 3|name|135|0
units.english: Go to <planet>
units.italian: Vai su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 3|description|136|0
units.english: Prefect Chilia left a message with Plume asking you to meet him on <destination> immediately.
units.italian: Il Prefetto Chilia ha lasciato un messaggio a Plume chiedendoti di incontrarlo subito su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|name|147|0
units.english: Search for the Korath
units.italian: Cerca i Korath

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|description|148|0
units.english: Prefect Chilia has asked you to track down a Korath fleet detected in the Ember Waste before returning to <destination>.
units.italian: Il Prefetto Chilia ti ha chiesto di rintracciare una flotta Korath rilevata nella Distesa di Braci prima di tornare su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|The <ship> has barely come to a rest on its designated pad when your panel begins blinking with a request for permission to come aboard. A glance at the viewscreen shows a fit young man with a military bearing standing at your airlock. You quickly check with the starport control and confirm that the prefect in charge of Remnant military activities is indeed waiting to board your ship. You hit the unlock button and watch as Prefect Chilia strides onboard.|157|0
units.english: The <ship> has barely come to a rest on its designated pad when your panel begins blinking with a request for permission to come aboard. A glance at the viewscreen shows a fit young man with a military bearing standing at your airlock. You quickly check with the starport control and confirm that the prefect in charge of Remnant military activities is indeed waiting to board your ship. You hit the unlock button and watch as Prefect Chilia strides onboard.
units.italian: La <ship> si è appena fermata sulla piazzola assegnata quando il tuo pannello comincia a lampeggiare con una richiesta di permesso di salire a bordo. Un'occhiata allo schermo mostra un giovane aitante dall'aria marziale in piedi davanti alla camera di equilibrio. Controlli in fretta con il controllo dello spazioporto e confermi che il prefetto responsabile delle attività militari dei Remnant sta davvero aspettando di salire sulla tua nave. Premi il pulsante di sblocco e guardi il Prefetto Chilia entrare a grandi passi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|	"Greetings, Captain <first>," he signs. "I am Prefect Chilia. I have the nominal responsibility for the overall defense of Remnant space and military operations." He smiles deprecatingly. "I say 'nominal' as virtually all our activities are military in some way, but usually fall under the purview of those who better understand them."|158|0
units.english: "Greetings, Captain <first>," he signs. "I am Prefect Chilia. I have the nominal responsibility for the overall defense of Remnant space and military operations." He smiles deprecatingly. "I say 'nominal' as virtually all our activities are military in some way, but usually fall under the purview of those who better understand them."
units.italian: "Salve, capitano <first>," segna. "Sono il Prefetto Chilia. Ho la responsabilità nominale della difesa complessiva dello spazio dei Remnant e delle operazioni militari." Sorride con autosufficienza. "Dico 'nominale' perché praticamente tutte le nostre attività sono in qualche modo militari, ma di solito ricadono sotto la competenza di chi le capisce meglio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|The <ship> has barely come to a rest on its designated pad when your panel begins blinking with a request for permission to come aboard. A quick glance at the viewscreen shows Prefect Chilia standing at your airlock. You quickly hit the unlock button and watch as he strides onboard.|161|0
units.english: The <ship> has barely come to a rest on its designated pad when your panel begins blinking with a request for permission to come aboard. A quick glance at the viewscreen shows Prefect Chilia standing at your airlock. You quickly hit the unlock button and watch as he strides onboard.
units.italian: La <ship> si è appena fermata sulla piazzola assegnata quando il tuo pannello comincia a lampeggiare con una richiesta di permesso di salire a bordo. Una rapida occhiata allo schermo mostra il Prefetto Chilia in piedi davanti alla camera di equilibrio. Premi in fretta il pulsante di sblocco e lo guardi entrare a grandi passi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|	"Greetings, Captain <first>," he signs. "You seem to have a knack for finding things of importance to us. I am glad, however, that you and Plume discovered this."|162|0
units.english: "Greetings, Captain <first>," he signs. "You seem to have a knack for finding things of importance to us. I am glad, however, that you and Plume discovered this."
units.italian: "Salve, capitano <first>," segna. "Sembra che tu abbia un talento per trovare le cose che ci interessano. Sono però contento che questa l'abbiano scoperta tu e Plume."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|	His gestures take on an abrupt cadence without many of the normal connecting movements that you are accustomed to. "Now, for the task at hand: it seems the Korath have discovered the void sprites and shot at enough of them that almost all have retreated into the depths of Nasqueron and Slylandro. There are military implications of the Korath harvesting void sprites, and we must take steps to prevent this from happening.|166|0
units.english: His gestures take on an abrupt cadence without many of the normal connecting movements that you are accustomed to. "Now, for the task at hand: it seems the Korath have discovered the void sprites and shot at enough of them that almost all have retreated into the depths of Nasqueron and Slylandro. There are military implications of the Korath harvesting void sprites, and we must take steps to prevent this from happening.
units.italian: I suoi gesti prendono una cadenza brusca, senza molti dei normali movimenti di raccordo a cui sei abituato. "Ora, il compito: sembra che i Korath abbiano scoperto gli spettri del vuoto e ne abbiano colpiti abbastanza che quasi tutti si sono ritirati nelle profondità di Nasqueron e Slylandro. Ci sono implicazioni militari nel fatto che i Korath raccolgano spettri del vuoto, e dobbiamo prendere provvedimenti per impedirlo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|label|168|0
units.english: void rifle
units.italian: void rifle

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|	His gestures take on an abrupt cadence without many of the normal connecting movements that you are accustomed to. You are aware of the potential military implications of the Korath harvesting void sprites and must realize the importance of stopping this.|169|0
units.english: His gestures take on an abrupt cadence without many of the normal connecting movements that you are accustomed to. "Now, for the task at hand: It seems the Korath have discovered the void sprites, and shot at enough of them that almost all have retreated into the depths of Nasqueron and Slylandro. You are aware of the potential military implications of the Korath harvesting void sprites and must realize the importance of stopping this.
units.italian: I suoi gesti prendono una cadenza brusca, senza molti dei normali movimenti di raccordo a cui sei abituato. "Ora, il compito: sembra che i Korath abbiano scoperto gli spettri del vuoto e ne abbiano colpiti abbastanza che quasi tutti si sono ritirati nelle profondità di Nasqueron e Slylandro. Sei consapevole delle potenziali implicazioni militari del fatto che i Korath raccolgano spettri del vuoto, e devi renderti conto di quanto sia importante fermarli.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|	"It is imperative that all the Korath involved in this exploration be located immediately. According to our surveillance, that ship was part of a fleet that recently passed through Parca. Locate the fleet and report back."|171|0
units.english: "It is imperative that all the Korath involved in this exploration be located immediately. According to our surveillance, that ship was part of a fleet that recently passed through Parca. Locate the fleet and report back."
units.italian: "È indispensabile localizzare subito tutti i Korath coinvolti in questa esplorazione. Secondo la nostra sorveglianza, quella nave faceva parte di una flotta passata di recente per Parca. Trova la flotta e riferisci."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|You've destroyed the Korath fleet that was harassing the void sprites.|191|0
units.english: You've destroyed the Korath fleet that was harassing the void sprites.
units.italian: Hai distrutto la flotta Korath che molestava gli spettri del vuoto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|dialog|194|0
units.english: You have located the Korath fleet. They do not seem to be going anywhere at the moment.
units.italian: Hai localizzato la flotta Korath. Al momento non sembra che stia andando da nessuna parte.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|This time, as you complete your post-flight checks you spot Prefect Chilia exiting the Starling next to you and watch as he strides across the pad to your airlock. You hit the open button as he clambers up the ladder. Without a word you pull up the sensor logs from Aescolanus, highlighting the position of the various ships. His eyes flit over the display for a moment, then he nods.|200|0
units.english: This time, as you complete your post-flight checks you spot Prefect Chilia exiting the Starling next to you and watch as he strides across the pad to your airlock. You hit the open button as he clambers up the ladder. Without a word you pull up the sensor logs from Aescolanus, highlighting the position of the various ships. His eyes flit over the display for a moment, then he nods.
units.italian: Questa volta, mentre completi i controlli dopo il volo, vedi il Prefetto Chilia scendere dallo Starling accanto a te e lo guardi attraversare la piazzola a grandi passi fino alla tua camera di equilibrio. Premi il pulsante di apertura mentre si arrampica sulla scaletta. Senza dire una parola tiri su i registri dei sensori di Aescolanus, evidenziando la posizione delle varie navi. I suoi occhi scorrono il display per un momento, poi annuisce.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|	"I will notify a task force. Meet me in the spaceport, and make sure your ship is ready to fight."|203|0
units.english: "I will notify a task force. Meet me in the spaceport, and make sure your ship is ready to fight."
units.italian: "Avviserò una task force. Incontrami allo spazioporto e assicurati che la nave sia pronta a combattere."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|	As he departs from your ship, your commlink beeps with a message that an organization by the name of "Remnant Logistics" has allocated you an additional <payment>.|204|0
units.english: As he departs from your ship, your commlink beeps with a message that an organization by the name of "Remnant Logistics" has allocated you an additional <payment>.
units.italian: Mentre si allontana dalla tua nave, il commlink trilla con un messaggio: un'organizzazione chiamata "Remnant Logistics" ti ha assegnato un <payment> aggiuntivo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|	"You have demonstrated good initiative; however, I suspect that it was not the only hunter fleet out there. I will notify a task force. Meet me in the spaceport, and make sure your ship is ready to fight."|207|0
units.english: "You have demonstrated good initiative; however, I suspect that it was not the only hunter fleet out there. I will notify a task force. Meet me in the spaceport, and make sure your ship is ready to fight."
units.italian: "Hai dimostrato buona iniziativa; sospetto però che non fosse l'unica flotta di cacciatori là fuori. Avviserò una task force. Incontrami allo spazioporto e assicurati che la nave sia pronta a combattere."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 4|	As he departs from your ship, your commlink beeps with a message that an organization by the name of "Remnant Logistics" has allocated you an additional <payment>.|208|0
units.english: As he departs from your ship, your commlink beeps with a message that an organization by the name of "Remnant Logistics" has allocated you an additional <payment>.
units.italian: Mentre si allontana dalla tua nave, il commlink trilla con un messaggio: un'organizzazione chiamata "Remnant Logistics" ti ha assegnato un <payment> aggiuntivo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 5|name|213|0
units.english: Destroy Korath
units.italian: Distruggi i Korath

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 5|description|214|0
units.english: Prefect Chilia has asked you to eliminate the Korath fleet before returning to <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Il Prefetto Chilia ti ha chiesto di eliminare la flotta Korath entro <date>, prima di tornare su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 5|When you arrive in the spaceport, you find Prefect Chilia in the middle of briefing a group of Remnant. He waves you forward as soon as you approach and introduces you to the briefing. "Everyone, this is Captain <last>, who has located the Korath hunters twice now and will take the lead on tracking the rest for this mission." As you cross the room to join him, you take a good look at the group. One detail that stands out to you is that every one of the Remnant in this group is wearing a thick leather wrap around their necks, which extends up to their hairline. The leather has a scaly texture, and it appears to be pulsing faintly. Unfortunately, you do not have time to ask questions, as Chilia has not stopped issuing instructions.|228|0
units.english: When you arrive in the spaceport, you find Prefect Chilia in the middle of briefing a group of Remnant. He waves you forward as soon as you approach and introduces you to the briefing. "Everyone, this is Captain <last>, who has located the Korath hunters twice now and will take the lead on tracking the rest for this mission." As you cross the room to join him, you take a good look at the group. One detail that stands out to you is that every one of the Remnant in this group is wearing a thick leather wrap around their necks, which extends up to their hairline. The leather has a scaly texture, and it appears to be pulsing faintly. Unfortunately, you do not have time to ask questions, as Chilia has not stopped issuing instructions.
units.italian: Quando arrivi allo spazioporto trovi il Prefetto Chilia nel mezzo di un briefing a un gruppo di Remnant. Ti fa cenno di avvicinarti appena ti vede e ti presenta al briefing. "Signori, questo è il capitano <last>, che ha già localizzato due volte i cacciatori Korath e guiderà il rintracciamento degli altri in questa missione." Mentre attraversi la stanza per raggiungerlo, dai una buona occhiata al gruppo. Un dettaglio ti colpisce: ognuno dei Remnant del gruppo porta intorno al collo una spessa fascia di cuoio che sale fino all'attaccatura dei capelli. Il cuoio ha una trama squamosa e sembra pulsare debolmente. Purtroppo non hai tempo di fare domande, perché Chilia non ha smesso di impartire istruzioni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 5|label|230|0
units.english: fleet killed
units.italian: fleet killed

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 5|When you arrive in the spaceport, you find Prefect Chilia in the middle of briefing a group of Remnant. He waves you forward as soon as you approach and introduces you to the briefing. "Everyone, this is Captain <last>, who has located the Korath hunters twice now and recently destroyed part of their fleet. The Captain will take the lead on tracking the rest for this mission." As you cross the room to join him, you take a good look at the group. One detail that stands out to you is that every one of the Remnant in this group is wearing a thick leather wrap around their necks, which extends up to their hairline. The leather has a scaly texture, and it appears to be pulsing faintly. Unfortunately, you do not have time to ask questions, as Chilia has not stopped issuing instructions.|231|0
units.english: When you arrive in the spaceport, you find Prefect Chilia in the middle of briefing a group of Remnant. He waves you forward as soon as you approach and introduces you to the briefing. "Everyone, this is Captain <last>, who has located the Korath hunters twice now and recently destroyed part of their fleet. The Captain will take the lead on tracking the rest for this mission." As you cross the room to join him, you take a good look at the group. One detail that stands out to you is that every one of the Remnant in this group is wearing a thick leather wrap around their necks, which extends up to their hairline. The leather has a scaly texture, and it appears to be pulsing faintly. Unfortunately, you do not have time to ask questions, as Chilia has not stopped issuing instructions.
units.italian: Quando arrivi allo spazioporto trovi il Prefetto Chilia nel mezzo di un briefing a un gruppo di Remnant. Ti fa cenno di avvicinarti appena ti vede e ti presenta al briefing. "Signori, questo è il capitano <last>, che ha già localizzato due volte i cacciatori Korath e di recente ha distrutto parte della loro flotta. Il capitano guiderà il rintracciamento degli altri in questa missione." Mentre attraversi la stanza per raggiungerlo, dai una buona occhiata al gruppo. Un dettaglio ti colpisce: ognuno dei Remnant del gruppo porta intorno al collo una spessa fascia di cuoio che sale fino all'attaccatura dei capelli. Il cuoio ha una trama squamosa e sembra pulsare debolmente. Purtroppo non hai tempo di fare domande, perché Chilia non ha smesso di impartire istruzioni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 5|	He turns to you. "These are the captains who will be following your lead. They are flying two Albatrosses, two Ibises with full complements, and six Starlings. One of the Albatrosses is outfitted to act as a shield; let it take the brunt of attacks." He pauses, looking around at the group. "This task force would be overkill for the intended target, but we are not taking any chances: make sure every Korath there is killed. Salvage is secondary: priority is making sure there are no escapees."|233|0
units.english: He turns to you. "These are the captains who will be following your lead. They are flying two Albatrosses, two Ibises with full complements, and six Starlings. One of the Albatrosses is outfitted to act as a shield; let it take the brunt of attacks." He pauses, looking around at the group. "This task force would be overkill for the intended target, but we are not taking any chances: make sure every Korath there is killed. Salvage is secondary: priority is making sure there are no escapees."
units.italian: Si volta verso di te. "Questi sono i capitani che seguiranno la tua guida. Volano due Albatross, due Ibis al completo e sei Starling. Uno degli Albatross è allestito per fare da scudo; lascia che assorba il grosso degli attacchi." Si ferma, guardandosi intorno verso il gruppo. "Questa task force sarebbe sproporzionata per l'obiettivo previsto, ma non vogliamo correre rischi: assicurati che ogni Korath venga ucciso. Il recupero viene dopo: la priorità è che non ci siano fuggitivi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 5|	He steps back and looks at the group. "May the Embers burn bright for you." With that, he gives the group a respectful nod and walks away. The captains all look around and make various signs you think are probably encouraging combat pilot slang and variations on Prefect Chilia's parting words. As they disperse to their ships, one gestures to you. "Lead on, Captain."|234|0
units.english: He steps back and looks at the group. "May the Embers burn bright for you." With that, he gives the group a respectful nod and walks away. The captains all look around and make various signs you think are probably encouraging combat pilot slang and variations on Prefect Chilia's parting words. As they disperse to their ships, one gestures to you. "Lead on, Captain."
units.italian: Fa un passo indietro e guarda il gruppo. "Che le Braci brucino luminose per voi." Detto questo, fa al gruppo un cenno rispettoso e si allontana. I capitani si guardano intorno e fanno vari segni che supponi essere gergo incoraggiante da piloti da combattimento e varianti del commiato del Prefetto Chilia. Mentre si disperdono verso le loro navi, uno ti fa cenno. "Guida tu, capitano."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 5|dialog|249|0
units.english: You have destroyed all the Korath that appeared to be hunting void sprites.
units.italian: Hai distrutto tutti i Korath che sembravano dare la caccia agli spettri del vuoto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 5|dialog|265|0
units.english: The Korath fleet is gone. Given the urgency Prefect Chilia put on this mission, the onus is on you to find it... quickly.
units.italian: La flotta Korath è sparita. Data l'urgenza che il Prefetto Chilia ha dato a questa missione, tocca a te trovarla... in fretta.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 5|dialog|269|0
units.english: You have found the Korath fleet. Time to destroy them all as Prefect Chilia requested.
units.italian: Hai trovato la flotta Korath. È il momento di distruggerla tutta, come ha chiesto il Prefetto Chilia.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 5|The task force streams back into <planet> without fanfare, its ships settling onto their landing pads with a sense of satisfaction. Within seconds, mechanics are climbing the hulls, and engineers drop from the ceiling on tethers to inspect the engines. Batteries are plugged in, fuel lines connected, and carts with replacement weaponry roll in. As always, the first responsibility of every captain is to ensure that their ship is ready to return to space for whenever it's needed. As the first footsteps echo on the hull of the <ship>, you switch the ship into maintenance mode before heading to the spaceport.|274|0
units.english: The task force streams back into <planet> without fanfare, its ships settling onto their landing pads with a sense of satisfaction. Within seconds, mechanics are climbing the hulls, and engineers drop from the ceiling on tethers to inspect the engines. Batteries are plugged in, fuel lines connected, and carts with replacement weaponry roll in. As always, the first responsibility of every captain is to ensure that their ship is ready to return to space for whenever it's needed. As the first footsteps echo on the hull of the <ship>, you switch the ship into maintenance mode before heading to the spaceport.
units.italian: La task force rientra su <planet> senza clamore, e le navi si posano sulle piazzole con un senso di soddisfazione. In pochi secondi i meccanici si arrampicano sugli scafi, e gli ingegneri calano dal soffitto su corde per ispezionare i motori. Si collegano batterie e condotti del carburante, e arrivano carrelli con armamenti di ricambio. Come sempre, il primo dovere di ogni capitano è assicurarsi che la nave sia pronta a tornare nello spazio quando servirà. Quando i primi passi risuonano sullo scafo della <ship>, passi la nave in modalità manutenzione prima di dirigerti allo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 6|name|279|0
units.english: Transport Plume
units.italian: Trasporta Plume

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 6|description|280|0
units.english: Pick up Plume on <stopovers> and bring him to <origin> by <day>. Prefect Chilia wants to consult him about the void sprites.
units.italian: Prendi Plume su <stopovers> e portalo su <origin> entro <day>. Il Prefetto Chilia vuole consultarlo sugli spettri del vuoto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 6|You find Prefect Chilia and the rest of the captains gathered in a small side room off the main cafeteria. Everyone is digging into their customarily enormous meals while the prefect works the room, talking with everyone. As you pull up a chair, Chilia appears next to you and slides a tray in front of you. "It might not be the sort of fare you are used to from the ancestral worlds," he says, "but it is what we have to offer." Chilia looks around at everyone eating in muted conversation. "It is something of a tradition to eat a meal together when returning from battle. Share memories of those who fall, talk about why they fell, and what we must do differently next time." He eats a few bites from his own plate.|289|0
units.english: You find Prefect Chilia and the rest of the captains gathered in a small side room off the main cafeteria. Everyone is digging into their customarily enormous meals while the prefect works the room, talking with everyone. As you pull up a chair, Chilia appears next to you and slides a tray in front of you. "It might not be the sort of fare you are used to from the ancestral worlds," he says, "but it is what we have to offer." Chilia looks around at everyone eating in muted conversation. "It is something of a tradition to eat a meal together when returning from battle. Share memories of those who fall, talk about why they fell, and what we must do differently next time." He eats a few bites from his own plate.
units.italian: Trovi il Prefetto Chilia e gli altri capitani riuniti in una piccola stanza laterale della mensa principale. Ognuno sta attaccando il suo abituale pasto enorme mentre il prefetto gira per la stanza parlando con tutti. Quando ti siedi, Chilia compare accanto a te e ti infila un vassoio davanti. "Forse non è il genere di pietanze a cui sei abituato dai mondi ancestrali," dice, "ma è quello che possiamo offrirti." Chilia si guarda intorno, verso tutti che mangiano in una conversazione sommessa. "È una specie di tradizione mangiare insieme al ritorno dalla battaglia. Condividere il ricordo di chi è caduto, parlare di perché è caduto e di cosa dobbiamo fare diversamente la prossima volta." Mangia qualche boccone dal suo piatto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 6|	"So, what should we do differently next time?"|290|0
units.english: "So, what should we do differently next time?"
units.italian: "Allora, cosa dovremmo fare diversamente la prossima volta?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 6|	"A few more Albatrosses would have been great."|292|0
units.english: "A few more Albatrosses would have been great."
units.italian: "Qualche Albatross in più sarebbe stato ottimo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 6|	"The EMPs kept getting in the way."|293|0
units.english: "The EMPs kept getting in the way."
units.italian: "Gli EMP continuavano a intralciare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 6|	"I think that went fairly well, actually."|294|0
units.english: "I think that went fairly well, actually."
units.italian: "In realtà credo che sia andata piuttosto bene."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 6|	He writes something on his notepad. "I appreciate the feedback." He pauses and sips from his glass. "Now, moving forward, we need to know what the Korath are doing. Beyond the obvious of killing void sprites and picking fights with the Archon, the Korath are a cunning foe, and they would not antagonize the Archon for no reason," he says.|295|0
units.english: He writes something on his notepad. "I appreciate the feedback." He pauses and sips from his glass. "Now, moving forward, we need to know what the Korath are doing. Beyond the obvious of killing void sprites and picking fights with the Archon, the Korath are a cunning foe, and they would not antagonize the Archon for no reason," he says.
units.italian: Scrive qualcosa sul suo taccuino. "Apprezzo il riscontro." Si ferma e sorseggia dal bicchiere. "Ora, andando avanti, dobbiamo capire cosa stanno facendo i Korath. Al di là dell'ovvio, cioè uccidere spettri del vuoto e attaccare briga con gli Archon, i Korath sono un nemico astuto, e non provocherebbero gli Archon senza un motivo," dice.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 6|	"I have to look into a few things here. In the meantime, please go pick up Plume from <stopovers> and bring him back. We need him to be here for a briefing before <day>."|296|0
units.english: "I have to look into a few things here. In the meantime, please go pick up Plume from <stopovers> and bring him back. We need him to be here for a briefing before <day>."
units.italian: "Devo verificare un paio di cose qui. Nel frattempo, va' a prendere Plume su <stopovers> e riportalo qui. Ci serve che sia presente a un briefing prima di <day>."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 6|Plume is waiting for you at the landing pad. Once you have given the all-clear and opened the doors, he boards with little fanfare. "Thanks for dealing with the Korath, Captain <last>. They had me worried." With that, he settles into a bunk and starts reviewing his notes.|300|0
units.english: Plume is waiting for you at the landing pad. Once you have given the all-clear and opened the doors, he boards with little fanfare. "Thanks for dealing with the Korath, Captain <last>. They had me worried." With that, he settles into a bunk and starts reviewing his notes.
units.italian: Plume ti aspetta alla piazzola di atterraggio. Quando dai il via libera e apri le porte, sale a bordo senza tanti complimenti. "Grazie per esserti occupato dei Korath, capitano <last>. Mi avevano preoccupato." Detto questo, si sistema in una cuccetta e comincia a rivedere i suoi appunti.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 6|As soon as you land, Plume scurries off to find Chilia. By the time you finish your shutdown checks and head to where the meeting is taking place, you find that Plume has almost finished the briefing already. You catch the last few minutes summarizing what materials might be concentrated within the void sprites and his speculation that the Korath may have decided that these semi-processed resources are useful to their survival, despite the hostility of the Archon.|305|0
units.english: As soon as you land, Plume scurries off to find Chilia. By the time you finish your shutdown checks and head to where the meeting is taking place, you find that Plume has almost finished the briefing already. You catch the last few minutes summarizing what materials might be concentrated within the void sprites and his speculation that the Korath may have decided that these semi-processed resources are useful to their survival, despite the hostility of the Archon.
units.italian: Appena atterri, Plume sguscia via a cercare Chilia. Quando finisci i controlli di spegnimento e raggiungi il luogo della riunione, scopri che Plume ha quasi già finito il briefing. Arrivi agli ultimi minuti, che riassumono quali materiali potrebbero essere concentrati negli spettri del vuoto e la sua ipotesi che i Korath abbiano deciso che queste risorse semi-lavorate sono utili alla loro sopravvivenza, nonostante l'ostilità degli Archon.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 6|	After a few minutes of questions and answers about void sprite physiology and speculation by the assembled Remnant pilots, Chilia calls for a recess. "We will reconvene shortly to discuss the implications of this, but there are tasks to be done in the meantime. Captain <first>, meet me in the spaceport."|306|0
units.english: After a few minutes of questions and answers about void sprite physiology and speculation by the assembled Remnant pilots, Chilia calls for a recess. "We will reconvene shortly to discuss the implications of this, but there are tasks to be done in the meantime. Captain <first>, meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: Dopo qualche minuto di domande e risposte sulla fisiologia degli spettri del vuoto e di congetture dei piloti Remnant riuniti, Chilia concede una pausa. "Ci ritroveremo tra poco per discutere le implicazioni di tutto questo, ma nel frattempo ci sono compiti da sbrigare. Capitano <first>, mi incontri allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 6|	As everyone disperses towards the spaceport, your commlink notifies you that you have received what the message terms "a resource offset allotment of <payment> from Remnant Logistics."|307|0
units.english: As everyone disperses towards the spaceport, your commlink notifies you that you have received what the message terms "a resource offset allotment of <payment> from Remnant Logistics."
units.italian: Mentre tutti si disperdono verso lo spazioporto, il tuo commlink ti avvisa che hai ricevuto quello che il messaggio chiama "un'assegnazione di compensazione risorse di <payment> da Remnant Logistics."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 7|name|312|0
units.english: Take Plume to <planet>
units.italian: Porta Plume su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 7|description|313|0
units.english: Plume wants to witness firsthand what is going on in Nenia, and would like to visit <planet>.
units.italian: Plume vuole vedere di persona cosa succede a Nenia e vorrebbe visitare <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 7|In the starport, Prefect Chilia and Plume are gesturing at some details on a datapad when you approach. Chilia notices you first and waves you over. "Thank you for joining us. While I put together some more long-term plans, could you take Plume to <planet>?"|321|0
units.english: In the starport, Prefect Chilia and Plume are gesturing at some details on a datapad when you approach. Chilia notices you first and waves you over. "Thank you for joining us. While I put together some more long-term plans, could you take Plume to <planet>?"
units.italian: Nello spazioporto, il Prefetto Chilia e Plume stanno indicando alcuni dettagli su un datapad quando ti avvicini. Chilia ti nota per primo e ti fa cenno di avvicinarti. "Grazie per esserti unito a noi. Mentre metto insieme piani un po' più a lungo termine, potresti portare Plume su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 7|	"Why do we need to go back?"|323|0
units.english: "Why do we need to go back?"
units.italian: "Perché dobbiamo tornarci?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 7|	"Let's go."|324|0
units.english: "Let's go."
units.italian: "Andiamo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 7|	"Recordings and sensor readings are useful data, but they don't really compare to actually seeing what is going on and experiencing the data firsthand." says Plume. "There aren't too many opportunities to do it in my line of work - especially when my expertise is needed by others who would rather not spend their time watching wildlife. But I digress."|326|0
units.english: "Recordings and sensor readings are useful data, but they don't really compare to actually seeing what is going on and experiencing the data firsthand." says Plume. "There aren't too many opportunities to do it in my line of work - especially when my expertise is needed by others who would rather not spend their time watching wildlife. But I digress."
units.italian: "Le registrazioni e le letture dei sensori sono dati utili, ma non si possono davvero confrontare con il vedere quello che succede e sperimentare i dati di persona," dice Plume. "Nel mio lavoro non ci sono molte occasioni per farlo - soprattutto quando la mia competenza serve ad altri che preferirebbero non passare il tempo a guardare la fauna selvatica. Ma sto divagando."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 7|	With a respectful bow to Chilia (who returns it equally respectfully), Plume heads for your ship. "I will be waiting onboard for you, Captain."|328|0
units.english: With a respectful bow to Chilia (who returns it equally respectfully), Plume heads for your ship. "I will be waiting onboard for you, Captain."
units.italian: Con un inchino rispettoso a Chilia (che glielo ricambia con altrettanto rispetto), Plume si dirige verso la tua nave. "Ti aspetto a bordo, capitano."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 7|Descending into the clouds of Nasqueron is becoming almost familiar to you. Wispy layers of gas give way to more voluminous formations and the occasional turbulent storm. Beside you, Plume is eagerly peering out the window, and you remind yourself that this may well be his first time actually seeing void sprites on their world.|342|0
units.english: Descending into the clouds of Nasqueron is becoming almost familiar to you. Wispy layers of gas give way to more voluminous formations and the occasional turbulent storm. Beside you, Plume is eagerly peering out the window, and you remind yourself that this may well be his first time actually seeing void sprites on their world.
units.italian: Scendere tra le nuvole di Nasqueron sta quasi diventando per te un'abitudine. Strati velati di gas lasciano il posto a formazioni più voluminose e a qualche tempesta turbolenta. Accanto a te, Plume si sporge con impazienza dalla finestra, e ti ricordi che questa potrebbe benissimo essere la prima volta che vede davvero gli spettri del vuoto sul loro mondo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 7|	You reach the altitude where void sprites have previously been found in the greatest concentration before activating your ship's sensors. Plume looks around, peering out the windows. "Where are they? Aren't there usually some around? They always seemed plentiful in the recordings." You focus on the sensors, and after a few minutes pick up some distant contacts. You follow them down into the lower atmosphere and eventually begin to detect some void sprites.|343|0
units.english: You reach the altitude where void sprites have previously been found in the greatest concentration before activating your ship's sensors. Plume looks around, peering out the windows. "Where are they? Aren't there usually some around? They always seemed plentiful in the recordings." You focus on the sensors, and after a few minutes pick up some distant contacts. You follow them down into the lower atmosphere and eventually begin to detect some void sprites.
units.italian: Raggiungi la quota dove in passato gli spettri del vuoto sono stati trovati nella maggiore concentrazione, poi attivi i sensori della nave. Plume si guarda intorno, spiando dalle finestre. "Dove sono? Non ce ne sono di solito da queste parti? Sembravano sempre abbondanti nelle registrazioni." Ti concentri sui sensori e dopo qualche minuto capti alcuni contatti lontani. Li segui giù nell'atmosfera inferiore e alla fine cominci a rilevare qualche spettro del vuoto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 7|	"That's close enough, Captain," says Plume. "I will go outside and watch them from the hull." You help him into a pressure suit and cycle the airlock behind him. You quickly suppress a brief feeling of disappointment. "This is, after all, Plume's job," you say to yourself as you settle back into your chair to wait for him to return.|344|0
units.english: "That's close enough, Captain," says Plume. "I will go outside and watch them from the hull." You help him into a pressure suit and cycle the airlock behind him. You quickly suppress a brief feeling of disappointment. "This is, after all, Plume's job," you say to yourself as you settle back into your chair to wait for him to return.
units.italian: "Basta così, capitano," dice Plume. "Esco e li guardo dallo scafo." Lo aiuti a infilarsi in una tuta pressurizzata e fai il ciclo della camera di equilibrio dietro di lui. Reprimi in fretta un breve senso di delusione. "Dopotutto, questo è il lavoro di Plume," dici tra te, mentre ti sistemi sulla poltrona ad aspettare che torni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 8|name|350|0
units.english: Return Plume to <planet>
units.italian: Riporta Plume su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 8|description|351|0
units.english: Plume wants to check his records of the research on void sprites to verify some information.
units.italian: Plume vuole controllare i suoi registri della ricerca sugli spettri del vuoto per verificare alcune informazioni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 8|Plume returns to the ship after several hours, spurred by alarms in his suit warning you both of low oxygen levels. As you help him out of the pressure suit, he looks like he is having trouble deciding if he should be thrilled or worried.|358|0
units.english: Plume returns to the ship after several hours, spurred by alarms in his suit warning you both of low oxygen levels. As you help him out of the pressure suit, he looks like he is having trouble deciding if he should be thrilled or worried.
units.italian: Plume torna alla nave dopo diverse ore, spinto dagli allarmi della tuta che avvertono entrambi del livello basso di ossigeno. Mentre lo aiuti a uscire dalla tuta pressurizzata, sembra avere difficoltà a decidere se essere entusiasta o preoccupato.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 8|	"It is wonderful to be here, watching them from a distance. A few did venture close, too. But I'm worried about them. Some of the void sprites out there have scorch marks similar to the scoring left by Korath weapons. And we already noticed that they are hiding much deeper in the atmosphere than normal." He glances down at his datapad then back up at you. "Once we are back into the chaos of the Ember Waste, I will send Chilia a signal. It looks like I will need to double-check my records and samples back on Aventine. Please take me there."|359|0
units.english: "It is wonderful to be here, watching them from a distance. A few did venture close, too. But I'm worried about them. Some of the void sprites out there have scorch marks similar to the scoring left by Korath weapons. And we already noticed that they are hiding much deeper in the atmosphere than normal." He glances down at his datapad then back up at you. "Once we are back into the chaos of the Ember Waste, I will send Chilia a signal. It looks like I will need to double-check my records and samples back on Aventine. Please take me there."
units.italian: "È meraviglioso essere qui, a guardarli da lontano. Alcuni si sono anche avvicinati. Ma sono preoccupato per loro. Alcuni degli spettri del vuoto là fuori hanno segni di bruciatura simili a quelli lasciati dalle armi Korath. E abbiamo già notato che si nascondono molto più in profondità nell'atmosfera del normale." Abbassa lo sguardo sul datapad, poi lo rialza su di te. "Appena saremo di nuovo nel caos della Distesa di Braci, manderò un segnale a Chilia. Sembra che dovrò ricontrollare i miei registri e i campioni su Aventine. Portami lì, per favore."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 8|As you approach Aventine, Plume gestures toward the pad closest to his lab. "You might as well set down there. If the samples in my lab check out, I will have another mission for you right away. You will need to keep your high-pressure ship active for this one. Stop by the lab in an hour or two and we will be ready to start loading."|373|0
units.english: As you approach Aventine, Plume gestures toward the pad closest to his lab. "You might as well set down there. If the samples in my lab check out, I will have another mission for you right away. You will need to keep your high-pressure ship active for this one. Stop by the lab in an hour or two and we will be ready to start loading."
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini ad Aventine, Plume ti fa cenno verso la piazzola più vicina al suo laboratorio. "Tanto vale che ti posi lì. Se i campioni del mio laboratorio risultano corretti, avrò subito un'altra missione per te. Per questa dovrai tenere attiva la tua nave ad alta pressione. Passa dal laboratorio tra un'ora o due e saremo pronti a cominciare a caricare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|name|378|0
units.english: Transport engineer to <planet>
units.italian: Trasporta un ingegnere su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|description|379|0
units.english: An engineer working for Plume needs transportation for himself and some equipment to <planet>.
units.italian: Un ingegnere che lavora per Plume ha bisogno di un passaggio per sé e per un po' di attrezzatura fino a <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|blocked|380|0
units.english: Plume's engineer needs a free bunk and <tons> of cargo space for his equipment. Come back when you have enough space.
units.italian: L'ingegnere di Plume ha bisogno di una cuccetta libera e di <tons> di spazio nel carico per la sua attrezzatura. Torna quando avrai spazio a sufficienza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|log|388|0
units.english: A technician that works with Plume, and a talented astrobiologist. Gavriil is the project lead for the repurposed Esquiline station.
units.italian: Un tecnico che lavora con Plume, e un talento dell'astrobiologia. Gavriil è a capo del progetto per la stazione riadattata di Esquiline.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|You walk into Plume's lab and are greeted by a large stack of crates and equipment. Plume and another Remnant are gathered around the stack, checking items off a list. "Ah, <first>! Good timing. We were just finishing the inventory of supplies that need to go on this delivery." He gestures to the engineer. "This is Gavriil, one of our best technologists and a skilled astrobiologist in their own right. They will be going with you."|390|0
units.english: You walk into Plume's lab and are greeted by a large stack of crates and equipment. Plume and another Remnant are gathered around the stack, checking items off a list. "Ah, <first>! Good timing. We were just finishing the inventory of supplies that need to go on this delivery." He gestures to the engineer. "This is Gavriil, one of our best technologists and a skilled astrobiologist in their own right. They will be going with you."
units.italian: Entri nel laboratorio di Plume e vieni accolto da una gran pila di casse e attrezzature. Plume e un altro Remnant sono intorno alla pila a spuntare voci da una lista. "Ah, <first>! Arrivi al momento giusto. Stavamo appena finendo l'inventario dei rifornimenti da portare con questa consegna." Fa un cenno verso l'ingegnere. "Ti presento Gavriil, del nostro team tecnico: è tra le nostre menti migliori e conosce bene l'astrobiologia. Viaggerà con te."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|	"It will be a pleasure to work with you," signs Gavriil, making a short bow. "We will be traveling to a research station on <planet>. Yes, it is a gas giant." They smile at that. "I have to get some equipment set up and get the core systems online. There will be a few more loads of materials afterwards." They look askance at you. "Shall we get started?"|391|0
units.english: "It will be a pleasure to work with you," signs Gavriil, making a short bow. "We will be traveling to a research station on <planet>. Yes, it is a gas giant." They smile at that. "I have to get some equipment set up and get the core systems online. There will be a few more loads of materials afterwards." They look askance at you. "Shall we get started?"
units.italian: "Sarà un piacere lavorare con te," segna Gavriil, con un breve inchino. "Andremo a una stazione di ricerca su <planet>. Sì, è un gigante gassoso." Sorride a quella battuta. "Devo installare un po' di attrezzatura e rimettere in linea i sistemi principali. Dopo arriveranno altri carichi di materiali." Ti lancia un'occhiata di traverso. "Cominciamo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|Gavriil gives you precise directions to a set of coordinates that your sensors tell you is an empty area, and when you reach the designated spot, you see a small station shimmering out of the clouds.|396|0
units.english: Gavriil gives you precise directions to a set of coordinates that your sensors tell you is an empty area, and when you reach the designated spot, you see a small station shimmering out of the clouds.
units.italian: Gavriil ti dà indicazioni precise verso un insieme di coordinate che i tuoi sensori indicano come un'area vuota; quando raggiungi il punto designato, vedi una piccola stazione emergere tremolando dalle nuvole.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|	"We never managed to actually cloak the station," the engineer explains, grinning. "But we managed to hide it very effectively against every form of scanning we knew of. We even managed to give it a cloak-like field that renders it mostly transparent."|398|0
units.english: "We never managed to actually cloak the station," the engineer explains, grinning. "But we managed to hide it very effectively against every form of scanning we knew of. We even managed to give it a cloak-like field that renders it mostly transparent."
units.italian: "Non siamo mai riusciti a occultare davvero la stazione," spiega l'ingegnere, sogghignando. "Ma siamo riusciti a nasconderla molto efficacemente a ogni forma di scansione che conoscessimo. Siamo persino riusciti a darle un campo simile a un occultamento che la rende in gran parte trasparente."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|	They nod approvingly. "It's rather impressive what my predecessors managed to do with what they had back then."|399|0
units.english: They nod approvingly. "It's rather impressive what my predecessors managed to do with what they had back then."
units.italian: Annuisce con approvazione. "È piuttosto impressionante quello che i miei predecessori sono riusciti a fare con i mezzi che avevano allora."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|	"What do you mean?"|401|0
units.english: "What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Che cosa intendi?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|	"Let's get on with it."|402|0
units.english: "Let's get on with it."
units.italian: "Mettiamoci al lavoro."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|	"Well, this place is fairly old. It was built shortly after we learned how to build Starlings - which is where we learned of the troubles of extending the cloaking field beyond small ships. I don't know the mechanics behind it, but it has taken close to two centuries of study and development for cloaks to be feasible on large ships. We had plenty of Puffins back then, and the techniques for building high-pressure systems were well understood. The Alphas hadn't shown any interest in gas giants or 'gaslined ships' as we call them, so having somewhere like this to hide in makes sense. Best place to hide is somewhere no one will look, right?" With that, they nod to themself, climb to their feet, and head towards the suit locker.|404|0
units.english: "Well, this place is fairly old. It was built shortly after we learned how to build Starlings - which is where we learned of the troubles of extending the cloaking field beyond small ships. I don't know the mechanics behind it, but it has taken close to two centuries of study and development for cloaks to be feasible on large ships. We had plenty of Puffins back then, and the techniques for building high-pressure systems were well understood. The Alphas hadn't shown any interest in gas giants or 'gaslined ships' as we call them, so having somewhere like this to hide in makes sense. Best place to hide is somewhere no one will look, right?" With that, they nod to themself, climb to their feet, and head towards the suit locker.
units.italian: "Beh, questo posto è piuttosto vecchio. È stato costruito poco dopo che abbiamo imparato a costruire gli Starling, ed è lì che abbiamo scoperto i problemi di estendere il campo di occultamento oltre le navi piccole. Non conosco i meccanismi, ma ci sono voluti quasi due secoli di studio e sviluppo perché gli occultamenti fossero realizzabili su navi grandi. Allora avevamo parecchi Puffin, e le tecniche per costruire sistemi ad alta pressione erano ben comprese. Gli Alpha non avevano mostrato interesse per i giganti gassosi o per le 'navi con rivestimento per gas', come le chiamiamo noi, quindi avere un posto così dove nascondersi ha senso. Il posto migliore per nascondersi è dove nessuno guarderà, no?" Detto questo, annuisce a se stesso, si alza in piedi e si dirige verso l'armadietto delle tute.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|label|405|0
units.english: skip info
units.italian: skip info

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|	"The station should be pressurized with a normal atmosphere, but it has been running on standby for ages with just yearly maintenance. It is time to get this place up and running again." With two of you operating your ship's loading equipment, everything is transferred in short order. You notice that the last crate includes a substantial amount of field rations and survival gear. It looks like Gavriil is planning on staying here for a while.|406|0
units.english: "The station should be pressurized with a normal atmosphere, but it has been running on standby for ages with just yearly maintenance. It is time to get this place up and running again." With two of you operating your ship's loading equipment, everything is transferred in short order. You notice that the last crate includes a substantial amount of field rations and survival gear. It looks like Gavriil is planning on staying here for a while.
units.italian: "La stazione dovrebbe essere pressurizzata con un'atmosfera normale, ma è rimasta in standby per ere con solo la manutenzione annuale. È ora di rimetterla in funzione." Con due di voi ai comandi delle attrezzature di carico della nave, tutto viene trasferito in breve tempo. Noti che l'ultima cassa contiene una quantità notevole di razioni da campo e attrezzatura di sopravvivenza. Sembra che Gavriil abbia intenzione di restare qui per un po'.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 9|	As they head off deeper into the station, you receive a notification that "Remnant Logistics" has made a deposit of <payment> to your account.|407|0
units.english: As they head off deeper into the station, you receive a notification that "Remnant Logistics" has made a deposit of <payment> to your account.
units.italian: Mentre si allontanano verso l'interno della stazione, ricevi una notifica che "Remnant Logistics" ha versato un <payment> sul tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 10|name|413|0
units.english: Technician and supplies to <planet>
units.italian: Tecnico e rifornimenti su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 10|description|414|0
units.english: You need to pick up a technician and their equipment from <stopovers> and take them to <planet>.
units.italian: Devi prendere un tecnico e la sua attrezzatura su <stopovers> e portarli su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 10|blocked|417|0
units.english: Plume's technician needs a free bunk and <tons> of cargo space for his equipment. Come back when you have enough space.
units.italian: Il tecnico di Plume ha bisogno di una cuccetta libera e di <tons> di spazio nel carico per la sua attrezzatura. Torna quando avrai spazio a sufficienza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 10|As you look around this eerily silent station, you get a message on your commlink: Plume requests that you pick up another technician and <tons> of equipment from <stopovers> and bring them back to <origin>.|424|0
units.english: As you look around this eerily silent station, you get a message on your commlink: Plume requests that you pick up another technician and <tons> of equipment from <stopovers> and bring them back to <origin>.
units.italian: Mentre ti guardi intorno in questa stazione stranamente silenziosa, ricevi un messaggio sul commlink: Plume ti chiede di prendere un altro tecnico e <tons> di attrezzatura su <stopovers> e di riportarli su <origin>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 10|Flight control gives you directions to a landing pad that already has a large pile of crates stacked next to it. As you land, workers swarm out to help load the equipment. Once everything is stowed, a young technician climbs aboard, stows their gear, and lets you know that everything is ready for departure. You shake your head, impressed at how quickly the Remnant make things happen when projects start to move.|427|0
units.english: Flight control gives you directions to a landing pad that already has a large pile of crates stacked next to it. As you land, workers swarm out to help load the equipment. Once everything is stowed, a young technician climbs aboard, stows their gear, and lets you know that everything is ready for departure.
