You shake your head, impressed at how quickly the Remnant make things happen when projects start to move.
units.italian: Il controllo del volo ti indica una piazzola di atterraggio che ha già un gran mucchio di casse impilate accanto. Mentre atterri, i lavoratori si precipitano fuori ad aiutare a caricare l'attrezzatura. Quando tutto è sistemato, una giovane tecnica sale a bordo, ripone i suoi strumenti e ti avvisa che tutto è pronto per la partenza. Scuoti la testa, impressionato da quanto in fretta i Remnant facciano succedere le cose quando i progetti si mettono in moto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 10|On the flight over, the technician joins you on the control deck to chat. She's a biotech specialist, adept at managing life-support systems in alien atmospheres, and a recent graduate from a Remnant educational program that seems to be similar to a university. Apparently she studied astrobiology and is part of a project aimed at supporting mutually exclusive environments in close proximity. She spends nearly an hour excitedly telling you the ins and outs of the station.|431|0
units.english: On the flight over, the technician joins you on the control deck to chat. She's a biotech specialist, adept at managing life-support systems in alien atmospheres, and a recent graduate from a Remnant educational program that seems to be similar to a university. Apparently she studied astrobiology and is part of a project aimed at supporting mutually exclusive environments in close proximity. She spends nearly an hour excitedly telling you the ins and outs of the station.
units.italian: Durante il volo, la tecnica ti raggiunge sul ponte di comando per chiacchierare. È specialista in biotecnologie, abile nella gestione dei sistemi di supporto vitale in atmosfere aliene, e si è appena diplomata in un programma educativo dei Remnant che sembra simile a un'università. A quanto pare ha studiato astrobiologia e fa parte di un progetto che mira a sostenere ambienti mutuamente esclusivi a breve distanza. Passa quasi un'ora a raccontarti con entusiasmo tutti i dettagli della stazione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 10|	As you approach <planet>, it occurs to you that the Remnant might appreciate you taking steps to maintain the secrecy of the station. Altering the <ship>'s path slightly, you swing down into <planet> in an oblique path then meander around the planet under the cloud layer until arriving at the station. Your passenger nods approvingly as she notices the flight path. "Secrecy is always good with projects like this. We appreciate the extra effort, and if anyone were to follow you, a path like that through the clouds would leave few signs to spot."|432|0
units.english: As you approach <planet>, it occurs to you that the Remnant might appreciate you taking steps to maintain the secrecy of the station. Altering the <ship>'s path slightly, you swing down into <planet> in an oblique path then meander around the planet under the cloud layer until arriving at the station. Your passenger nods approvingly as she notices the flight path. "Secrecy is always good with projects like this. We appreciate the extra effort, and if anyone were to follow you, a path like that through the clouds would leave few signs to spot."
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini a <planet>, ti viene in mente che i Remnant potrebbero apprezzare se prendessi qualche accorgimento per mantenere segreta la stazione. Modificando leggermente la rotta della <ship>, scendi verso <planet> su un percorso obliquo, poi vaghi intorno al pianeta sotto lo strato di nuvole fino ad arrivare alla stazione. La tua passeggera annuisce con approvazione quando nota la traiettoria. "La segretezza fa sempre bene con progetti come questo. Apprezziamo lo sforzo extra, e se qualcuno ti seguisse, un percorso così tra le nuvole lascerebbe pochi indizi da notare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 10|	The <ship> settles into the landing bay, and the technician quickly disembarks. Apparently there must have been other shipments while you were gone, as there are now a handful of people visible and quite a bit more equipment stacked everywhere. The station itself feels more alive, the air fresher. As before, you promptly receive notification of another payment of <payment> to your account.|433|0
units.english: The <ship> settles into the landing bay, and the technician quickly disembarks. Apparently there must have been other shipments while you were gone, as there are now a handful of people visible and quite a bit more equipment stacked everywhere. The station itself feels more alive, the air fresher. As before, you promptly receive notification of another payment of <payment> to your account.
units.italian: La <ship> si posa nella baia di atterraggio e la tecnica sbarca in fretta. A quanto pare ci sono stati altri carichi mentre eri via, perché ora si vedono alcune persone e parecchia altra attrezzatura impilata ovunque. La stazione stessa sembra più viva, l'aria più fresca. Come prima, ricevi subito la notifica di un altro pagamento di <payment> sul tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 11|name|439|0
units.english: Remnant Data Delivery
units.italian: Consegna di dati dei Remnant

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 11|description|440|0
units.english: Deliver a data crystal to the engineers on <planet>.
units.italian: Consegna un cristallo di dati agli ingegneri su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 11|As you finish unloading, you spot Gavriil approaching. They gesture in greeting as they approach. "Thanks for the delivery. We've got standard logistics routes set up now for the rest." They pause and fish a data crystal out of a pouch. "Could you take this to Prefect Taely on <planet>? She is overseeing some retrofits and will need this data."|447|0
units.english: As you finish unloading, you spot Gavriil approaching. They gesture in greeting as they approach. "Thanks for the delivery. We've got standard logistics routes set up now for the rest." They pause and fish a data crystal out of a pouch. "Could you take this to Prefect Taely on <planet>? She is overseeing some retrofits and will need this data."
units.italian: Mentre finisci di scaricare, vedi Gavriil avvicinarsi. Ti saluta con un gesto mentre si avvicina. "Grazie della consegna. Ora abbiamo organizzato rotte logistiche standard per il resto." Si ferma e pesca un cristallo di dati da una sacca. "Potresti portarlo al Prefetto Taely su <planet>? Sta supervisionando alcune modifiche e avrà bisogno di questi dati."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 11|On Viminal, you easily locate the maintenance yards. You ask around for Prefect Taely and are eventually directed towards a solidly built woman working on a Pelican. She spots you approaching and frees herself from the machinery. "Greetings, Captain <last>, I am Prefect Taely. I understand you have something for me." You hand her the data crystal. "This must contain the detailed chemical analysis and profiles," she says. She slots it into her console and taps a few commands. "Okay, I just need to incorporate these profiles into the system and make a few more adjustments. Meet me in the spaceport cafeteria in a couple hours."|454|0
units.english: On Viminal, you easily locate the maintenance yards. You ask around for Prefect Taely and are eventually directed towards a solidly built woman working on a Pelican. She spots you approaching and frees herself from the machinery. "Greetings, Captain <last>, I am Prefect Taely. I understand you have something for me." You hand her the data crystal. "This must contain the detailed chemical analysis and profiles," she says. She slots it into her console and taps a few commands. "Okay, I just need to incorporate these profiles into the system and make a few more adjustments. Meet me in the spaceport cafeteria in a couple hours."
units.italian: Su Viminal individui facilmente i cantieri di manutenzione. Chiedi in giro del Prefetto Taely e alla fine ti indicano una donna robusta che lavora su un Pelican. Ti vede arrivare e si libera dai macchinari. "Salve, capitano <last>, sono il Prefetto Taely. Ho saputo che hai qualcosa per me." Le porgi il cristallo di dati. "Qui dentro ci saranno le analisi chimiche dettagliate e i profili," dice. Lo inserisce nella console e tocca qualche comando. "Bene, devo solo integrare questi profili nel sistema e fare qualche altro aggiustamento. Incontrami nella mensa dello spazioporto tra un paio d'ore."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 11|On Viminal, you easily locate the maintenance yards and eventually find Taely buried in a Pelican. She spots you approaching and frees herself from the machinery. "Greetings, <first>. How is our station faring?" You reply that it is improving rapidly and hand her the data crystal. "Ah, good. This must contain the detailed chemical analysis and profiles," she says. She slots it into her console and taps a few commands. "Okay, I just need to incorporate these profiles into the system and make a few more adjustments. Meet me in the spaceport cafeteria in a couple hours."|457|0
units.english: On Viminal, you easily locate the maintenance yards and eventually find Taely buried in a Pelican. She spots you approaching and frees herself from the machinery. "Greetings, <first>. How is our station faring?" You reply that it is improving rapidly and hand her the data crystal. "Ah, good. This must contain the detailed chemical analysis and profiles," she says. She slots it into her console and taps a few commands. "Okay, I just need to incorporate these profiles into the system and make a few more adjustments. Meet me in the spaceport cafeteria in a couple hours."
units.italian: Su Viminal individui facilmente i cantieri di manutenzione e alla fine trovi Taely immersa in un Pelican. Ti vede arrivare e si libera dai macchinari. "Salve, <first>. Come se la passa la nostra stazione?" Rispondi che sta migliorando rapidamente e le porgi il cristallo di dati. "Ah, bene. Qui dentro ci saranno le analisi chimiche dettagliate e i profili," dice. Lo inserisce nella console e tocca qualche comando. "Bene, devo solo integrare questi profili nel sistema e fare qualche altro aggiustamento. Incontrami nella mensa dello spazioporto tra un paio d'ore."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 12|name|462|0
units.english: Meet with escorts
units.italian: Incontra le scorte

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 12|description|463|0
units.english: Travel with the <npc> to pick up a shipment of atmosphere from <stopovers>, and deliver it to <destination>.
units.italian: Viaggia con <npc> per prelevare un carico di atmosfera su <stopovers> e consegnarlo su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 12|In the cafeteria, you are met by Taely and several other captains. "Thank you for joining us," she signs. "The goal of this mission is to travel to Nasqueron together with equipment designed to harvest some atmosphere from the void sprites' worlds before bringing it back to Esquiline. The equipment on the Puffins will collect, compress, and store the gas, which you can offload to specially prepared tanks on the Pelican. Then proceed to <planet> and offload what you have collected to the station."|472|0
units.english: In the cafeteria, you are met by Taely and several other captains. "Thank you for joining us," she signs. "The goal of this mission is to travel to Nasqueron together with equipment designed to harvest some atmosphere from the void sprites' worlds before bringing it back to Esquiline. The equipment on the Puffins will collect, compress, and store the gas, which you can offload to specially prepared tanks on the Pelican. Then proceed to <planet> and offload what you have collected to the station."
units.italian: Nella mensa ti accolgono Taely e altri capitani. "Grazie per essere venuto," segna. "Lo scopo di questa missione è andare su Nasqueron insieme a un'attrezzatura progettata per raccogliere un po' di atmosfera dai mondi degli spettri del vuoto e riportarla a Esquiline. L'attrezzatura sui Puffin raccoglierà, comprimerà e stoccherà il gas, che potrai trasferire in serbatoi preparati apposta sul Pelican. Poi procederai verso <planet> e scaricherai alla stazione quello che hai raccolto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 12|	She turns to face the group of captains and gestures with tones of respect. "May the Embers bring interest to your journey."|475|0
units.english: She turns to face the group of captains and gestures with tones of respect. "May the Embers bring interest to your journey."
units.italian: Si volta verso il gruppo di capitani e gesticola con toni di rispetto. "Che le Braci portino interesse al vostro viaggio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 12|	She nods at you and continues. "The Penguin will be even better than the Puffin for this task, and you are welcome to use her, but we do not have any available to accompany you. Continuing to rely on Puffins is not ideal, but we will make do with what we have." She turns to face the group of captains and gestures with tones of respect. "May the Embers bring interest to your journey."|478|0
units.english: She nods at you and continues. "The Penguin will be even better than the Puffin for this task, and you are welcome to use her, but we do not have any available to accompany you. Continuing to rely on Puffins is not ideal, but we will make do with what we have." She turns to face the group of captains and gestures with tones of respect. "May the Embers bring interest to your journey."
units.italian: Ti fa un cenno e continua. "Il Penguin sarà ancora meglio del Puffin per questo compito, e sei libero di usarlo, ma non ne abbiamo nessuno disponibile per accompagnarti. Continuare a contare sui Puffin non è l'ideale, ma faremo con quello che abbiamo." Si volta verso il gruppo di capitani e gesticola con toni di rispetto. "Che le Braci portino interesse al vostro viaggio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 12|You cruise through the atmosphere at a relaxed pace, waiting while the equipment does its work. You see fewer void sprites than usual, and many have scars. Once the equipment indicates that it has reached capacity, you climb up to where the Pelican is waiting in the high atmosphere, hook up the connections to offload the gas, and then head back down into the depths of the planet. After several hours, the captain of the Pelican informs you that the tanks are full, and it is time to head to <planet>.|492|0
units.english: You cruise through the atmosphere at a relaxed pace, waiting while the equipment does its work. You see fewer void sprites than usual, and many have scars. Once the equipment indicates that it has reached capacity, you climb up to where the Pelican is waiting in the high atmosphere, hook up the connections to offload the gas, and then head back down into the depths of the planet. After several hours, the captain of the Pelican informs you that the tanks are full, and it is time to head to <planet>.
units.italian: Te ne vai tra l'atmosfera a ritmo rilassato, aspettando che l'attrezzatura faccia il suo lavoro. Vedi meno spettri del vuoto del solito, e molti hanno cicatrici. Quando l'attrezzatura segnala di aver raggiunto la capacità, sali dove il Pelican aspetta nell'atmosfera alta, colleghi i raccordi per scaricare il gas, poi torni giù nelle profondità del pianeta. Dopo diverse ore, il capitano del Pelican ti informa che i serbatoi sono pieni ed è il momento di andare su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 12|You arrive at the hidden station on <planet> where Gavriil is waiting to offload the atmospheric gases. Their team quickly hooks the Puffins up to ports on the bay walls, and hidden equipment starts pumping their contents into the system. After a few minutes, they disconnect the ships, and you and the Puffins head up to the Pelican to refill your reservoirs and ferry it down to the station.|496|0
units.english: You arrive at the hidden station on <planet> where Gavriil is waiting to offload the atmospheric gases. Their team quickly hooks the Puffins up to ports on the bay walls, and hidden equipment starts pumping their contents into the system. After a few minutes, they disconnect the ships, and you and the Puffins head up to the Pelican to refill your reservoirs and ferry it down to the station.
units.italian: Arrivi alla stazione nascosta su <planet>, dove Gavriil aspetta di scaricare i gas atmosferici. La sua squadra collega in fretta i Puffin alle prese sulle pareti della baia, e un'attrezzatura nascosta comincia a pompare il contenuto nel sistema. Dopo qualche minuto scollegano le navi, e tu e i Puffin salite al Pelican per riempire i serbatoi e trasferirlo alla stazione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 12|	As the last load starts to empty into the station, another tech comes up to you. "Captain, we just received a message from Prefect Chilia. He would like you to meet him on Viminal as soon as possible." You nod and start to run checks on the <ship>, making ready to leave once the cargo is done unloading.|497|0
units.english: As the last load starts to empty into the station, another tech comes up to you. "Captain, we just received a message from Prefect Chilia. He would like you to meet him on Viminal as soon as possible." You nod and start to run checks on the <ship>, making ready to leave once the cargo is done unloading.
units.italian: Mentre l'ultimo carico comincia a svuotarsi nella stazione, un altro tecnico ti si avvicina. "Capitano, abbiamo appena ricevuto un messaggio dal Prefetto Chilia. Vorrebbe incontrarti su Viminal il prima possibile." Annuisci e cominci a fare i controlli sulla <ship>, pronto a partire appena il carico avrà finito di scaricare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 13|name|503|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 13|description|504|0
units.english: You have been informed that Prefect Chilia would like to meet with you on <destination>.
units.italian: Ti è stato comunicato che il Prefetto Chilia vorrebbe incontrarti su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 14|name|515|0
units.english: Investigate strange sensor readings
units.italian: Indaga su strane letture dei sensori

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 14|description|516|0
units.english: Long range sensors have picked up strange gravitational waves. Go investigate, then return to <destination>.
units.italian: I sensori a lungo raggio hanno captato strane onde gravitazionali. Vai a indagare, poi torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 14|You land by the starport and are immediately accosted by a Remnant who informs you that Prefect Chilia is on his personal warship and escorts you to a nearby Starling. Inside you find Chilia and several other Remnant clustered around a holographic display and some display panels. "Ah, Captain. Join us, please." Chilia gestures for you to join them around the displays. As you approach, you note that the holographic display shows the Ember Waste, although there are a few details that do not match the star maps you're familiar with.|524|0
units.english: You land by the starport and are immediately accosted by a Remnant who informs you that Prefect Chilia is on his personal warship and escorts you to a nearby Starling. Inside you find Chilia and several other Remnant clustered around a holographic display and some display panels. "Ah, Captain. Join us, please." Chilia gestures for you to join them around the displays. As you approach, you note that the holographic display shows the Ember Waste, although there are a few details that do not match the star maps you're familiar with.
units.italian: Atterri vicino allo spazioporto e vieni subito avvicinato da un Remnant che ti informa che il Prefetto Chilia è sulla sua nave da guerra personale e ti accompagna a uno Starling lì vicino. Dentro trovi Chilia e diversi altri Remnant riuniti intorno a un display olografico e ad alcuni pannelli di controllo. "Ah, capitano. Unisciti a noi, prego." Chilia ti fa cenno di raggiungerli intorno ai display. Mentre ti avvicini, noti che il display olografico mostra la Distesa di Braci, anche se ci sono alcuni dettagli che non corrispondono alle mappe stellari che conosci.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 14|	Chilia notices you eyeing the deviations. "Perceptive, Captain. Our sensors have reported some unusual energy signatures coming from this location. Scouts in the area say they are picking up signs of a new system. There were no immediately apparent hyperlinks or wormholes that connect to it, but there are still unusual energy fluctuations in the area. Unusual even for the Ember Waste." He looks up at you. "We are hoping that you might be able to figure out a way in."|525|0
units.english: Chilia notices you eyeing the deviations. "Perceptive, Captain. Our sensors have reported some unusual energy signatures coming from this location. Scouts in the area say they are picking up signs of a new system. There were no immediately apparent hyperlinks or wormholes that connect to it, but there are still unusual energy fluctuations in the area. Unusual even for the Ember Waste." He looks up at you. "We are hoping that you might be able to figure out a way in."
units.italian: Chilia nota che stai osservando le anomalie. "Perspicace, capitano. I nostri sensori hanno riportato insolite firme energetiche provenienti da questa posizione. Le sonde della zona dicono di captare segni di un nuovo sistema. Non c'erano collegamenti iper o cunicoli immediatamente evidenti che vi portassero, ma nella zona ci sono ancora fluttuazioni energetiche insolite. Insolite anche per la Distesa di Braci." Alza lo sguardo su di te. "Speriamo che tu possa trovare un modo per entrare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 14|	"I could see if I can reach it with a jump drive."|527|0
units.english: "I could see if I can reach it with a jump drive."
units.italian: "Potrei vedere se riesco a raggiungerlo con un motore di salto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 14|	"I will see if I can find another way."|528|0
units.english: "I will see if I can find another way."
units.italian: "Vedrò se riesco a trovare un'altra via."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 14|	"Thank you, Captain <first>. We have some ships that can follow, and there are other scouts already in the area that should be reporting soon. Given your experience with the wider galaxy, though, we would like you to lead the way."|529|0
units.english: "Thank you, Captain <first>. We have some ships that can follow, and there are other scouts already in the area that should be reporting soon. Given your experience with the wider galaxy, though, we would like you to lead the way."
units.italian: "Grazie, capitano <first>. Abbiamo alcune navi che possono seguirci, e ci sono altre sonde nella zona che dovrebbero riferire presto. Data la tua esperienza con la galassia in generale, però, vorremmo che aprissi la strada."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 14|As your ship's sensors re-establish their depiction of the system around you, an alien space station comes into view. It appears to be old and mostly inactive, but your sensors do pick up occasional bursts of energy - and, oddly, faint signs of life almost everywhere.|533|0
units.english: As your ship's sensors re-establish their depiction of the system around you, an alien space station comes into view. It appears to be old and mostly inactive, but your sensors do pick up occasional bursts of energy - and, oddly, faint signs of life almost everywhere.
units.italian: Mentre i sensori della nave ristabiliscono la loro rappresentazione del sistema intorno a te, una stazione spaziale aliena entra nel campo visivo. Sembra vecchia e in gran parte inattiva, ma i sensori captano raffiche di energia occasionali e, stranamente, deboli segni di vita quasi ovunque.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 14|Surprisingly, the station is still operational, despite its apparent age. Ancient environmental systems maintain a breathable atmosphere, although it is thinner than you find comfortable. Likewise, the air is cool - but not dangerously so. Everywhere you look, you continually feel like you have stumbled upon a space station built by giants: doors are massive, controls are placed at head height, and displays seem to be angled for a being significantly taller than you. Most unusually, larger rooms often have what look to be benches and tables placed halfway up walls.|536|0
units.english: Surprisingly, the station is still operational, despite its apparent age. Ancient environmental systems maintain a breathable atmosphere, although it is thinner than you find comfortable. Likewise, the air is cool - but not dangerously so. Everywhere you look, you continually feel like you have stumbled upon a space station built by giants: doors are massive, controls are placed at head height, and displays seem to be angled for a being significantly taller than you. Most unusually, larger rooms often have what look to be benches and tables placed halfway up walls.
units.italian: Sorprendentemente, la stazione è ancora operativa, nonostante l'età evidente. Antichi sistemi ambientali mantengono un'atmosfera respirabile, anche se più rarefatta di quanto trovi confortevole. Allo stesso modo l'aria è fresca, ma non pericolosamente. Ovunque guardi, continui ad avere la sensazione di esserti imbattuto in una stazione spaziale costruita da giganti: le porte sono enormi, i comandi sono all'altezza della testa e i display sembrano inclinati per un essere molto più alto di te. Cosa più insolita di tutte, le stanze più grandi hanno spesso quelle che sembrano panche e tavoli a metà parete.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 14|	The engineering of the station points to a dedicated construction program aimed at a single purpose. You trace some of the more obvious sets of cables and discover a large spherical chamber in the station's core filled with arcane machinery. It emits significant amounts of unknown energy - enough that your suit's medical systems emphatically warn you to turn back. While the devices appear to be central to this station's purpose, they will have to remain a mystery for now. Clearly, this is the sort of thing that the Remnant sent you out to find, and they will want to know about it as soon as possible.|537|0
units.english: The engineering of the station points to a dedicated construction program aimed at a single purpose. You trace some of the more obvious sets of cables and discover a large spherical chamber in the station's core filled with arcane machinery. It emits significant amounts of unknown energy - enough that your suit's medical systems emphatically warn you to turn back. While the devices appear to be central to this station's purpose, they will have to remain a mystery for now. Clearly, this is the sort of thing that the Remnant sent you out to find, and they will want to know about it as soon as possible.
units.italian: L'ingegneria della stazione indica un programma di costruzione dedicato a un unico scopo. Segui alcuni dei gruppi di cavi più evidenti e scopri una grande camera sferica nel nucleo della stazione, piena di macchinari arcani. Emette quantità notevoli di energia sconosciuta, abbastanza che i sistemi medici della tuta ti avvertono con enfasi di tornare indietro. Anche se i dispositivi sembrano centrali nello scopo della stazione, per ora dovranno restare un mistero. È chiaro che questo è il genere di cosa per cui i Remnant ti hanno mandato, e vorranno saperlo il prima possibile.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 14|As you arrive back at Viminal, you broadcast a warning to the port authorities that something is following you. You inform them that it is not hostile, but it is an unknown entity that originated in the new system.|540|0
units.english: As you arrive back at Viminal, you broadcast a warning to the port authorities that something is following you. You inform them that it is not hostile, but it is an unknown entity that originated in the new system.
units.italian: Quando arrivi di nuovo a Viminal, lanci un avviso alle autorità del porto che qualcosa ti sta seguendo. Le informi che non è ostile, ma è un'entità sconosciuta proveniente dal nuovo sistema.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 16|name|561|0
units.english: Follow the Creature
units.italian: Segui la creatura

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 16|description|562|0
units.english: The creature seems to be creating constellations and trying to get you to follow it.
units.italian: La creatura sembra creare costellazioni e cercare di farti capire che devi seguirla.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 16|Quite a number of Remnant have gathered around the spaceport watching the movements of the strange creature. It gestures wildly in various ways, then freezes in several different positions with the tips of certain tentacles glowing with energy. You note that several anti-air batteries around the area have their formidable-looking weapons trained on the creature in case it turns violent.|571|0
units.english: Quite a number of Remnant have gathered around the spaceport watching the movements of the strange creature. It gestures wildly in various ways, then freezes in several different positions with the tips of certain tentacles glowing with energy. You note that several anti-air batteries around the area have their formidable-looking weapons trained on the creature in case it turns violent.
units.italian: Un buon numero di Remnant si è radunato intorno allo spazioporto a guardare i movimenti della strana creatura. Gesticola freneticamente in vari modi, poi si blocca in diverse posizioni con le punte di alcuni tentacoli che brillano di energia. Noti che diverse batterie antiaeree della zona hanno le loro armi dall'aspetto formidabile puntate sulla creatura, nel caso diventi violenta.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 16|	After several hours of watching the creature, one captain pushes his way forward to where you, Chilia, and Plume are talking. "I think I have an idea about this thing, Prefect!" the man signs excitedly. "Look at the positions of the glowing tips when it freezes. That pattern there matches the star positions of the main Ember Waste systems when viewed from Peragenor, and that second matches Convector." He pulls out a datapad and pulls up a projection of the starmap. "It is hard to tell due to the imprecision, but it looks like the third freeze is probably Antevorta or Nenia."|572|0
units.english: After several hours of watching the creature, one captain pushes his way forward to where you, Chilia, and Plume are talking. "I think I have an idea about this thing, Prefect!" the man signs excitedly. "Look at the positions of the glowing tips when it freezes. That pattern there matches the star positions of the main Ember Waste systems when viewed from Peragenor, and that second matches Convector." He pulls out a datapad and pulls up a projection of the starmap. "It is hard to tell due to the imprecision, but it looks like the third freeze is probably Antevorta or Nenia."
units.italian: Dopo diverse ore passate a osservare la creatura, un capitano si fa largo fino al punto in cui tu, Chilia e Plume state parlando. "Credo di avere un'idea su questa cosa, prefetto!" segna l'uomo con eccitazione. "Guarda le posizioni delle punte luminose quando si blocca. Quello schema lì corrisponde alle posizioni stellari dei principali sistemi della Distesa di Braci viste da Peragenor, e il secondo corrisponde a Convector." Tira fuori un datapad e apre una proiezione della mappa stellare. "È difficile dirlo per l'imprecisione, ma sembra che il terzo blocco sia probabilmente Antevorta o Nenia."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 16|	Plume chimes in, "If those freezes indicate star positions, then the flying and landing behavior in between them may be indicating that it wants you to travel there. Please give it a try. Make sure to take a 'gaslined' ship; if the third system is Nenia, it may want you to enter the gas giants."|573|0
units.english: Plume chimes in, "If those freezes indicate star positions, then the flying and landing behavior in between them may be indicating that it wants you to travel there. Please give it a try. Make sure to take a 'gaslined' ship; if the third system is Nenia, it may want you to enter the gas giants."
units.italian: Plume interviene: "Se quei blocchi indicano posizioni stellari, allora il volo e l'atterraggio in mezzo potrebbero indicare che vuole che tu vada lì. Per favore, prova. Assicurati di prendere una nave 'con rivestimento per gas'; se il terzo sistema è Nenia, potrebbe volere che entri nei giganti gassosi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 16|dialog|580|0
units.english: The creature comes to a stop in front of you, spins around briefly, then spreads out its tentacles in another pattern. Following the Remnant's intuition, you match it to your star charts as probably being Convector. After holding the position for a minute, the creature realigns itself and starts to shimmer with the tell-tale signs of starting to make a jump, but it holds it, as if waiting for you.
units.italian: La creatura si ferma davanti a te, ruota brevemente su se stessa, poi distende i tentacoli in un altro schema. Seguendo l'intuizione dei Remnant, lo confronti con le tue carte stellari e risulta probabilmente Convector. Dopo aver tenuto la posizione per un minuto, la creatura si riallinea e comincia a tremolare dei segni tipici dell'inizio di un salto, ma si trattiene, come se ti aspettasse.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 16|dialog|582|0
units.english: It seems the analysis of the location was right. The creature quickly approaches you and repeats its previous dance, ending up with a slightly different frozen position. From this vantage, you suspect that it is probably Nenia. This time, as you watch it more closely, it looks like it is following in your wake somehow.
units.italian: Sembra che l'analisi della posizione fosse giusta. La creatura ti si avvicina in fretta e ripete la sua danza di prima, fermandosi in una posizione leggermente diversa. Da questa prospettiva sospetti che sia probabilmente Nenia. Questa volta, guardandola più da vicino, sembra che in qualche modo segua la tua scia.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 16|dialog|584|0
units.english: You have never seen such activity from the void sprites. Many quickly congregate around the strange creature that has been guiding you, and escort it to Nasqueron. It seems like that is where it wanted to be. In the distance, you can see the Archon methodically pulverizing a Palavret.
units.italian: Non hai mai visto un'attività simile da parte degli spettri del vuoto. Molti si radunano in fretta intorno alla strana creatura che ti ha guidato e la scortano su Nasqueron. Sembra che fosse lì che voleva andare. In lontananza vedi l'Archon che polverizza metodicamente un Palavret.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 17|name|590|0
units.english: Report back to <planet>
units.italian: Riferisci su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 17|description|591|0
units.english: The Remnant will want to know about what happened on Nasqueron.
units.italian: I Remnant vorranno sapere cosa è successo su Nasqueron.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 17|You follow the creature down through the clouds of Nasqueron and emerge into what can only be described as an amphitheater in the clouds. Thousands of void sprites fill the area, and the creature you have been following floats near the center of it. Your external sensors pick up myriad pulses of energy and eerie whistling noises that seem to resonate in the clouds. As the <ship> moves forward, there is a sudden silence, and the flickers of energy synchronize.|600|0
units.english: You follow the creature down through the clouds of Nasqueron and emerge into what can only be described as an amphitheater in the clouds. Thousands of void sprites fill the area, and the creature you have been following floats near the center of it. Your external sensors pick up myriad pulses of energy and eerie whistling noises that seem to resonate in the clouds. As the <ship> moves forward, there is a sudden silence, and the flickers of energy synchronize.
units.italian: Segui la creatura giù tra le nuvole di Nasqueron ed emergi in quello che si può solo descrivere come un anfiteatro tra le nuvole. Migliaia di spettri del vuoto riempiono l'area, e la creatura che hai seguito fluttua vicino al centro. I sensori esterni captano miriadi di impulsi di energia e strani fischi che sembrano risuonare nelle nuvole. Mentre la <ship> avanza, cala un silenzio improvviso e i guizzi di energia si sincronizzano.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 17|	You feel a sudden pressure in your mind and a sense of presence as the world around you fades out somewhat.|601|0
units.english: You feel a sudden pressure in your mind and a sense of presence as the world around you fades out somewhat.
units.italian: Senti una pressione improvvisa nella mente e una sensazione di presenza, mentre il mondo intorno a te sfuma un po'.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 17|	"Know you not, do I. Live creature inside not-quite creature, like ones who flew but not everywhere." You are momentarily disoriented as you look around and see hundreds of views of yourself peering out the cockpit window. "Your intention reverberates - Know and not know - Return with more echoes - Perhaps I shall hear."|602|0
units.english: "Know you not, do I. Live creature inside not-quite creature, like ones who flew but not everywhere." You are momentarily disoriented as you look around and see hundreds of views of yourself peering out the cockpit window. "Your intention reverberates - Know and not know - Return with more echoes - Perhaps I shall hear."
units.italian: "Non conoscere te, io. Creatura viva dentro non-proprio creatura, come quelli che volavano ma non ovunque." Resti momentaneamente disorientato mentre ti guardi intorno e vedi centinaia di immagini di te che spiano fuori dal finestrino dell'abitacolo. "La tua intenzione risuona - Sapere e non sapere - Tornare con più echi - Forse udrò."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 17|	With that, the pressure vanishes, and you are left staring out the window at the rapidly dispersing flock of void sprites. You aren't entirely sure what the voice meant, but you are certain that the Remnant are going to want to hear about this.|603|0
units.english: With that, the pressure vanishes, and you are left staring out the window at the rapidly dispersing flock of void sprites. You aren't entirely sure what the voice meant, but you are certain that the Remnant are going to want to hear about this.
units.italian: Detto questo, la pressione svanisce e resti a fissare dal finestrino lo stormo di spettri del vuoto che si disperde rapidamente. Non sei del tutto sicuro di cosa volesse dire la voce, ma sei certo che i Remnant vorranno saperlo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|name|609|0
units.english: Collect void sprites
units.italian: Raccogli gli spettri del vuoto

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|description|610|0
units.english: Escort the Pelican fleet to <waypoints> and back to <planet>.
units.italian: Scorta la flotta di Pelican fino a <waypoints> e ritorno a <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|It is almost starting to feel commonplace to have Remnant pouncing on your ship and using your bridge as a meeting room. This time, it is Prefect Chilia and Plume who seem to appear out of nowhere requesting permission to board. The two gather around your console to watch the recording of your trip. They nod at your narration of what transpired and focus intently when you describe the strange presence in your mind. When you finish recounting your experience, they lean back in thought.|618|0
units.english: It is almost starting to feel commonplace to have Remnant pouncing on your ship and using your bridge as a meeting room. This time, it is Prefect Chilia and Plume who seem to appear out of nowhere requesting permission to board. The two gather around your console to watch the recording of your trip. They nod at your narration of what transpired and focus intently when you describe the strange presence in your mind. When you finish recounting your experience, they lean back in thought.
units.italian: Comincia quasi a sembrarti normale che i Remnant piombino sulla tua nave e usino il tuo ponte come sala riunioni. Questa volta sono il Prefetto Chilia e Plume a comparire dal nulla chiedendo il permesso di salire a bordo. I due si radunano intorno alla tua console a guardare la registrazione del viaggio. Annuiscono al tuo racconto di quello che è successo e si concentrano intensamente quando descrivi la strana presenza nella tua mente. Quando finisci di raccontare la tua esperienza, si appoggiano indietro a riflettere.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|	"Captain <first>, the exact meaning is unclear, but it seems to be the voice of something not accustomed to speaking to us or creatures like us," signs Prefect Chilia. "While interesting, I think we should move forward with our plan and continue investigating this later." Plume reluctantly signs his agreement as Chilia continues. "Best case scenario, we can deprive the Korath of easy access to the void sprites. Worst case scenario, we can move enough that should the Korath hunt them to extinction in Nenia, they will continue to exist in our territory."|619|0
units.english: "Captain <first>, the exact meaning is unclear, but it seems to be the voice of something not accustomed to speaking to us or creatures like us," signs Prefect Chilia. "While interesting, I think we should move forward with our plan and continue investigating this later." Plume reluctantly signs his agreement as Chilia continues. "Best case scenario, we can deprive the Korath of easy access to the void sprites. Worst case scenario, we can move enough that should the Korath hunt them to extinction in Nenia, they will continue to exist in our territory."
units.italian: "Capitano <first>, il significato esatto non è chiaro, ma sembra la voce di qualcosa che non è abituato a parlare con noi o con creature come noi," segna il Prefetto Chilia. "Per quanto interessante, credo che dovremmo andare avanti con il nostro piano e continuare a indagare più tardi." Plume acconsente a malincuore mentre Chilia continua. "Nel migliore dei casi, possiamo togliere ai Korath un facile accesso agli spettri del vuoto. Nel peggiore, possiamo spostarne abbastanza che, se i Korath li cacciassero fino all'estinzione a Nenia, continuerebbero a esistere nel nostro territorio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|	Plume signals his cautious agreement. "This message is intriguing, but I agree it should not be our first priority. That being said, I will plan for additional investigations after we have completed this initial operation."|620|0
units.english: Plume signals his cautious agreement. "This message is intriguing, but I agree it should not be our first priority. That being said, I will plan for additional investigations after we have completed this initial operation."
units.italian: Plume segnala il suo cauto assenso. "Questo messaggio è intrigante, ma concordo che non debba essere la nostra prima priorità. Detto questo, programmerò altre indagini dopo aver completato questa operazione iniziale."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|	The two look at you, and Chilia authoritatively signs, "We are evacuating a large group of void sprites from Nenia to Esquiline. The atmospheres are largely a match, and we have reconfigured the station to provide the nutrients that aren't otherwise present. We have a fleet of Pelicans that have basically been hollowed out so we can lure as many void sprites into it as we can."|621|0
units.english: The two look at you, and Chilia authoritatively signs, "We are evacuating a large group of void sprites from Nenia to Esquiline. The atmospheres are largely a match, and we have reconfigured the station to provide the nutrients that aren't otherwise present. We have a fleet of Pelicans that have basically been hollowed out so we can lure as many void sprites into it as we can."
units.italian: I due ti guardano, e Chilia segna con autorità: "Stiamo evacuando un grande gruppo di spettri del vuoto da Nenia a Esquiline. Le atmosfere corrispondono in gran parte, e abbiamo riconfigurato la stazione per fornire i nutrienti che altrimenti mancano. Abbiamo una flotta di Pelican che sono stati praticamente svuotati, così possiamo attirare dentro quanti più spettri del vuoto possibile."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|	"How are we supposed to lure them inside?"|623|0
units.english: "How are we supposed to lure them inside?"
units.italian: "E come dovremmo attirarli dentro?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|	"Are we sure this is a good idea?"|624|0
units.english: "Are we sure this is a good idea?"
units.italian: "Siamo sicuri che sia una buona idea?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|	"Okay, let's go do this."|626|0
units.english: "Okay, let's go do this."
units.italian: "Va bene, facciamolo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|	Plume looks a bit embarrassed. "When we first studied the void sprites centuries ago, we learned how to harvest them. As part of that, we discovered that they were particularly interested in certain types of radiation. Likewise, if they discovered a certain kind of element common in some asteroids, they would ignore almost everything while they chewed on it. So, we have emitters inside the cargo holds along with asteroids to keep them busy for a short while."|628|0
units.english: Plume looks a bit embarrassed. "When we first studied the void sprites centuries ago, we learned how to harvest them. As part of that, we discovered that they were particularly interested in certain types of radiation. Likewise, if they discovered a certain kind of element common in some asteroids, they would ignore almost everything while they chewed on it. So, we have emitters inside the cargo holds along with asteroids to keep them busy for a short while."
units.italian: Plume sembra un po' in imbarazzo. "Quando abbiamo studiato gli spettri del vuoto secoli fa, abbiamo imparato a raccoglierli. Come parte di quel lavoro, abbiamo scoperto che erano particolarmente interessati a certi tipi di radiazione. Allo stesso modo, se trovavano un certo elemento comune in alcuni asteroidi, ignoravano quasi tutto il resto mentre lo masticavano. Quindi abbiamo emettitori nelle stive insieme agli asteroidi, per tenerli occupati per un po'."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|	"Are we sure this is a good idea?"|630|0
units.english: "Are we sure this is a good idea?"
units.italian: "Siamo sicuri che sia una buona idea?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|	"Okay, let's go."|631|0
units.english: "Okay, let's go."
units.italian: "Va bene, andiamo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|label|633|0
units.english: good idea
units.italian: good idea

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|	Chilia signs with a resolute tone. "Is it a good idea? Maybe, maybe not. Is it the best idea we have so far? Yes." He sighs. "I fully expect the Archon to interfere: they do have long memories. As best we can tell, they can pick out who is leading a fleet, so you should expect them to talk to you. That is, if they do not simply start shooting, anyway."|634|0
units.english: Chilia signs with a resolute tone. "Is it a good idea? Maybe, maybe not. Is it the best idea we have so far? Yes." He sighs. "I fully expect the Archon to interfere: they do have long memories. As best we can tell, they can pick out who is leading a fleet, so you should expect them to talk to you. That is, if they do not simply start shooting, anyway."
units.italian: Chilia segna con tono risoluto. "È una buona idea? Forse sì, forse no. È la migliore idea che abbiamo finora? Sì." Sospira. "Mi aspetto pienamente che l'Archon interferisca: hanno davvero una lunga memoria. Per quanto possiamo capire, riescono a distinguere chi guida una flotta, quindi aspettati che parlino con te. Sempre che non comincino semplicemente a sparare, comunque."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|label|635|0
units.english: lets go
units.italian: lets go

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|	Chilia continues. "You don't need to actually land anywhere in Nenia this time, Captain. Just make sure the Pelicans get there, load up, and return safely." The two stand up and get ready to leave. "May the Embers burn bright for you, Captain." With that, they disembark and quickly clear the blast area around the landing pad. Around you a large group of Pelicans are warming up, each one synchronizing to your IFF and confirming their status.|636|0
units.english: Chilia continues. "You don't need to actually land anywhere in Nenia this time, Captain. Just make sure the Pelicans get there, load up, and return safely." The two stand up and get ready to leave. "May the Embers burn bright for you, Captain." With that, they disembark and quickly clear the blast area around the landing pad. Around you a large group of Pelicans are warming up, each one synchronizing to your IFF and confirming their status.
units.italian: Chilia continua. "Questa volta non devi atterrare da nessuna parte a Nenia, capitano. Assicurati solo che i Pelican arrivino, carichino e tornino sani e salvi." I due si alzano e si preparano a uscire. "Che le Braci brucino luminose per te, capitano." Detto questo, sbarcano e sgombrano in fretta l'area di scarico intorno alla piazzola. Intorno a te un grande gruppo di Pelican si sta scaldando, ognuno si sincronizza con il tuo IFF e conferma il proprio stato.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|dialog|662|0
units.english: As you enter the system, you quickly search for the Archon, but it is nowhere to be seen. A Korath hunting party, however, is clearly waiting for you and moves to attack. As their ships converge on you, the Pelicans immediately set to work collecting void sprites. As the last one closes its hold, the confirmation codes flash across your tactical screen. "Good to go."
units.italian: Appena entri nel sistema cerchi subito l'Archon, ma non si vede da nessuna parte. Una squadra di caccia Korath, però, ti sta chiaramente aspettando e si muove all'attacco. Mentre le loro navi convergono su di te, i Pelican si mettono subito al lavoro a raccogliere spettri del vuoto. Quando l'ultimo chiude la stiva, i codici di conferma lampeggiano sul tuo schermo tattico. "Pronti a partire."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|log|666|0
units.english: Successfully introduced a flock of void sprites to Esquiline. Time will tell how they fare.
units.italian: Ho introdotto con successo uno stormo di spettri del vuoto a Esquiline. Il tempo dirà come se la caveranno.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|Moments later a ping comes in on the commlink, and Prefect Chilia appears on screen accompanied by Plume. Plume gestures first. "Thank you for your work, Captain. It is unclear what the results of this effort will be, but for now, we wait and see. Hopefully the void sprites settle in," he concludes.|672|0
units.english: Moments later a ping comes in on the commlink, and Prefect Chilia appears on screen accompanied by Plume. Plume gestures first. "Thank you for your work, Captain. It is unclear what the results of this effort will be, but for now, we wait and see. Hopefully the void sprites settle in," he concludes.
units.italian: Pochi istanti dopo arriva un segnale sul commlink, e sullo schermo appare il Prefetto Chilia insieme a Plume. Plume gesticola per primo. "Grazie per il tuo lavoro, capitano. Non è chiaro quali saranno i risultati di questo sforzo, ma per ora aspettiamo e vediamo. Speriamo che gli spettri del vuoto si stabiliscano," conclude.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18|	"In the meantime," continues Chilia, "We are allocating you a daily stipend from our resources to cover some of your ongoing crew, maintenance, and upgrading costs. A larger one-time allotment has already been credited to your account with the shipyard facilities to help cover costs incurred during this mission."|673|0
units.english: "In the meantime," continues Chilia, "We are allocating you a daily stipend from our resources to cover some of your ongoing crew, maintenance, and upgrading costs. A larger one-time allotment has already been credited to your account with the shipyard facilities to help cover costs incurred during this mission."
units.italian: "Nel frattempo," continua Chilia, "ti stiamo assegnando uno stipendio giornaliero dalle nostre risorse per coprire parte dei costi continui di equipaggio, manutenzione e potenziamenti. Un'assegnazione una tantum più consistente è già stata accreditata sul tuo conto presso i cantieri navali, per aiutarti a coprire le spese sostenute durante questa missione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 18B|dialog|687|0
units.english: You watch vigilantly as the Pelicans with the void sprites dip low into Esquiline's atmosphere and open their bay doors. The void sprites emerge tentatively, then confidently launch themselves into the clouds. A few minutes later, you receive a message from Esquiline station informing you that the first void sprite just swooped through the bay, grabbed one of the asteroid supplements, and vanished into the clouds again.
units.italian: Osservi vigile mentre i Pelican con gli spettri del vuoto scendono in picchiata nell'atmosfera di Esquiline e aprono le porte delle stive. Gli spettri del vuoto escono con cautela, poi si lanciano con decisione tra le nuvole. Pochi minuti dopo ricevi un messaggio dalla stazione di Esquiline che ti informa che il primo spettro del vuoto ha appena attraversato in volo la baia, ha afferrato uno degli asteroidi supplementari ed è svanito di nuovo tra le nuvole.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 19|name|693|0
units.english: Deliver navigation data
units.italian: Consegna i dati di navigazione

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 19|description|694|0
units.english: Deliver navigational data on the new systems to <destination>.
units.italian: Consegna i dati di navigazione sui nuovi sistemi su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 19|As you finish your landing checks, your commlink notifies you of an incoming message from Dawn:|707|0
units.english: As you finish your landing checks, your commlink notifies you of an incoming message from Dawn:
units.italian: Mentre finisci i controlli di atterraggio, il commlink ti avvisa di un messaggio in arrivo da Dawn:

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 19|	"Greetings, Captain <first>! We will be compiling updated navigational charts for the new systems and would like a fresh copy of the data your nav system recorded. We are hoping to retrieve some additional data that is not routinely downloaded by the automated starport systems. Stop by <planet>, and the starport systems will copy the data during the systems check. It's a pretty small data set, so there's no need to use data crystals. Thank you!"|708|0
units.english: "Greetings, Captain <first>! We will be compiling updated navigational charts for the new systems and would like a fresh copy of the data your nav system recorded. We are hoping to retrieve some additional data that is not routinely downloaded by the automated starport systems. Stop by <planet>, and the starport systems will copy the data during the systems check. It's a pretty small data set, so there's no need to use data crystals. Thank you!"
units.italian: "Salve, capitano <first>! Stiamo compilando carte di navigazione aggiornate per i nuovi sistemi e vorremmo una copia fresca dei dati registrati dal tuo sistema di navigazione. Speriamo di recuperare qualche dato aggiuntivo che i sistemi automatizzati degli spazioporti non scaricano di routine. Passa da <planet> e i sistemi dello spazioporto copieranno i dati durante il controllo dei sistemi. È un insieme di dati piuttosto piccolo, quindi non serve usare cristalli di dati. Grazie!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 19|	The end of the message is the location of a starport on <planet>, presumably where you are supposed to go.|709|0
units.english: The end of the message is the location of a starport on <planet>, presumably where you are supposed to go.
units.italian: La fine del messaggio contiene la posizione di uno spazioporto su <planet>, presumibilmente dove dovresti andare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 19|dialog|714|0
units.english: As the starport computer downloads the data, your computer displays a message tacked onto the log file: "Thank you for providing the additional data from your navigational logs. It will be useful to contrast against those of our scouts. A logistics adjustment of <payment> has been authorized for the <ship>."
units.italian: Mentre il computer dello spazioporto scarica i dati, il tuo computer mostra un messaggio aggiunto in coda al file di registro: "Grazie per aver fornito i dati aggiuntivi dai tuoi registri di navigazione. Saranno utili da confrontare con quelli delle nostre sonde. È stato autorizzato un adeguamento logistico di <payment> per la <ship>."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|name|719|0
units.english: Preparation for expedition
units.italian: Preparativi per la spedizione

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|description|720|0
units.english: Install a Research Laboratory, retrieve equipment from <stopovers>, then bring it to <destination>.
units.italian: Installa un Laboratorio di Ricerca, recupera l'attrezzatura su <stopovers>, poi portala su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|blocked|727|0
units.english: You need 10 free cargo space for this mission.
units.italian: Per questa missione ti servono 10 unità di spazio nel carico.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|The crowd inside the spaceport cafeteria is an excited flurry of movement. You squeeze through a gap in the crowd to discover that they are gathered around a holoprojector displaying footage of the strange creature that recently followed you to Viminal and then on to Nenia. From the snippets of conversation that you catch, it appears that they are discussing theories about it. Almost as soon as you arrive, however, the gestures still and one of the Remnant gestures to you. "Greetings, Seeker. You are the one who found this creature. Since you traveled with it, could you share more recordings of it?"|734|0
units.english: The crowd inside the spaceport cafeteria is an excited flurry of movement. You squeeze through a gap in the crowd to discover that they are gathered around a holoprojector displaying footage of the strange creature that recently followed you to Viminal and then on to Nenia. From the snippets of conversation that you catch, it appears that they are discussing theories about it. Almost as soon as you arrive, however, the gestures still and one of the Remnant gestures to you. "Greetings, Seeker. You are the one who found this creature. Since you traveled with it, could you share more recordings of it?"
units.italian: La folla nella mensa dello spazioporto è un turbinio eccitato di movimento. Ti fai largo in uno spazio tra la gente e scopri che sono riuniti intorno a un ologettore che mostra filmati della strana creatura che di recente ti ha seguito fino a Viminal e poi a Nenia. Dai frammenti di conversazione che cogli, sembra che stiano discutendo teorie al riguardo. Quasi appena arrivi, però, i gesti si fermano e uno dei Remnant ti fa cenno. "Salve, Cercatore. Sei tu che hai trovato questa creatura. Dato che hai viaggiato con lei, potresti condividere altre registrazioni?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"Definitely."|736|0
units.english: "Definitely."
units.italian: "Assolutamente."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"Maybe later."|737|0
units.english: "Maybe later."
units.italian: "Forse più tardi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	A few commands on your commlink later, and recordings your ship automatically made from its sensors while in flight pop up on a second projector. Several others pull up their commlinks and start skimming over the attached sensor logs. Almost immediately, one waves to get everyone's attention.|739|0
units.english: A few commands on your commlink later, and recordings your ship automatically made from its sensors while in flight pop up on a second projector. Several others pull up their commlinks and start skimming over the attached sensor logs. Almost immediately, one waves to get everyone's attention.
units.italian: Pochi comandi sul commlink dopo, e le registrazioni che la tua nave ha fatto automaticamente con i sensori durante il volo appaiono su un secondo proiettore. Diversi altri aprono i loro commlink e cominciano a scorrere i registri dei sensori allegati. Quasi subito uno fa un gesto per attirare l'attenzione di tutti.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"Captain, was there anything unusual when you arrived there?"|740|0
units.english: "Captain, was there anything unusual when you arrived there?"
units.italian: "Capitano, c'era qualcosa di insolito quando sei arrivato lì?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"Yes, sensors reported life signs."|742|0
units.english: "Yes, sensors reported life signs."
units.italian: "Sì, i sensori hanno riportato segni di vita."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"I don't remember. Did you notice something?"|743|0
units.english: "I don't remember. Did you notice something?"
units.italian: "Non ricordo. Hai notato qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	One of the Remnant pulls up the relevant section and puts it up on the projector. "Right here, the logs show that there are ambient life-signs all over the system, but nothing of significance shows up on the physical scanners." He frowns at the projector. "All the equipment status signals in the records are nominal, and both the check digits and data hashes match."|744|0
units.english: One of the Remnant pulls up the relevant section and puts it up on the projector. "Right here, the logs show that there are ambient life-signs all over the system, but nothing of significance shows up on the physical scanners." He frowns at the projector. "All the equipment status signals in the records are nominal, and both the check digits and data hashes match."
units.italian: Uno dei Remnant apre la sezione pertinente e la proietta. "Proprio qui, i registri mostrano che ci sono segni di vita ambientale in tutto il sistema, ma niente di significativo compare sugli scanner fisici." Aggrotta la fronte verso il proiettore. "Tutti i segnali di stato delle apparecchiature nei registri sono nella norma, e sia le cifre di controllo sia gli hash dei dati coincidono."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"So there are no problems with the data?"|746|0
units.english: "So there are no problems with the data?"
units.italian: "Quindi non ci sono problemi con i dati?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"Skip the technical jargon. What does it mean?"|747|0
units.english: "Skip the technical jargon. What does it mean?"
units.italian: "Salta il gergo tecnico. Che cosa significa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	Another Remnant nods. "Exactly. There is no problem with the data or the equipment, so one way or another, this is what it recorded. As such, either there is something here which we have never seen before, or there is something causing problems with conventional sensors." He looks around at the gathered Remnant and pauses as if focusing on something you cannot see or hear, then turns to you. "We have reached a consensus.|749|0
units.english: Another Remnant nods. "Exactly. There is no problem with the data or the equipment, so one way or another, this is what it recorded. As such, either there is something here which we have never seen before, or there is something causing problems with conventional sensors." He looks around at the gathered Remnant and pauses as if focusing on something you cannot see or hear, then turns to you. "We have reached a consensus.
units.italian: Un altro Remnant annuisce. "Esatto. Non c'è nessun problema con i dati o con le apparecchiature, quindi in un modo o nell'altro è quello che ha registrato. Perciò, o c'è qualcosa qui che non abbiamo mai visto prima, o c'è qualcosa che crea problemi ai sensori convenzionali." Si guarda intorno verso i Remnant riuniti e si ferma come se si concentrasse su qualcosa che tu non puoi vedere né sentire, poi si volta verso di te. "Abbiamo raggiunto un consenso.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|label|751|0
units.english: skip tech
units.italian: skip tech

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	The Remnant pauses for a moment to adjust what they were about to say before continuing. "What it means is that there is no obvious explanation for why there would be life signs out there." They glance around at the rest of the gathered Remnant then back to you.|752|0
units.english: The Remnant pauses for a moment to adjust what they were about to say before continuing. "What it means is that there is no obvious explanation for why there would be life signs out there." They glance around at the rest of the gathered Remnant then back to you.
units.italian: Il Remnant si ferma un momento per aggiustare quello che stava per dire prima di continuare. "Il punto è che non c'è una spiegazione ovvia del perché ci sarebbero segni di vita là fuori." Si guarda intorno verso il resto dei Remnant riuniti, poi di nuovo verso di te.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|label|753|0
units.english: mission statement
units.italian: mission statement

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"We would like you to take a team of five researchers and their equipment to Ssil Vida. Can you do that?"|754|0
units.english: "We would like you to take a team of five researchers and their equipment to Ssil Vida. Can you do that?"
units.italian: "Vorremmo che portassi una squadra di cinque ricercatori e la loro attrezzatura su Ssil Vida. Puoi farlo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"That sounds reasonable."|756|0
units.english: "That sounds reasonable."
units.italian: "Mi sembra ragionevole."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"Not right now."|758|0
units.english: "Not right now."
units.italian: "Non adesso."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"You aren't a prefect. How can you make a decision like that?"|760|0
units.english: "You aren't a prefect. How can you make a decision like that?"
units.italian: "Non sei un prefetto. Come puoi prendere una decisione del genere?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	Before he can respond, another Remnant answers. "The Prefects are not the sole source of decisions. One could say that they are the 'executive' authority that can make on-the-spot decisions, whereas the Remnant as a whole makes what one might term 'legislative' decision making. The scope of our decisions as a group are limited based on the size of the group making the decision."|761|0
units.english: Before he can respond, another Remnant answers. "The Prefects are not the sole source of decisions. One could say that they are the 'executive' authority that can make on-the-spot decisions, whereas the Remnant as a whole makes what one might term 'legislative' decision making. The scope of our decisions as a group are limited based on the size of the group making the decision."
units.italian: Prima che possa rispondere, interviene un altro Remnant. "I prefetti non sono l'unica fonte di decisioni. Si potrebbe dire che siano l'autorità 'esecutiva' che può prendere decisioni sul momento, mentre i Remnant nel loro insieme esercitano una funzione decisionale che si potrebbe definire 'legislativa'. La portata delle nostre decisioni come gruppo è limitata in base alla dimensione del gruppo che decide."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"That makes sense."|763|0
units.english: "That makes sense."
units.italian: "Ha senso."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"Why do you need multiple methods of decision making?"|765|0
units.english: "Why do you need multiple methods of decision making?"
units.italian: "Perché vi servono più metodi decisionali?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"Because we are in the midst of war, and located in an actively hazardous part of the galaxy. We, as a people, need to make countless thousands of on-the-spot decisions every day. If we had to reach a consensus for every troop movement, expedition, or resource allocation we would be overwhelmed within days." She stops speaking, and another Remnant picks up the explanation.|766|0
units.english: "Because we are in the midst of war, and located in an actively hazardous part of the galaxy. We, as a people, need to make countless thousands of on-the-spot decisions every day. If we had to reach a consensus for every troop movement, expedition, or resource allocation we would be overwhelmed within days." She stops speaking, and another Remnant picks up the explanation.
units.italian: "Perché siamo in mezzo a una guerra e ci troviamo in una parte della galassia attivamente pericolosa. Noi, come popolo, dobbiamo prendere innumerevoli migliaia di decisioni sul momento ogni giorno. Se dovessimo raggiungere un consenso per ogni movimento di truppe, spedizione o assegnazione di risorse, saremmo sopraffatti in pochi giorni." Smette di parlare, e un altro Remnant riprende la spiegazione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"By the same token, prefects can be killed, or overloaded. Having as much decision making as possible handled by the Remnant as a group reduces our vulnerability to assassination strikes, and helps protect our prefects from burning out under the responsibility. On the flip side, it also protects our society from becoming an autocracy where one powerful person or small group makes all the decisions."|767|0
units.english: "By the same token, prefects can be killed, or overloaded. Having as much decision making as possible handled by the Remnant as a group reduces our vulnerability to assassination strikes, and helps protect our prefects from burning out under the responsibility. On the flip side, it also protects our society from becoming an autocracy where one powerful person or small group makes all the decisions."
units.italian: "Allo stesso modo, i prefetti possono essere uccisi o sovraccaricati. Affidare ai Remnant nel loro insieme quante più decisioni possibile riduce la nostra vulnerabilità ai colpi mirati e aiuta a proteggere i nostri prefetti dall'esaurirsi sotto il peso della responsabilità. D'altra parte, protegge anche la nostra società dal diventare un'autocrazia in cui una persona potente o un piccolo gruppo prende tutte le decisioni."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|label|768|0
units.english: mission choice
units.italian: mission choice

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	The Remnant become still and look at you. "So, will you take this mission?"|769|0
units.english: The Remnant become still and look at you. "So, will you take this mission?"
units.italian: I Remnant restano immobili e ti guardano. "Allora, prenderai questa missione?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"Yes."|771|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"Later."|772|0
units.english: "Later."
units.italian: "Più tardi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|label|774|0
units.english: take mission
units.italian: take mission

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"Excellent. We will load our equipment racks on-board, and the equipment to go in them will be waiting for you on pad D43A on <stopovers>. Once it is loaded, return here to pick up the team of researchers who will be going with you. Remember, you will need 5 bunks free as well as an on-board Research Laboratory to complement our equipment."|775|0
units.english: "Excellent. We will load our equipment racks on-board, and the equipment to go in them will be waiting for you on pad D43A on <stopovers>. Once it is loaded, return here to pick up the team of researchers who will be going with you. Remember, you will need 5 bunks free as well as an on-board Research Laboratory to complement our equipment."
units.italian: "Eccellente. Caricheremo a bordo i nostri scaffali per l'attrezzatura, e l'attrezzatura da metterci ti aspetterà sulla piazzola D43A su <stopovers>. Una volta caricata, torna qui a prendere la squadra di ricercatori che verrà con te. Ricorda: ti serviranno 5 cuccette libere e un Laboratorio di Ricerca a bordo per completare la nostra attrezzatura."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|label|777|0
units.english: maybe later
units.italian: maybe later

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|	"Oh, that is unfortunate. Maybe some other time, then." The crowd makes various gestures of disappointment, and turn back to observing the projection and discussing their theories.|778|0
units.english: "Oh, that is unfortunate. Maybe some other time, then." The crowd makes various gestures of disappointment, and turn back to observing the projection and discussing their theories.
units.italian: "Oh, è un peccato. Sarà per un'altra volta, allora." La folla fa vari gesti di delusione e torna a osservare la proiezione e a discutere le proprie teorie.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|You land on pad D43A and sure enough, there is a team waiting to load a bunch of equipment into the racks. Within minutes they are done loading, and they cheerfully wave to you as they head off.|782|0
units.english: You land on pad D43A and sure enough, there is a team waiting to load a bunch of equipment into the racks. Within minutes they are done loading, and they cheerfully wave to you as they head off.
units.italian: Atterri sulla piazzola D43A e, come previsto, c'è una squadra che aspetta di caricare un mucchio di attrezzatura negli scaffali. In pochi minuti hanno finito di caricare e ti salutano allegramente mentre si allontanano.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|According to your log, you are where you need to be, but something is missing. The mission checklist blinks quietly at you on the side of your console, reminding you that you need to have a Research Laboratory installed, and that the requested equipment must be in-system. If you have more than one ship, it might not have arrived yet.|785|0
units.english: According to your log, you are where you need to be, but something is missing. The mission checklist blinks quietly at you on the side of your console, reminding you that you need to have a Research Laboratory installed, and that the requested equipment must be in-system. If you have more than one ship, it might not have arrived yet.
units.italian: Secondo il tuo registro sei dove devi essere, ma manca qualcosa. La lista di controllo della missione lampeggia piano ai margini della console, ricordandoti che devi avere installato un Laboratorio di Ricerca e che l'attrezzatura richiesta deve essere nel sistema. Se hai più di una nave, potrebbe non essere ancora arrivata.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|One of the Remnant is waiting for you. "Thanks for picking up the equipment. The team that you will be taking to Ssil Vida is waiting for you in the spaceport."|791|0
units.english: One of the Remnant is waiting for you. "Thanks for picking up the equipment. The team that you will be taking to Ssil Vida is waiting for you in the spaceport."
units.italian: Uno dei Remnant ti aspetta. "Grazie per aver ritirato l'attrezzatura. La squadra che porterai su Ssil Vida ti aspetta allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 20|One of the Remnant is waiting for you. "Thanks for picking up the equipment. Dusk will lead the team that you will take to Ssil Vida, but we understand he is currently busy elsewhere with you. You should complete that work, then return to the spaceport here to begin the next expedition."|794|0
units.english: One of the Remnant is waiting for you. "Thanks for picking up the equipment. Dusk will lead the team that you will take to Ssil Vida, but we understand he is currently busy elsewhere with you. You should complete that work, then return to the spaceport here to begin the next expedition."
units.italian: Uno dei Remnant ti aspetta. "Grazie per aver ritirato l'attrezzatura. Dusk guiderà la squadra che porterai su Ssil Vida, ma ci risulta che al momento sia occupato altrove con te. Dovresti completare quel lavoro, poi tornare allo spazioporto qui per cominciare la prossima spedizione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|name|799|0
units.english: Expedition to Ssil Vida
units.italian: Spedizione su Ssil Vida

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|description|800|0
units.english: Install a Research Laboratory, transport these Remnant researchers to <stopovers>, and then return to <destination>.
units.italian: Installa un Laboratorio di Ricerca, trasporta questi ricercatori Remnant su <stopovers>, poi torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|blocked|805|0
units.english: You need 10 free space, five free bunks, and a Research Laboratory for this mission.
units.italian: Per questa missione ti servono 10 spazi liberi, cinque cuccette libere e un Laboratorio di Ricerca.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|In the cafeteria the scene hasn't changed much: there is still a large group of Remnant gathered around a cluster of projectors, with a constant stream of gestures discussing various points of the data. You understand enough to figure out that most of the conversation is deep into technical discussions of how the lifesign sensors might give the readings they do without having anything visible. The principal difference from before is the presence of five pressure-suited Remnant with a neat stack of equipment topped with helmets. One of them notices you and waves you over. "Captain <first>! My name is Dusk, and I am one of the researchers that you volunteered to transport to Ssil Vida."|816|0
units.english: In the cafeteria the scene hasn't changed much: there is still a large group of Remnant gathered around a cluster of projectors, with a constant stream of gestures discussing various points of the data. You understand enough to figure out that most of the conversation is deep into technical discussions of how the lifesign sensors might give the readings they do without having anything visible. The principal difference from before is the presence of five pressure-suited Remnant with a neat stack of equipment topped with helmets. One of them notices you and waves you over. "Captain <first>! My name is Dusk, and I am one of the researchers that you volunteered to transport to Ssil Vida."
units.italian: Nella mensa la scena non è cambiata molto: c'è ancora un grande gruppo di Remnant riunito intorno a un grappolo di proiettori, con un flusso costante di gesti che discute vari punti dei dati. Capisci abbastanza da dedurre che la maggior parte della conversazione è immersa in discussioni tecniche su come i sensori di vita possano dare quelle letture senza nulla di visibile. La differenza principale rispetto a prima è la presenza di cinque Remnant in tute pressurizzate con una pila ordinata di attrezzatura sormontata da caschi. Uno di loro ti nota e ti fa cenno. "Capitano <first>! Mi chiamo Dusk, e sono uno dei ricercatori che ti sei offerto di trasportare su Ssil Vida."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"Pleased to meet you, Dusk."|818|0
units.english: "Pleased to meet you, Dusk."
