units.italian: "Piacere di conoscerti, Dusk."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"Dusk? Are names like that common?"|820|0
units.english: "Dusk? Are names like that common?"
units.italian: "Dusk? Nomi del genere sono comuni?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|label|822|0
units.english: dusk known
units.italian: dusk known

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	In the cafeteria the scene hasn't changed much: There is still a large group of Remnant gathered around a cluster of projectors, with a constant stream of gestures discussing various points of the data. You understand enough to figure out that most of the conversation is deep into technical discussions of how the lifesign sensors might give the readings they do without having anything visible. The principal difference from before is the presence of five pressure-suited Remnant with a neat stack of equipment topped with helmets. You recognize one of them as Dusk as he waves you over. "Captain <first>! The Embers crossed our paths once again. I am one of the researchers that you have volunteered to transport to Ssil Vida."|823|0
units.english: In the cafeteria the scene hasn't changed much: There is still a large group of Remnant gathered around a cluster of projectors, with a constant stream of gestures discussing various points of the data. You understand enough to figure out that most of the conversation is deep into technical discussions of how the lifesign sensors might give the readings they do without having anything visible. The principal difference from before is the presence of five pressure-suited Remnant with a neat stack of equipment topped with helmets. You recognize one of them as Dusk as he waves you over. "Captain <first>! The Embers crossed our paths once again. I am one of the researchers that you have volunteered to transport to Ssil Vida."
units.italian: Nella mensa la scena non è cambiata molto: c'è ancora un grande gruppo di Remnant riunito intorno a un grappolo di proiettori, con un flusso costante di gesti che discute vari punti dei dati. Capisci abbastanza da dedurre che la maggior parte della conversazione è immersa in discussioni tecniche su come i sensori di vita possano dare quelle letture senza nulla di visibile. La differenza principale rispetto a prima è la presenza di cinque Remnant in tute pressurizzate con una pila ordinata di attrezzatura sormontata da caschi. Riconosci uno di loro: è Dusk, che ti fa cenno. "Capitano <first>! Le Braci hanno incrociato di nuovo le nostre strade. Sono uno dei ricercatori che ti sei offerto di trasportare su Ssil Vida."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"Good to see you again, Dusk."|825|0
units.english: "Good to see you again, Dusk."
units.italian: "Bello rivederti, Dusk."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"I was meaning to ask: are names like that common?"|827|0
units.english: "I was meaning to ask: are names like that common?"
units.italian: "Volevo chiedere: nomi del genere sono comuni?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|label|828|0
units.english: dusk name
units.italian: dusk name

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"You mean names of the various phases of daylight?" He pauses for a few seconds. "I would not say they are common, but nor are they rare, either. Our ancestors devoted their lives, one way or another, to studying the stars and the ever-changing light of the universe. It should not be surprising that their vocabulary should be so entwined in our culture."|829|0
units.english: "You mean names of the various phases of daylight?" He pauses for a few seconds. "I would not say they are common, but nor are they rare, either. Our ancestors devoted their lives, one way or another, to studying the stars and the ever-changing light of the universe. It should not be surprising that their vocabulary should be so entwined in our culture."
units.italian: "Intendi nomi delle varie fasi della luce del giorno?" Si ferma per qualche secondo. "Non direi che siano comuni, ma nemmeno rari. I nostri antenati hanno dedicato la vita, in un modo o nell'altro, a studiare le stelle e la luce sempre mutevole dell'universo. Non dovrebbe sorprendere che il loro vocabolario sia così intrecciato con la nostra cultura."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"Who were your ancestors?"|831|0
units.english: "Who were your ancestors?"
units.italian: "Chi erano i vostri antenati?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"Interesting. Well, what is our mission?"|832|0
units.english: "Interesting. Well, what is our mission?"
units.italian: "Interessante. Allora, qual è la nostra missione?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	Dusk looks thoughtful for a moment. "Our ancestors came from a different era for humanity. They were the heirs of a golden age of human scientific development and progress, when governments and institutions poured vast wealth into science. The developments of that time period resulted in the completion of the hyperspace relay network, new terraforming techniques, and advanced genetic engineering capabilities." His face clouds at that. "This, of course, culminated in the Alphas." He pauses, then shakes his head. "But you asked who our ancestors were, not about human history.|834|0
units.english: Dusk looks thoughtful for a moment. "Our ancestors came from a different era for humanity. They were the heirs of a golden age of human scientific development and progress, when governments and institutions poured vast wealth into science. The developments of that time period resulted in the completion of the hyperspace relay network, new terraforming techniques, and advanced genetic engineering capabilities." His face clouds at that. "This, of course, culminated in the Alphas." He pauses, then shakes his head. "But you asked who our ancestors were, not about human history.
units.italian: Dusk resta pensieroso per un momento. "I nostri antenati venivano da un'epoca diversa per l'umanità. Erano gli eredi di un'età dell'oro dello sviluppo scientifico e del progresso umano, quando governi e istituzioni riversavano enormi ricchezze nella scienza. Gli sviluppi di quel periodo portarono al completamento della rete di relè iperspaziali, a nuove tecniche di terraformazione e a capacità avanzate di ingegneria genetica." Il volto gli si rabbuia. "Tutto questo, naturalmente, culminò negli Alpha." Si ferma, poi scuote la testa. "Ma tu hai chiesto chi erano i nostri antenati, non la storia umana.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"In that era there were a number of burgeoning astronomy and exploration programs across human space. Despite also benefiting from the substantial budget increases that science in general was receiving, they were being pushed to the margins of the academic community: unlike many of the more practical sciences like biology and chemistry which were coming up with new wonders, astronomy and astrophysics was purely academic. There was no budget in explaining the whys of the universe, not when other scientists were creating homo superior and unleashing instantaneous interstellar communication.|835|0
units.english: "In that era there were a number of burgeoning astronomy and exploration programs across human space. Despite also benefiting from the substantial budget increases that science in general was receiving, they were being pushed to the margins of the academic community: unlike many of the more practical sciences like biology and chemistry which were coming up with new wonders, astronomy and astrophysics was purely academic. There was no budget in explaining the whys of the universe, not when other scientists were creating homo superior and unleashing instantaneous interstellar communication.
units.italian: "In quell'era c'erano numerosi programmi astronomici ed esplorativi in crescita in tutto lo spazio umano. Pur beneficiando anch'essi dei sostanziali aumenti di bilancio che la scienza in generale riceveva, venivano spinti ai margini della comunità accademica: a differenza di molte scienze più pratiche, come la biologia e la chimica, che producevano nuove meraviglie, l'astronomia e l'astrofisica erano puramente accademiche. Non c'erano fondi per spiegare i perché dell'universo, non quando altri scienziati creavano l'homo superior e scatenavano la comunicazione interstellare istantanea.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"So they banded together. It was not, I gather from the records, an unusual thing for academics of a particular field to meet with others of their field. If one faculty could not fund an expedition, perhaps two different faculties working together could. Eventually they formed a loose organization, a sort of 'standing conference' on astronomy and astrophysics, through which they met to discuss, debate, and organize."|836|0
units.english: "So they banded together. It was not, I gather from the records, an unusual thing for academics of a particular field to meet with others of their field. If one faculty could not fund an expedition, perhaps two different faculties working together could. Eventually they formed a loose organization, a sort of 'standing conference' on astronomy and astrophysics, through which they met to discuss, debate, and organize."
units.italian: "Così si unirono. Non era, deduco dai registri, una cosa insolita che gli accademici di un certo campo si incontrassero con altri dello stesso campo. Se una facoltà non poteva finanziare una spedizione, forse due facoltà diverse che lavoravano insieme potevano. Alla fine formarono un'organizzazione informale, una specie di 'conferenza permanente' su astronomia e astrofisica, tramite la quale si incontravano per discutere, dibattere e organizzare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"Your ancestors were originally a scientific conference?"|838|0
units.english: "Your ancestors were originally a scientific conference?"
units.italian: "I vostri antenati erano in origine una conferenza scientifica?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"Thanks for the background. So, what is our mission?"|839|0
units.english: "Thanks for the background. So, what is our mission?"
units.italian: "Grazie del contesto. Allora, qual è la nostra missione?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	Several of the Remnant nod, and another signs, "They gathered together to talk of their science, and each brought with them the captains and crew who enabled them. Some of those captains brought with them resources, too. Who else would appreciate learning of the void as much as those who ply their trades across it?|841|0
units.english: Several of the Remnant nod, and another signs, "They gathered together to talk of their science, and each brought with them the captains and crew who enabled them. Some of those captains brought with them resources, too. Who else would appreciate learning of the void as much as those who ply their trades across it?
units.italian: Diversi Remnant annuiscono, e un altro segna: "Si riunivano per parlare della loro scienza, e ognuno portava con sé i capitani e gli equipaggi che glielo permettevano. Alcuni di quei capitani portavano anche risorse. Chi altri avrebbe apprezzato conoscere il vuoto quanto chi lo percorre per mestiere?

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"The association grew over time, although as best we can tell from our records it made an effort to remain both politically and economically neutral. As such, it remained comparatively small and close-knit. Many of our ancestors have told stories about calling themselves the 'Exploration Vector,' alluding to the fact that they were the one subset of humanity on a course to head out into the furthest reaches of space. They even held contests about who could go the furthest from inhabited space, or who could spend the longest time between resupply stops.|842|0
units.english: "The association grew over time, although as best we can tell from our records it made an effort to remain both politically and economically neutral. As such, it remained comparatively small and close-knit. Many of our ancestors have told stories about calling themselves the 'Exploration Vector,' alluding to the fact that they were the one subset of humanity on a course to head out into the furthest reaches of space. They even held contests about who could go the furthest from inhabited space, or who could spend the longest time between resupply stops.
units.italian: "L'associazione crebbe col tempo, anche se per quanto possiamo capire dai registri fece in modo di restare neutrale sia politicamente sia economicamente. Perciò rimase relativamente piccola e unita. Molti dei nostri antenati hanno raccontato di essersi chiamati 'Vettore di Esplorazione', alludendo al fatto di essere l'unico sottoinsieme dell'umanità su una rotta verso i confini più remoti dello spazio. Organizzavano persino gare su chi riuscisse ad andare più lontano dallo spazio abitato, o a restare più a lungo tra una sosta di rifornimento e l'altra.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"When the war against the Alphas started, it was these people who had the most knowledge and experience with the farthest reaches of space. While many outfitters might sell a captain a map showing the hyperjumps a few systems into the uninhabited territories, it was our ancestors who had spent years living in those systems while they did their research. Thus they were the ones who got the jobs running supplies, or flying reconnaissance. They saw first-hand the way the war was going. They made the rendezvous and picked up the equipment drops, and they grew increasingly worried."|843|0
units.english: "When the war against the Alphas started, it was these people who had the most knowledge and experience with the farthest reaches of space. While many outfitters might sell a captain a map showing the hyperjumps a few systems into the uninhabited territories, it was our ancestors who had spent years living in those systems while they did their research. Thus they were the ones who got the jobs running supplies, or flying reconnaissance. They saw first-hand the way the war was going. They made the rendezvous and picked up the equipment drops, and they grew increasingly worried."
units.italian: "Quando iniziò la guerra contro gli Alpha, furono queste persone ad avere più conoscenze ed esperienza dei confini più remoti dello spazio. Mentre molti fornitori di equipaggiamento potevano vendere a un capitano una mappa con i salti iper nei primi sistemi dei territori disabitati, erano i nostri antenati ad aver passato anni a vivere in quei sistemi mentre facevano ricerca. Furono quindi loro a ottenere i lavori di rifornimento o di ricognizione. Videro in prima persona come andava la guerra. Facevano gli appuntamenti e ritiravano i lanci di equipaggiamento, e diventavano sempre più preoccupati."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"They were worried about the course the war was taking?"|845|0
units.english: "They were worried about the course the war was taking?"
units.italian: "Erano preoccupati per la piega che prendeva la guerra?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"That would be worrisome. We should focus on the mission."|846|0
units.english: "That would be worrisome. We should focus on the mission."
units.italian: "Sarebbe preoccupante. Dovremmo concentrarci sulla missione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	Dusk starts gesturing again. "Yes, but also by what they saw. Strange ships that slipped over the horizon, odd energy signatures in the distance, novel equipment that simply showed up on Deep ships without explanation... It seemed like someone out there was taking advantage of the chaos to influence humanity. Someone beyond the reach of the normal hyperspace network. It spurred our ancestors to revisit old theories and kindle new ones. Knowing that there was someone, something beyond what we knew made us bold. It was not long before the first ship traveled through the wormhole."|848|0
units.english: Dusk starts gesturing again. "Yes, but also by what they saw. Strange ships that slipped over the horizon, odd energy signatures in the distance, novel equipment that simply showed up on Deep ships without explanation... It seemed like someone out there was taking advantage of the chaos to influence humanity. Someone beyond the reach of the normal hyperspace network. It spurred our ancestors to revisit old theories and kindle new ones. Knowing that there was someone, something beyond what we knew made us bold. It was not long before the first ship traveled through the wormhole."
units.italian: Dusk ricomincia a gesticolare. "Sì, ma anche per quello che vedevano. Navi strane che scivolavano oltre l'orizzonte, strane firme energetiche in lontananza, equipaggiamenti inediti che comparivano sulle navi dei Deep senza spiegazione... Sembrava che qualcuno là fuori approfittasse del caos per influenzare l'umanità. Qualcuno oltre la portata della normale rete iperspaziale. Questo spinse i nostri antenati a riesaminare vecchie teorie e ad accenderne di nuove. Sapere che c'era qualcuno, qualcosa oltre ciò che conoscevamo, ci rese audaci. Non passò molto prima che la prima nave attraversasse il cunicolo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"Which ship was that?"|850|0
units.english: "Which ship was that?"
units.italian: "Quale nave era?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"I think I can see where this is going. Time to get to work."|851|0
units.english: "I think I can see where this is going. Time to get to work."
units.italian: "Credo di capire dove vuoi arrivare. È ora di mettersi al lavoro."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	Dusk smiles. "The Shadow Step, an independent science vessel who did double-duty as a gas miner. She made a quiet fortune harvesting rarer gases from obscure gas planets off the charted paths. Never enough to attract the attention of the big corporate entities, but enough to be comfortable. Her captain was always making modifications. Not a genius by any means, but what they lacked in brilliance, they made up for in dedication and willingness to experiment. According to our records, making modifications to the Shadow Step was their main hobby, and the small crew they flew with had similar interests." Dusk pauses to take a drink.|853|0
units.english: Dusk smiles. "The Shadow Step, an independent science vessel who did double-duty as a gas miner. She made a quiet fortune harvesting rarer gases from obscure gas planets off the charted paths. Never enough to attract the attention of the big corporate entities, but enough to be comfortable. Her captain was always making modifications. Not a genius by any means, but what they lacked in brilliance, they made up for in dedication and willingness to experiment. According to our records, making modifications to the Shadow Step was their main hobby, and the small crew they flew with had similar interests." Dusk pauses to take a drink.
units.italian: Dusk sorride. "La Shadow Step, una nave scientifica indipendente che faceva anche da estrattrice di gas. Si è costruita una fortuna discreta raccogliendo gas più rari da pianeti gassosi oscuri, fuori dalle rotte tracciate. Mai abbastanza da attirare l'attenzione delle grandi entità aziendali, ma abbastanza per stare comodi. Chi la comandava faceva sempre modifiche. Non certo un genio, ma a ciò che mancava in brillantezza suppliva con dedizione e voglia di sperimentare. Secondo i nostri registri, modificare la Shadow Step era il loro passatempo principale, e il piccolo equipaggio con cui volavano aveva interessi simili." Dusk si ferma per bere qualcosa.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"Thanks to the bravery of the Shadow Step and her crew, the hard work of the researchers that worked with them, and the contributions of a vast number of other ships and teams, the way out was discovered." Dusk signs this last with a note of finality, and many of the Remnant who were listening make the sign for "respect" and "together."|854|0
units.english: "Thanks to the bravery of the Shadow Step and her crew, the hard work of the researchers that worked with them, and the contributions of a vast number of other ships and teams, the way out was discovered." Dusk signs this last with a note of finality, and many of the Remnant who were listening make the sign for "respect" and "together."
units.italian: "Grazie al coraggio della Shadow Step e del suo equipaggio, al duro lavoro dei ricercatori che lavoravano con loro e al contributo di un vasto numero di altre navi e squadre, la via d'uscita fu scoperta." Dusk segna quest'ultima parte con una nota di finalità, e molti dei Remnant che ascoltavano fanno il segno per "rispetto" e "insieme."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|label|855|0
units.english: mission transition
units.italian: mission transition

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	Dusk smiles and signs apologetically. "My apologies for being overly detailed. I found the study of our ancestors to be an intriguing one, so I have spent much time searching out my families' history. That, in turn, has led to a detailed interest in the early years of our society." Dusk gestures towards the holographic projection of Ssil Vida. "But enough of history, the present calls to us."|856|0
units.english: Dusk smiles and signs apologetically. "My apologies for being overly detailed. I found the study of our ancestors to be an intriguing one, so I have spent much time searching out my families' history. That, in turn, has led to a detailed interest in the early years of our society." Dusk gestures towards the holographic projection of Ssil Vida. "But enough of history, the present calls to us."
units.italian: Dusk sorride e segna con aria di scusa. "Mi scuso per essere stato troppo dettagliato. Ho trovato lo studio dei nostri antenati davvero avvincente, quindi ho passato molto tempo a ricostruire la storia della mia famiglia. Questo, a sua volta, mi ha portato a un interesse dettagliato per i primi anni della nostra società." Dusk fa un cenno verso la proiezione olografica di Ssil Vida. "Ma basta con la storia, il presente ci chiama."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|label|857|0
units.english: mission description
units.italian: mission description

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	Dusk leans over the holo, peering at the details. "The mission is a very standard arc: we go to the station, set up our equipment to get some detailed readings, and return here once we are done. For these initial readings we should need about a day onsite, and we will leave some of our equipment to take ongoing recordings for retrieval later. After that... well, we will see what the data says and decide from there."|858|0
units.english: Dusk leans over the holo, peering at the details. "The mission is a very standard arc: we go to the station, set up our equipment to get some detailed readings, and return here once we are done. For these initial readings we should need about a day onsite, and we will leave some of our equipment to take ongoing recordings for retrieval later. After that... well, we will see what the data says and decide from there."
units.italian: Dusk si china sull'ologramma, scrutando i dettagli. "La missione segue un arco molto standard: andiamo alla stazione, sistemiamo la nostra attrezzatura per ottenere letture dettagliate e torniamo qui quando abbiamo finito. Per queste letture iniziali dovremmo aver bisogno di circa un giorno sul posto, e lasceremo parte della nostra attrezzatura a registrare in modo continuo, da recuperare più tardi. Dopo... beh, vedremo cosa dicono i dati e decideremo di conseguenza."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|Dusk and the team of scientists waste no time in getting to work: they have the preliminary sensors working almost from the moment you leave the spaceport, and by the time you dock with Ssil Vida they have all their equipment arranged to quickly offload and set up. With the space cleared, they expand the Research Laboratory and set to work analyzing the system. Before long they are clustered around displays and adjusting sensor readings, deep in discussion. Eventually, Dusk strides over to you. "Everything is set up and proceeding nominally, Captain. We will need a few hours to complete the measurements. You do not need to stand around watching, although you are welcome to if you like." Dusk heads back over to check on one of the devices.|866|0
units.english: Dusk and the team of scientists waste no time in getting to work: they have the preliminary sensors working almost from the moment you leave the spaceport, and by the time you dock with Ssil Vida they have all their equipment arranged to quickly offload and set up. With the space cleared, they expand the Research Laboratory and set to work analyzing the system. Before long they are clustered around displays and adjusting sensor readings, deep in discussion. Eventually, Dusk strides over to you. "Everything is set up and proceeding nominally, Captain. We will need a few hours to complete the measurements. You do not need to stand around watching, although you are welcome to if you like." Dusk heads back over to check on one of the devices.
units.italian: Dusk e la squadra di scienziati non perdono tempo a mettersi al lavoro: hanno i sensori preliminari in funzione quasi da quando lasci lo spazioporto, e quando ti agganci a Ssil Vida hanno tutta l'attrezzatura disposta per scaricare e sistemare in fretta. Liberato lo spazio, espandono il Laboratorio di Ricerca e si mettono ad analizzare il sistema. In poco tempo sono raggruppati intorno ai display e regolano le letture dei sensori, immersi nella discussione. Alla fine Dusk ti si avvicina a grandi passi. "È tutto pronto e procede nella norma, capitano. Ci serviranno alcune ore per completare le misurazioni. Non devi restare qui a guardare, anche se sei il benvenuto se ti va." Dusk torna indietro a controllare uno dei dispositivi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	(Return to the <ship> and prepare for departure.)|868|0
units.english: (Return to the <ship> and prepare for departure.)
units.italian: (Torna alla <ship> e preparati a partire.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	(Ask if I can help with their work.)|870|0
units.english: (Ask if I can help with their work.)
units.italian: (Chiedi se puoi aiutare nel loro lavoro.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	(Explore Ssil Vida.)|872|0
units.english: (Explore Ssil Vida.)
units.italian: (Esplora Ssil Vida.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	You pick up some instruments, recording equipment, and wayfinding labels, then check the map tracking the other Remnant researchers. Picking an unexplored direction, you set off.|875|0
units.english: You pick up some instruments, recording equipment, and wayfinding labels, then check the map tracking the other Remnant researchers. Picking an unexplored direction, you set off.
units.italian: Raccogli alcuni strumenti, attrezzatura per registrare ed etichette di orientamento, poi controlli la mappa che traccia gli altri ricercatori Remnant. Scegli una direzione inesplorata e ti metti in cammino.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	The first few corridors are marked with labels indicating the direction that other explorers traveled, and so you easily find your way into unexplored territory. As you explore the empty corridors, your early impressions of scale are reinforced by the massive doors and significant distances between them. Glancing inside, you find room after room containing large platforms. Each platform is lightly padded with several bars along each side, and what appears to be a storage locker set into it at the end. Based on your experience, you realize that these resemble storage platforms used to secure delicate cargo, but there is no indication of what that cargo might be.|876|0
units.english: The first few corridors are marked with labels indicating the direction that other explorers traveled, and so you easily find your way into unexplored territory. As you explore the empty corridors, your early impressions of scale are reinforced by the massive doors and significant distances between them. Glancing inside, you find room after room containing large platforms. Each platform is lightly padded with several bars along each side, and what appears to be a storage locker set into it at the end. Based on your experience, you realize that these resemble storage platforms used to secure delicate cargo, but there is no indication of what that cargo might be.
units.italian: I primi corridoi hanno etichette che indicano la direzione in cui sono andati gli altri esploratori, quindi trovi facilmente la strada per il territorio inesplorato. Mentre esplori i corridoi vuoti, le prime impressioni sulle dimensioni vengono rafforzate dalle porte enormi e dalle distanze notevoli tra loro. Guardando dentro, trovi stanza dopo stanza grandi piattaforme. Ogni piattaforma è leggermente imbottita, con diverse barre su ogni lato e quello che sembra un armadietto di stoccaggio incassato all'estremità. In base alla tua esperienza, capisci che assomigliano alle piattaforme usate per fissare carichi delicati, ma non c'è indicazione di cosa potesse essere quel carico.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	Further exploration reveals considerably more oversized rooms, including one with vast amounts of storage lockers and freezers. You note that the rooms you search appear to be fairly well organized, so you conclude that whatever happened to this station either did not cause a panic, or someone else cleaned up afterwards. After a few hours of exploring you head back to the main area.|877|0
units.english: Further exploration reveals considerably more oversized rooms, including one with vast amounts of storage lockers and freezers. You note that the rooms you search appear to be fairly well organized, so you conclude that whatever happened to this station either did not cause a panic, or someone else cleaned up afterwards. After a few hours of exploring you head back to the main area.
units.italian: Esplorando ancora scopri molte altre stanze sovradimensionate, tra cui una con enormi quantità di armadietti e congelatori. Noti che le stanze che visiti sembrano piuttosto ordinate, quindi concludi che qualunque cosa sia successa a questa stazione non ha causato il panico, oppure che qualcun altro ha ripulito dopo. Dopo qualche ora di esplorazione torni all'area principale.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|label|879|0
units.english: science assistant
units.italian: science assistant

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	You follow Dusk over to the equipment, and ask if there is anything you can do to help. He looks surprised, but pleased. After thinking about it for a moment, he asks you if you can help monitor some diagnostics and do some preventative maintenance on some of the equipment. Over the following few hours, Dusk keeps you involved in the work, occasionally explaining what the various pieces of equipment do. The rest of the team quickly follows suit, and before long you feel like part of the team. By the time Dusk starts wrapping up the observations you have started to pick up some of the scientific vocabulary, along with a few of the basics behind how the equipment works.|882|0
units.english: You follow Dusk over to the equipment, and ask if there is anything you can do to help. He looks surprised, but pleased. After thinking about it for a moment, he asks you if you can help monitor some diagnostics and do some preventative maintenance on some of the equipment. Over the following few hours, Dusk keeps you involved in the work, occasionally explaining what the various pieces of equipment do. The rest of the team quickly follows suit, and before long you feel like part of the team. By the time Dusk starts wrapping up the observations you have started to pick up some of the scientific vocabulary, along with a few of the basics behind how the equipment works.
units.italian: Segui Dusk fino all'attrezzatura e chiedi se c'è qualcosa che puoi fare per aiutare. Sembra sorpreso, ma contento. Dopo averci pensato un momento, ti chiede se puoi aiutarlo a monitorare alcune diagnostiche e a fare un po' di manutenzione preventiva su parte dell'attrezzatura. Nelle ore successive, Dusk ti tiene coinvolto nel lavoro, spiegandoti ogni tanto cosa fanno i vari pezzi di attrezzatura. Il resto della squadra segue presto l'esempio, e in poco tempo ti senti parte del gruppo. Quando Dusk comincia a chiudere le osservazioni, hai già iniziato a raccogliere un po' del vocabolario scientifico, insieme ad alcune basi su come funziona l'attrezzatura.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	You help pack up the equipment, then head back to the main room where Dusk and several others are gathered.|883|0
units.english: You help pack up the equipment, then head back to the main room where Dusk and several others are gathered.
units.italian: Aiuti a imballare l'attrezzatura, poi torni nella stanza principale dove Dusk e altri si sono riuniti.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	You head back to the <ship> and run through all the preliminary checks to get ready for the trip back to <destination>. You quickly finish the checks, along with some preventative maintenance, and end up spending a few hours relaxing while you wait for Dusk and his team to finish their studies.|886|0
units.english: You head back to the <ship> and run through all the preliminary checks to get ready for the trip back to <destination>. You quickly finish the checks, along with some preventative maintenance, and end up spending a few hours relaxing while you wait for Dusk and his team to finish their studies.
units.italian: Torni alla <ship> e fai tutti i controlli preliminari per prepararti al viaggio di ritorno su <destination>. Finisci in fretta i controlli, insieme a un po' di manutenzione preventiva, e finisci per passare qualche ora a rilassarti mentre aspetti che Dusk e la sua squadra finiscano gli studi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	Eventually you get a message from Dusk indicating that they are all packed up and ready to begin loading.|887|0
units.english: Eventually you get a message from Dusk indicating that they are all packed up and ready to begin loading.
units.italian: Alla fine ricevi un messaggio da Dusk che indica che hanno finito di imballare tutto e sono pronti a cominciare a caricare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	You find Dusk in the main hall that opens directly off of the bay where the <ship> is docked. Remnant scurry around stacking equipment in preparation for loading, and a team appears to be setting up a number of instruments around the periphery of the room. Dusk spots you, and waves you over to where he appears to be checking the readings on a console.|889|0
units.english: You find Dusk in the main hall that opens directly off of the bay where the <ship> is docked. Remnant scurry around stacking equipment in preparation for loading, and a team appears to be setting up a number of instruments around the periphery of the room. Dusk spots you, and waves you over to where he appears to be checking the readings on a console.
units.italian: Trovi Dusk nella sala principale che si apre direttamente sulla baia dove è attraccata la <ship>. I Remnant si affannano intorno a impilare attrezzatura in preparazione del carico, e una squadra sembra stare installando diversi strumenti lungo il perimetro della stanza. Dusk ti vede e ti fa cenno di raggiungerlo dove sembra controllare le letture su una console.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"What are you doing now?"|891|0
units.english: "What are you doing now?"
units.italian: "Che cosa state facendo adesso?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	"Ready to load up?"|892|0
units.english: "Ready to load up?"
units.italian: "Pronti a caricare?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	Dusk smiles at you and gestures at the others setting up instruments around the edge of the room. "We are leaving these instruments here running automated data collection routines. We cannot run the main instruments without access to larger power sources such as your ship, but these smaller instruments will be able to record baseline data for us as well as documenting any sudden changes in some of the spectral emanations. They will provide useful data for us in the future." He smiles, then continues. "As the saying goes, the best time to start collecting data is a hundred years ago. The second best time to start collecting data is now."|894|0
units.english: Dusk smiles at you and gestures at the others setting up instruments around the edge of the room. "We are leaving these instruments here running automated data collection routines. We cannot run the main instruments without access to larger power sources such as your ship, but these smaller instruments will be able to record baseline data for us as well as documenting any sudden changes in some of the spectral emanations. They will provide useful data for us in the future." He smiles, then continues. "As the saying goes, the best time to start collecting data is a hundred years ago. The second best time to start collecting data is now."
units.italian: Dusk ti sorride e fa un cenno agli altri che stanno installando strumenti intorno al bordo della stanza. "Lasciamo qui questi strumenti a eseguire routine automatiche di raccolta dati. Non possiamo far funzionare gli strumenti principali senza accesso a fonti di energia più grandi, come la tua nave, ma questi più piccoli potranno registrarci dati di base e documentare eventuali cambiamenti improvvisi in alcune delle emanazioni spettrali. Ci forniranno dati utili in futuro." Sorride, poi continua. "Come dice il proverbio, il momento migliore per cominciare a raccogliere dati era cento anni fa. Il secondo momento migliore per cominciare a raccogliere dati è adesso."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	He gestures to the rest of the team, who immediately start loading the <ship>. "Well, it is time to head back." Dusk heads over to the equipment pile, and starts carrying equipment onboard.|896|0
units.english: He gestures to the rest of the team, who immediately start loading the <ship>. "Well, it is time to head back." Dusk heads over to the equipment pile, and starts carrying equipment onboard.
units.italian: Fa un cenno al resto della squadra, che comincia subito a caricare la <ship>. "Bene, è ora di tornare." Dusk va verso la pila di attrezzatura e comincia a portarla a bordo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|The trip back to <destination> goes quickly but quietly, as all the Remnant seem to be focused on writing reports of their observations. From what you can tell, each member of the team writes up their own observations and experiences, and then Dusk assembles all the reports into an expedition report that includes each researcher's verbatim report as well as his own.|902|0
units.english: The trip back to <destination> goes quickly but quietly, as all the Remnant seem to be focused on writing reports of their observations. From what you can tell, each member of the team writes up their own observations and experiences, and then Dusk assembles all the reports into an expedition report that includes each researcher's verbatim report as well as his own.
units.italian: Il viaggio di ritorno su <destination> passa in fretta ma in silenzio, perché tutti i Remnant sembrano concentrati a scrivere rapporti delle loro osservazioni. Per quanto puoi capire, ogni membro della squadra scrive le proprie osservazioni ed esperienze, e poi Dusk assembla tutti i rapporti in un rapporto di spedizione che include i resoconti testuali di ogni ricercatore e anche il suo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 21|	The <ship> settles into the current landing pattern for the main spaceport on <destination> as you flip through the exterior camera feeds. In the distance, you notice that one of the research hangars has some activity going on around it, but otherwise, the spaceport seems to be humming along as usual. Dusk stops by the cockpit as you settle the <ship> into its berth. "Thank you for helping us, <first>. It will take us some time to analyze this data, but we will likely be mounting another expedition to Ssil Vida in the near future." He pauses, then adds, "I do not think we ever mentioned it, but, as is appropriate for your assistance, a logistics adjustment of <payment> has been applied to your account to cover your costs and provide resources to prepare for future endeavors." Dusk gives you a polite nod before heading off to help the other researchers unload the equipment.|903|0
units.english: The <ship> settles into the current landing pattern for the main spaceport on <destination> as you flip through the exterior camera feeds. In the distance, you notice that one of the research hangars has some activity going on around it, but otherwise, the spaceport seems to be humming along as usual. Dusk stops by the cockpit as you settle the <ship> into its berth. "Thank you for helping us, <first>. It will take us some time to analyze this data, but we will likely be mounting another expedition to Ssil Vida in the near future." He pauses, then adds, "I do not think we ever mentioned it, but, as is appropriate for your assistance, a logistics adjustment of <payment> has been applied to your account to cover your costs and provide resources to prepare for future endeavors." Dusk gives you a polite nod before heading off to help the other researchers unload the equipment.
units.italian: La <ship> si inserisce nello schema di atterraggio in vigore per lo spazioporto principale su <destination> mentre scorri le immagini delle telecamere esterne. In lontananza noti che intorno a uno degli hangar di ricerca c'è un po' di attività, ma per il resto lo spazioporto sembra brulicare come sempre. Dusk passa dall'abitacolo mentre sistemi la <ship> nel posto assegnato. "Grazie per il tuo aiuto, <first>. Ci servirà un po' di tempo per analizzare questi dati, ma probabilmente organizzeremo un'altra spedizione su Ssil Vida nel prossimo futuro." Si ferma, poi aggiunge: "Credo che non l'abbiamo mai detto, ma, come è giusto per il tuo aiuto, ti è stato applicato un adeguamento logistico di <payment> sul conto per coprire le spese e fornire risorse per preparare le imprese future." Dusk ti fa un cenno cortese prima di andare ad aiutare gli altri ricercatori a scaricare l'attrezzatura.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|name|926|0
units.english: Deliver Data Backups for Taely
units.italian: Consegna i backup dei dati per Taely

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|description|927|0
units.english: Deliver a data backup to <stopovers> for Taely.
units.italian: Consegna un backup dei dati su <stopovers> per Taely.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|You step out of the <ship> into the fresh air of <origin>. You recall seeing some unusual activity over at one of the research hangars. There must be something interesting going on to generate that much activity.|939|0
units.english: You step out of the <ship> into the fresh air of <origin>. You recall seeing some unusual activity over at one of the research hangars. There must be something interesting going on to generate that much activity.
units.italian: Scendi dalla <ship> nell'aria fresca di <origin>. Ricordi di aver visto un'attività insolita intorno a uno degli hangar di ricerca. Deve esserci qualcosa di interessante in corso per generare tutta quell'attività.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	(Not today.)|941|0
units.english: (Not today.)
units.italian: (Non oggi.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	(Go check out the activity.)|943|0
units.english: (Go check out the activity.)
units.italian: (Vai a vedere cosa succede.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	You follow the stream of engineers and technicians to find Taely wedged into a cavity on what must be a ship. You cannot quite tell what it looks like, however, because it is still surrounded by scaffolding, tubes, and other systems. Whatever it is, it is quite small: without all the construction rigging, you suspect that it would probably be only slightly larger than a Puffin.|944|0
units.english: You follow the stream of engineers and technicians to find Taely wedged into a cavity on what must be a ship. You cannot quite tell what it looks like, however, because it is still surrounded by scaffolding, tubes, and other systems. Whatever it is, it is quite small: without all the construction rigging, you suspect that it would probably be only slightly larger than a Puffin.
units.italian: Segui il flusso di ingegneri e tecnici e trovi Taely incastrata in una cavità di quella che deve essere una nave. Non riesci a capire bene che aspetto abbia, però, perché è ancora circondata da impalcature, tubi e altri sistemi. Qualunque cosa sia, è piuttosto piccola: senza tutto l'armamentario di costruzione, sospetti che sarebbe appena più grande di un Puffin.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	As you peer around the supports a Remnant scurries up with a slimy cable in a bag and hands it to you. "Here, Taely will need this in a few seconds, could you hand it to her when she asks for it? I need to go find the next part. Thanks!" The Remnant vanishes into an adjacent storage room before you even have the chance to respond. Almost immediately, however, Taely twists around to look back at you. "Oh, <first>! I was expecting Cora to be there with the... Ah, they gave it to you. Excellent. If you could just hand it up to me, it would be much appreciated." You reach up to hand her the bag, and Taely inches farther into the craft until only her feet are visible. A few liquid sounds later, and Taely slides back out and drops to the ground.|945|0
units.english: As you peer around the supports a Remnant scurries up with a slimy cable in a bag and hands it to you. "Here, Taely will need this in a few seconds, could you hand it to her when she asks for it? I need to go find the next part. Thanks!" The Remnant vanishes into an adjacent storage room before you even have the chance to respond. Almost immediately, however, Taely twists around to look back at you. "Oh, <first>! I was expecting Cora to be there with the... Ah, they gave it to you. Excellent. If you could just hand it up to me, it would be much appreciated." You reach up to hand her the bag, and Taely inches farther into the craft until only her feet are visible. A few liquid sounds later, and Taely slides back out and drops to the ground.
units.italian: Mentre ti sporgi tra i supporti, un Remnant arriva di corsa con un cavo viscido in una busta e te lo porge. "Ecco, a Taely servirà tra pochi secondi; potresti passarglielo quando lo chiede? Devo andare a prendere il pezzo successivo. Grazie!" Il Remnant svanisce in una stanza di deposito vicina prima ancora che tu possa rispondere. Quasi subito, però, Taely si gira a guardarti. "Oh, <first>! Mi aspettavo che ci fosse Cora con il... Ah, te l'hanno dato. Eccellente. Se potessi passarmelo, te ne sarei grata." Allunghi il braccio per porgerle la busta, e Taely si infila ancora più dentro la nave finché non si vedono che i piedi. Qualche suono liquido dopo, Taely scivola fuori e salta a terra.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"So, you came to see what the excitement was about?"|946|0
units.english: "So, you came to see what the excitement was about?"
units.italian: "Allora, sei venuto a vedere di cosa fosse tutto il trambusto?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"I spotted it on final for landing and I was curious."|948|0
units.english: "I spotted it on final for landing and I was curious."
units.italian: "L'ho notato in avvicinamento finale e mi sono incuriosito."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"I saw it while inbound for landing and was worried."|950|0
units.english: "I saw it while inbound for landing and was worried."
units.italian: "L'ho visto mentre arrivavo per atterrare e mi sono preoccupato."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"Thanks for checking up on us then," she signs with a smile. "People being concerned for the welfare of those around them is the adhesive that makes society strong."|951|0
units.english: "Thanks for checking up on us then," she signs with a smile. "People being concerned for the welfare of those around them is the adhesive that makes society strong."
units.italian: "Grazie per esserti informato su di noi, allora," segna con un sorriso. "Che le persone si preoccupino del bene di chi hanno intorno è il collante che rende forte una società."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	She gestures to the ship next to her. "You have arrived in our space at an opportune time, <first>. While most of our developments over the years have been tweaking existing ships, tweaks can only go so far. Starting long before we established our first shipyard, we have been constantly innovating and trying out new ship designs. Every new development is put on the conceptual model to see if it can help us build a better ship." She grimaces slightly. "Well, that is a bit hyperbolic. Not every development applies to spacecraft, just the ones of most interest to me." She grins at that. "In any case, several of our development projects are nearing the point of production, and this prototype should be operational within a few days."|953|0
units.english: She gestures to the ship next to her. "You have arrived in our space at an opportune time, <first>. While most of our developments over the years have been tweaking existing ships, tweaks can only go so far. Starting long before we established our first shipyard, we have been constantly innovating and trying out new ship designs. Every new development is put on the conceptual model to see if it can help us build a better ship." She grimaces slightly. "Well, that is a bit hyperbolic. Not every development applies to spacecraft, just the ones of most interest to me." She grins at that. "In any case, several of our development projects are nearing the point of production, and this prototype should be operational within a few days."
units.italian: Fa un cenno verso la nave accanto a lei. "Sei arrivato nel nostro spazio in un momento opportuno, <first>. Mentre gran parte dei nostri sviluppi negli anni è consistita nel ritoccare navi esistenti, i ritocchi arrivano solo fino a un certo punto. Da molto prima di fondare il nostro primo cantiere navale, abbiamo innovato di continuo e provato nuovi progetti di navi. Ogni nuovo sviluppo viene messo sul modello concettuale per vedere se può aiutarci a costruire una nave migliore." Fa una smorfia. "Beh, è un po' iperbolico. Non ogni sviluppo si applica alle navi spaziali, solo quelli che interessano di più a me." Sogghigna. "In ogni caso, diversi dei nostri progetti di sviluppo sono vicini alla produzione, e questo prototipo dovrebbe essere operativo entro pochi giorni."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	She pats a piece of exposed hull, and you think you can almost feel some kind of vibration or hum in response. Taely takes on a distant expression, as if lost in thought. After a long enough pause to feel awkward, she blinks a few times and focuses on you again. "Sorry about that. A new ship waking up and all that." She smiles, thoughtfully. "Before I get absorbed in my work again, would you be able to make a delivery for me? It is a simple one, but important. I need someone to deliver a set of data files to <stopovers>. As my development project has reached its end, it is time to send a hard copy of the data to one of our archives for safe keeping. Could you deliver it for me?"|954|0
units.english: She pats a piece of exposed hull, and you think you can almost feel some kind of vibration or hum in response. Taely takes on a distant expression, as if lost in thought. After a long enough pause to feel awkward, she blinks a few times and focuses on you again. "Sorry about that. A new ship waking up and all that." She smiles, thoughtfully. "Before I get absorbed in my work again, would you be able to make a delivery for me? It is a simple one, but important. I need someone to deliver a set of data files to <stopovers>. As my development project has reached its end, it is time to send a hard copy of the data to one of our archives for safe keeping. Could you deliver it for me?"
units.italian: Dà una pacca su un pezzo di scafo esposto, e ti sembra quasi di sentire una specie di vibrazione o un ronzio in risposta. Taely assume un'espressione lontana, come persa nei pensieri. Dopo una pausa abbastanza lunga da risultare imbarazzante, sbatte le palpebre un paio di volte e torna a concentrarsi su di te. "Scusa. Una nave nuova che si sveglia e tutto il resto." Sorride, pensierosa. "Prima che mi assorba di nuovo il lavoro, potresti farmi una consegna? È semplice, ma importante. Mi serve qualcuno che consegni una serie di file di dati su <stopovers>. Dato che il mio progetto di sviluppo è arrivato alla fine, è il momento di mandare una copia fisica dei dati a uno dei nostri archivi, per tenerli al sicuro. Potresti consegnarla per me?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"Yes, I can."|956|0
units.english: "Yes, I can."
units.italian: "Sì, posso."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"I am too busy for that."|958|0
units.english: "I am too busy for that."
units.italian: "Sono troppo occupato per questo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	Taely looks disappointed, but shrugs. "No problem, I will get someone else to deliver it."|959|0
units.english: Taely looks disappointed, but shrugs. "No problem, I will get someone else to deliver it."
units.italian: Taely sembra delusa, ma alza le spalle. "Nessun problema, lo farò consegnare da qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	Taely looks pleased. "Excellent. Just deliver this to the archive on <stopovers>." She hands you a very robust looking data crystal. "Looks a bit different from other data crystals, I am sure." She pauses. "These are archival crystals, and as such they have more robust data structures with many more layers of redundancy and error correction. Likewise, they have many additional layers of encryption and security to ensure that it does not fall into enemy hands. In other words, perfect for long-term storage." She smiles. "Once you have delivered this, please come back shortly to help with the initial launch of the new prototype."|962|0
units.english: Taely looks pleased. "Excellent. Just deliver this to the archive on <stopovers>." She hands you a very robust looking data crystal. "Looks a bit different from other data crystals, I am sure." She pauses. "These are archival crystals, and as such they have more robust data structures with many more layers of redundancy and error correction. Likewise, they have many additional layers of encryption and security to ensure that it does not fall into enemy hands. In other words, perfect for long-term storage." She smiles. "Once you have delivered this, please come back shortly to help with the initial launch of the new prototype."
units.italian: Taely sembra contenta. "Eccellente. Consegnalo all'archivio su <stopovers>." Ti porge un cristallo di dati dall'aspetto molto robusto. "Immagino che sembri diverso dagli altri cristalli di dati." Si ferma. "Questi sono cristalli d'archivio, e come tali hanno strutture dati più robuste, con molti più livelli di ridondanza e correzione degli errori. Allo stesso modo hanno molti strati aggiuntivi di crittografia e sicurezza per assicurare che non finiscano in mani nemiche. In altre parole, perfetti per l'archiviazione a lungo termine." Sorride. "Una volta consegnato, torna qui tra poco ad aiutare con il lancio iniziale del nuovo prototipo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|Glancing around the spaceport, you quickly spot an information desk with several busy looking Remnant. As you approach, one of them signs a greetings to you and asks how they can be of service today. A few gestures later, and they pull out a device that they wave over the data crystal. The device makes a number of chirps before falling silent, at which the Remnant looks satisfied. "Everything looks in order, Captain <last>. Please come this way." He gestures towards an inconspicuous hallway tucked behind the information desk.|966|0
units.english: Glancing around the spaceport, you quickly spot an information desk with several busy looking Remnant. As you approach, one of them signs a greetings to you and asks how they can be of service today. A few gestures later, and they pull out a device that they wave over the data crystal. The device makes a number of chirps before falling silent, at which the Remnant looks satisfied. "Everything looks in order, Captain <last>. Please come this way." He gestures towards an inconspicuous hallway tucked behind the information desk.
units.italian: Dando un'occhiata allo spazioporto, individui in fretta un banco informazioni con diversi Remnant dall'aria indaffarata. Mentre ti avvicini, uno di loro ti saluta con un segno e chiede in cosa possa essere utile oggi. Pochi gesti dopo, tira fuori un dispositivo che passa sopra il cristallo di dati. Il dispositivo emette una serie di trilli prima di tacere, e il Remnant sembra soddisfatto. "È tutto in ordine, capitano <last>. Prego, da questa parte." Fa un cenno verso un corridoio poco appariscente nascosto dietro il banco informazioni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|label|973|0
units.english: surface vault
units.italian: surface vault

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	The Remnant leads you through several sets of increasingly impressive doors before arriving at a room filled with tiny doors. He picks one, uses a key to open it, and pull out a small metal box that they unlock with a second key. "If you would place the data crystal here, we will record the surface metadata, and those who need it will be able to retrieve it when necessary." He waits until you have placed it in the box, then reverses the process to secure it in the vault wall again.|974|0
units.english: The Remnant leads you through several sets of increasingly impressive doors before arriving at a room filled with tiny doors. He picks one, uses a key to open it, and pull out a small metal box that they unlock with a second key. "If you would place the data crystal here, we will record the surface metadata, and those who need it will be able to retrieve it when necessary." He waits until you have placed it in the box, then reverses the process to secure it in the vault wall again.
units.italian: Il Remnant ti guida attraverso diverse serie di porte sempre più imponenti prima di arrivare a una stanza piena di porticine. Ne sceglie una, la apre con una chiave e tira fuori una piccola scatola di metallo che apre con una seconda chiave. "Se metti qui il cristallo di dati, registreremo i metadati di superficie, e chi ne avrà bisogno potrà recuperarlo quando serve." Aspetta che tu lo abbia messo nella scatola, poi ripete il procedimento al contrario per assicurarla di nuovo nella parete del caveau.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	The Remnant gestures, "If you are in a rush, you can drop it off in the surface vault for now, and I will move it to its proper storage location myself later. Or you can deliver it to the deep vault yourself."|977|0
units.english: The Remnant gestures, "If you are in a rush, you can drop it off in the surface vault for now, and I will move it to its proper storage location myself later. Or you can deliver it to the deep vault yourself."
units.italian: Il Remnant gesticola: "Se hai fretta, per ora puoi lasciarlo nel caveau di superficie, e lo sposterò io più tardi nella sua sede corretta. Oppure puoi consegnarlo direttamente al caveau profondo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"The surface vault."|979|0
units.english: "The surface vault."
units.italian: "Il caveau di superficie."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"The deep vault."|981|0
units.english: "The deep vault."
units.italian: "Il caveau profondo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	The Remnant leads you through several sets of increasingly impressive doors before finally taking you through an almost invisible door tucked in the back corner of a storage room. Inside, he pauses and gestures, "I would recommend you hold onto the rails, and either hook your feet onto the toeholds or activate the magnets in your boots, if you have them. The drop is quite sudden." Looking around, you note that there are what look like toeholds bolted to the floor around the edge of the room, and your guide has inserted his feet into one pair.|982|0
units.english: The Remnant leads you through several sets of increasingly impressive doors before finally taking you through an almost invisible door tucked in the back corner of a storage room. Inside, he pauses and gestures, "I would recommend you hold onto the rails, and either hook your feet onto the toeholds or activate the magnets in your boots, if you have them. The drop is quite sudden." Looking around, you note that there are what look like toeholds bolted to the floor around the edge of the room, and your guide has inserted his feet into one pair.
units.italian: Il Remnant ti guida attraverso diverse serie di porte sempre più imponenti, prima di portarti attraverso una porta quasi invisibile nascosta nell'angolo in fondo a una stanza di deposito. Dentro si ferma e gesticola: "Ti consiglio di tenerti alle ringhiere e di agganciare i piedi agli appoggi o di attivare i magneti degli stivali, se li hai. La caduta è piuttosto brusca." Guardandoti intorno, noti che ci sono quelli che sembrano appoggi per i piedi bullonati al pavimento lungo il bordo della stanza, e la tua guida ha infilato i piedi in un paio.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	As soon as you gesture that you are ready, the floor seems to drop out from below you. It seems as though you are in an elevator dropping down so fast that you are experiencing negative g-forces. After several minutes it begins to slow down, and instead of feeling lighter than usual, you feel heavier than usual as gravity catches up. Eventually, however, it eases off and the door opens once again.|983|0
units.english: As soon as you gesture that you are ready, the floor seems to drop out from below you. It seems as though you are in an elevator dropping down so fast that you are experiencing negative g-forces. After several minutes it begins to slow down, and instead of feeling lighter than usual, you feel heavier than usual as gravity catches up. Eventually, however, it eases off and the door opens once again.
units.italian: Appena fai un gesto che sei pronto, il pavimento sembra sparire sotto di te. Ti sembra di essere in un ascensore che scende così in fretta da farti provare forze g negative. Dopo diversi minuti comincia a rallentare, e invece di sentirti più leggero del solito ti senti più pesante, mentre la gravità recupera. Alla fine però rallenta del tutto e la porta si apre di nuovo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"Well, onwards we go."|985|0
units.english: "Well, onwards we go."
units.italian: "Beh, andiamo avanti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"How far down are we?"|987|0
units.english: "How far down are we?"
units.italian: "Quanto siamo in profondità?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	The Remnant smiles, and gestures, "I do not know the exact distance, but suffice to say that it is far enough that multiple direct strikes to the spaceport with nuclear ordnance would be insufficient to penetrate to this depth."|988|0
units.english: The Remnant smiles, and gestures, "I do not know the exact distance, but suffice to say that it is far enough that multiple direct strikes to the spaceport with nuclear ordnance would be insufficient to penetrate to this depth."
units.italian: Il Remnant sorride e gesticola: "Non conosco la distanza esatta, ma basti dire che è abbastanza da rendere insufficienti più colpi diretti allo spazioporto con ordigni nucleari per arrivare a questa profondità."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	Outside the elevator, the Remnant leads you down a short hallway with many doors, and eventually it opens onto a larger hall. At the opposite end of the hall is a massive door flanked with several large devices that look remarkably similar to Point Defense Turrets, but subtly different. Your guide takes a few steps into the room, and a short pedestal pops out of the floor near him. He pulls a license out of his pocket, places it in the slot, and presses firmly on it for a second, before removing it once again.|990|0
units.english: Outside the elevator, the Remnant leads you down a short hallway with many doors, and eventually it opens onto a larger hall. At the opposite end of the hall is a massive door flanked with several large devices that look remarkably similar to Point Defense Turrets, but subtly different. Your guide takes a few steps into the room, and a short pedestal pops out of the floor near him. He pulls a license out of his pocket, places it in the slot, and presses firmly on it for a second, before removing it once again.
units.italian: Fuori dall'ascensore, il Remnant ti guida lungo un breve corridoio con molte porte, che alla fine si apre su una sala più grande. All'estremità opposta della sala c'è una porta massiccia fiancheggiata da diversi grandi dispositivi che assomigliano notevolmente a torrette di difesa puntuale, ma con differenze sottili. La tua guida fa qualche passo nella stanza, e un breve piedistallo esce dal pavimento vicino a lui. Tira fuori una licenza dalla tasca, la inserisce nella fessura e preme con fermezza per un secondo, prima di estrarla di nuovo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	He then walks briskly across the hall, gesturing for you to follow. Shields flare in and out of existence around the two of you, forming a series of openings that allow you to approach the vault door, which opens when you reach it. Inside is a disappointingly small room with a small tray on a pedestal.|991|0
units.english: He then walks briskly across the hall, gesturing for you to follow. Shields flare in and out of existence around the two of you, forming a series of openings that allow you to approach the vault door, which opens when you reach it. Inside is a disappointingly small room with a small tray on a pedestal.
units.italian: Poi attraversa la sala a passo svelto, facendoti cenno di seguirlo. Gli scudi si accendono e si spengono intorno a voi due, formando una serie di aperture che vi permettono di avvicinarvi alla porta del caveau, che si apre quando la raggiungete. Dentro c'è una stanza deludentemente piccola, con un piccolo vassoio su un piedistallo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"If you would place the data crystal here, we will record the surface metadata, and those who need it will be able to retrieve it when necessary." He gestures to the tray, and once you place the data crystal on it, a shield springs into existence surrounding the tray, and the whole assembly sinks into the floor.|992|0
units.english: "If you would place the data crystal here, we will record the surface metadata, and those who need it will be able to retrieve it when necessary." He gestures to the tray, and once you place the data crystal on it, a shield springs into existence surrounding the tray, and the whole assembly sinks into the floor.
units.italian: "Se metti qui il cristallo di dati, registreremo i metadati di superficie, e chi ne avrà bisogno potrà recuperarlo quando serve." Fa un cenno verso il vassoio, e quando ci appoggi il cristallo di dati uno scudo scatta in esistenza intorno al vassoio, e l'intero complesso sprofonda nel pavimento.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"Well, that is done. Taely is waiting for me."|996|0
units.english: "Well, that is done. Taely is waiting for me."
units.italian: "Bene, fatto. Taely mi aspetta."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"Those turrets looked different."|998|0
units.english: "Those turrets looked different."
units.italian: "Quelle torrette sembravano diverse."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	The Remnant nods. "You are observant. Most of those turrets are, in fact, the originals that we discovered here. Each one is a veritable fortress in and of itself, which is why we built similar ones to use as point defense systems for our ships."|999|0
units.english: The Remnant nods. "You are observant. Most of those turrets are, in fact, the originals that we discovered here. Each one is a veritable fortress in and of itself, which is why we built similar ones to use as point defense systems for our ships."
units.italian: Il Remnant annuisce. "Sei osservatore. La maggior parte di quelle torrette sono, in effetti, gli originali che abbiamo trovato qui. Ognuna è una vera e propria fortezza in sé, ed è per questo che ne abbiamo costruite di simili da usare come sistemi di difesa puntuale per le nostre navi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"Originals?"|1001|0
units.english: "Originals?"
units.italian: "Gli originali?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"You did not build the vault?"|1002|0
units.english: "You did not build the vault?"
units.italian: "Non avete costruito il caveau?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"What do you mean by fortress?"|1004|0
units.english: "What do you mean by fortress?"
units.italian: "Che cosa intendi per fortezza?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"Yes, originals. As in, they were built by those who lived here before us, and survived countless eons protecting these hidden vaults. Even after so much time, they were still sufficiently functional to be formidable obstacles. We have since repaired them and learned much, including a lot that we have yet to be able to put into practice." He sighs, but makes a gesture of anticipation. "If we can master even half the science that made these, we will be able to achieve things that would seem like magic to those still on the ancestral worlds."|1006|0
units.english: "Yes, originals. As in, they were built by those who lived here before us, and survived countless eons protecting these hidden vaults. Even after so much time, they were still sufficiently functional to be formidable obstacles. We have since repaired them and learned much, including a lot that we have yet to be able to put into practice." He sighs, but makes a gesture of anticipation. "If we can master even half the science that made these, we will be able to achieve things that would seem like magic to those still on the ancestral worlds."
units.italian: "Sì, gli originali. Nel senso che sono stati costruiti da chi viveva qui prima di noi, e hanno resistito a innumerevoli eoni proteggendo questi caveau nascosti. Anche dopo tanto tempo erano ancora abbastanza funzionanti da rappresentare ostacoli formidabili. Da allora li abbiamo riparati e abbiamo imparato molto, comprese molte cose che non siamo ancora riusciti a mettere in pratica." Sospira, ma fa un gesto di attesa. "Se riuscissimo a padroneggiare anche solo metà della scienza che li ha prodotti, potremmo ottenere cose che sembrerebbero magia a chi è rimasto sui mondi ancestrali."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"But you produce these turrets for use on ships..."|1008|0
units.english: "But you produce these turrets for use on ships..."
units.italian: "Ma voi producete queste torrette per usarle sulle navi..."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"What about the Point Defense Turrets on your ships?"|1009|0
units.english: "What about the Point Defense Turrets on your ships?"
units.italian: "E le torrette di difesa puntuale sulle vostre navi?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"There is a big difference between being able to make something that looks similar, and being able to recreate something perfectly. The elements that we have formed into the defense turrets are actually the simplest and least advanced pieces of these ancient protectors." He shakes his head. "Someday, though. We are making new breakthroughs all the time."|1010|0
units.english: "There is a big difference between being able to make something that looks similar, and being able to recreate something perfectly. The elements that we have formed into the defense turrets are actually the simplest and least advanced pieces of these ancient protectors." He shakes his head. "Someday, though. We are making new breakthroughs all the time."
units.italian: "C'è una bella differenza tra riuscire a fare qualcosa che sembra simile e riuscire a ricreare qualcosa alla perfezione. Gli elementi che abbiamo messo nelle torrette di difesa sono in realtà i pezzi più semplici e meno avanzati di questi antichi protettori." Scuote la testa. "Un giorno, però. Facciamo nuovi progressi di continuo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	The Remnant's gestures take on a tone of curiosity. "We are not sure what they are intended to hold, but their design includes a lot of passageways and chambers that resemble a hive or a miniature city. Some have speculated that the vault builders might have been minuscule beings, which would mean that these protective devices might well have housed thousands of individuals." He shakes his head. "It must have been quite the feat to survive and prosper in a world where wildlife could annihilate a village in a single footstep." After allowing you a moment to absorb the implications, he turns back to the door. "Time to go, Captain. The sentries grow twitchy when people dawdle here."|1013|0
units.english: The Remnant's gestures take on a tone of curiosity. "We are not sure what they are intended to hold, but their design includes a lot of passageways and chambers that resemble a hive or a miniature city. Some have speculated that the vault builders might have been minuscule beings, which would mean that these protective devices might well have housed thousands of individuals." He shakes his head. "It must have been quite the feat to survive and prosper in a world where wildlife could annihilate a village in a single footstep." After allowing you a moment to absorb the implications, he turns back to the door. "Time to go, Captain. The sentries grow twitchy when people dawdle here."
units.italian: I gesti del Remnant prendono un tono di curiosità. "Non sappiamo cosa dovessero contenere, ma il loro progetto include molti passaggi e camere che assomigliano a un alveare o a una città in miniatura. Alcuni hanno ipotizzato che i costruttori dei caveau fossero esseri minuscoli, il che significherebbe che questi dispositivi di protezione potrebbero aver ospitato migliaia di individui." Scuote la testa. "Deve essere stata un'impresa notevole sopravvivere e prosperare in un mondo dove la fauna selvatica poteva annientare un villaggio con un solo passo." Dopo averti concesso un momento per assorbire le implicazioni, si volta di nuovo verso la porta. "È ora di andare, capitano. Le sentinelle diventano nervose quando la gente si attarda qui."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|label|1015|0
units.english: build vault
units.italian: build vault

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	"No, we did not build the vaults. They were built by ancient inhabitants of these worlds. We were lucky to find them, hidden away as they were. We have studied them, repaired them, and added additional layers of our own; but fundamentally these are still the structures left behind by those who came before." He nods appreciatively at the surrounding room. Taking a moment to look around, you note that the walls and floor join seamlessly, and are made of a dark metallic substance that seems to shimmer. After allowing you a moment to admire the design, he turns back to the door. "Time to go, Captain. We would not want the sentries to think you were dawdling here."|1016|0
units.english: "No, we did not build the vaults. They were built by ancient inhabitants of these worlds. We were lucky to find them, hidden away as they were. We have studied them, repaired them, and added additional layers of our own; but fundamentally these are still the structures left behind by those who came before." He nods appreciatively at the surrounding room. Taking a moment to look around, you note that the walls and floor join seamlessly, and are made of a dark metallic substance that seems to shimmer. After allowing you a moment to admire the design, he turns back to the door. "Time to go, Captain. We would not want the sentries to think you were dawdling here."
units.italian: "No, non abbiamo costruito i caveau. Li hanno costruiti gli antichi abitanti di questi mondi. Siamo stati fortunati a trovarli, nascosti come erano. Li abbiamo studiati, riparati e abbiamo aggiunto strati nostri; ma in fondo queste sono ancora le strutture lasciate da chi è venuto prima." Annuisce con apprezzamento verso la stanza intorno. Prendendoti un momento per guardarti intorno, noti che le pareti e il pavimento si congiungono senza giunzioni e sono fatti di una sostanza metallica scura che sembra tremolare. Dopo averti concesso un momento per ammirare il progetto, si volta di nuovo verso la porta. "È ora di andare, capitano. Non vorremmo che le sentinelle pensassero che ti attardi qui."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|	The Remnant leads you back out of the vault the same way you entered, and back to the information desk. He thanks you for your assistance and waves farewell before being drawn into a conversation with another ship captain. You gesture a polite farewell and head back to the spaceport. Taely mentioned something about launching a new prototype, and that is likely to be interesting.|1018|0
units.english: The Remnant leads you back out of the vault the same way you entered, and back to the information desk. He thanks you for your assistance and waves farewell before being drawn into a conversation with another ship captain. You gesture a polite farewell and head back to the spaceport. Taely mentioned something about launching a new prototype, and that is likely to be interesting.
units.italian: Il Remnant ti riporta fuori dal caveau per la stessa via dell'andata, fino al banco informazioni. Ti ringrazia per l'assistenza e ti saluta con un gesto prima di essere trascinato in una conversazione con un altro capitano di nave. Ricambi il saluto con cortesia e torni allo spazioporto. Taely ha accennato a qualcosa sul lancio di un nuovo prototipo, e probabilmente sarà interessante.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 22|You have barely cleared the security perimeter when your commlink chimes twice with a notification of a logistics credit of <payment> being deposited to your account, closely following a message to land on pad 3E5 near the research hangar Taely has been working in.|1022|0
units.english: You have barely cleared the security perimeter when your commlink chimes twice with a notification of a logistics credit of <payment> being deposited to your account, closely following a message to land on pad 3E5 near the research hangar Taely has been working in.
units.italian: Hai appena superato il perimetro di sicurezza quando il commlink trilla due volte con la notifica di un credito logistico di <payment> depositato sul tuo conto, subito dopo un messaggio che ti dice di atterrare sulla piazzola 3E5, vicino all'hangar di ricerca dove ha lavorato Taely.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|name|1028|0
units.english: First Flight
units.italian: Primo volo

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|description|1029|0
units.english: Escort the Merganser to <waypoints>, and destroy the Korath ship there.
