units.italian: Scorta il Merganser fino a <waypoints> e distruggi la nave Korath che si trova lì.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|You disembark from the <ship> just in time to watch a trio of small ships taxi out of the hangar where Taely has been working. They are strange little ships, only somewhat larger than the Terns and Petrels. What stands out the most, however, is the fact that the three ships seem to be walking of their own accord, moving forward on flexible landing legs.|1039|0
units.english: You disembark from the <ship> just in time to watch a trio of small ships taxi out of the hangar where Taely has been working. They are strange little ships, only somewhat larger than the Terns and Petrels. What stands out the most, however, is the fact that the three ships seem to be walking of their own accord, moving forward on flexible landing legs.
units.italian: Sbarchi dalla <ship> appena in tempo per vedere un terzetto di piccole navi rullare fuori dall'hangar dove ha lavorato Taely. Sono strane navi piccole, solo un po' più grandi dei Tern e dei Petrel. Quello che colpisce di più, però, è il fatto che le tre navi sembrano camminare di loro iniziativa, avanzando su zampe di atterraggio flessibili.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	Taely follows them out, and when they reach the landing pad she whistles, causing the three ships to turn and cluster around her. You can see her smile even from where you're standing, and as you watch she reaches up to pat each of them on the nose. The trio sparkle with iridescent ripples as they move around, the skin flexing and twisting like some sort of organic creature.|1040|0
units.english: Taely follows them out, and when they reach the landing pad she whistles, causing the three ships to turn and cluster around her. You can see her smile even from where you're standing, and as you watch she reaches up to pat each of them on the nose. The trio sparkle with iridescent ripples as they move around, the skin flexing and twisting like some sort of organic creature.
units.italian: Taely le segue fuori, e quando raggiungono la piazzola fischia, facendo voltare le tre navi che si stringono intorno a lei. Riesci a vederla sorridere anche da dove sei, e mentre guardi allunga una mano per dare una pacca sul naso a ciascuna. Il trio manda riflessi iridescenti mentre si muove, e la pelle si flette e si torce come quella di una specie di creatura organica.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	(Walk over to where she is standing.)|1042|0
units.english: (Walk over to where she is standing.)
units.italian: (Raggiungila dove sta in piedi.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	(Wait until she notices me.)|1044|0
units.english: (Wait until she notices me.)
units.italian: (Aspetta che ti noti.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	After several minutes of watching Taely commune with the trio of ships, she turns toward you and waves you over. "Enjoying the view?" she signs as you approach, but she continues without waiting for a response. "They are nice ships, and a major step forward in our ship development. Well worth watching." She nods to herself as she runs a hand along a fin, as if checking something.|1045|0
units.english: After several minutes of watching Taely commune with the trio of ships, she turns toward you and waves you over. "Enjoying the view?" she signs as you approach, but she continues without waiting for a response. "They are nice ships, and a major step forward in our ship development. Well worth watching." She nods to herself as she runs a hand along a fin, as if checking something.
units.italian: Dopo diversi minuti passati a guardare Taely comunicare con il trio di navi, lei si volta verso di te e ti fa cenno. "Ti piace lo spettacolo?" segna mentre ti avvicini, ma continua senza aspettare risposta. "Sono belle navi, e un grande passo avanti nello sviluppo delle nostre navi. Vale la pena guardarle." Annuisce a se stessa mentre passa una mano lungo una pinna, come per controllare qualcosa.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|label|1047|0
units.english: walk over
units.italian: walk over

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	Taely waves to you as you approach. "Eager to meet the latest additions to our fleet?" She pats the nose of the nearest ship again. "They definitely are a beautiful addition to the Remnant patrols." She smiles to herself and runs a hand along one of the fins as if checking for something.|1048|0
units.english: Taely waves to you as you approach. "Eager to meet the latest additions to our fleet?" She pats the nose of the nearest ship again. "They definitely are a beautiful addition to the Remnant patrols." She smiles to herself and runs a hand along one of the fins as if checking for something.
units.italian: Taely ti saluta con la mano mentre ti avvicini. "Impaziente di conoscere le ultime aggiunte alla nostra flotta?" Dà un'altra pacca sul naso della nave più vicina. "Sono decisamente una bella aggiunta alle pattuglie dei Remnant." Sorride a se stessa e passa una mano lungo una delle pinne come per controllare qualcosa.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|label|1049|0
units.english: merganser intro
units.italian: merganser intro

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"Captain <first>," she signs, "Please meet our first three Mergansers. I have been working on them for years now, and recent breakthroughs in our materials science have enabled significant progress in our ship designs." She pauses and gestures to one. "Would you like to touch them?"|1052|0
units.english: "Captain <first>," she signs, "Please meet our first three Mergansers. I have been working on them for years now, and recent breakthroughs in our materials science have enabled significant progress in our ship designs." She pauses and gestures to one. "Would you like to touch them?"
units.italian: "Capitano <first>," segna, "ti presento i nostri primi tre Merganser. Ci lavoro da anni, e recenti scoperte nella nostra scienza dei materiali hanno permesso progressi notevoli nei progetti delle nostre navi." Si ferma e fa un cenno verso uno di loro. "Vuoi toccarli?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"Captain <first>," she signs, "Please meet our first three Mergansers. I have been working on them for years now. In fact, the Penguin that you helped me complete was an early prototype that was testing some of the techniques for these. With that and other recent breakthroughs in our materials science, significant progress in our ship designs has been made possible." She pauses and gestures to one. "Would you like to touch them?"|1055|0
units.english: "Captain <first>," she signs, "Please meet our first three Mergansers. I have been working on them for years now. In fact, the Penguin that you helped me complete was an early prototype that was testing some of the techniques for these. With that and other recent breakthroughs in our materials science, significant progress in our ship designs has been made possible." She pauses and gestures to one. "Would you like to touch them?"
units.italian: "Capitano <first>," segna, "ti presento i nostri primi tre Merganser. Ci lavoro da anni. Anzi, il Penguin che mi hai aiutato a completare era un primo prototipo che collaudava alcune delle tecniche usate per queste navi. Con quello e altre recenti scoperte nella nostra scienza dei materiali, sono stati resi possibili progressi notevoli nei progetti delle nostre navi." Si ferma e fa un cenno verso uno di loro. "Vuoi toccarli?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"No."|1058|0
units.english: "No."
units.italian: "No."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"Yes."|1060|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	Taely smiles. "Just hold out your hand, and let it sense you first. Once it bumps your hand, you can touch it safely." You follow her example, and a few moments later the nearest Merganser nudges your hand. You follow Taely's lead in running your hand along it, and you discover that - despite the slimy appearance - the ship's skin is dry and smooth. The surface is clearly metallic, but you can feel it stretch and twist under your hand as the ship shifts and moves. You can feel pulsing vibrations not entirely unlike the ones you are used to on the <ship>, but with subtle fluctuations.|1061|0
units.english: Taely smiles. "Just hold out your hand, and let it sense you first. Once it bumps your hand, you can touch it safely." You follow her example, and a few moments later the nearest Merganser nudges your hand. You follow Taely's lead in running your hand along it, and you discover that - despite the slimy appearance - the ship's skin is dry and smooth. The surface is clearly metallic, but you can feel it stretch and twist under your hand as the ship shifts and moves. You can feel pulsing vibrations not entirely unlike the ones you are used to on the <ship>, but with subtle fluctuations.
units.italian: Taely sorride. "Tieni fuori la mano e lascia che ti percepisca prima. Quando ti urta la mano, puoi toccarlo senza rischi." Segui il suo esempio, e pochi istanti dopo il Merganser più vicino ti sfiora la mano. Segui l'esempio di Taely passando la mano lungo la superficie, e scopri che, nonostante l'aspetto viscido, la pelle della nave è asciutta e liscia. La superficie è chiaramente metallica, ma la senti allungarsi e torcersi sotto la mano mentre la nave si sposta e si muove. Senti vibrazioni pulsanti non del tutto diverse da quelle a cui sei abituato sulla <ship>, ma con fluttuazioni sottili.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"So what do these ships do?"|1063|0
units.english: "So what do these ships do?"
units.italian: "E che cosa fanno queste navi?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"Amazing what science can do these days."|1065|0
units.english: "Amazing what science can do these days."
units.italian: "Incredibile quello che la scienza sa fare oggi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"They are beautiful."|1066|0
units.english: "They are beautiful."
units.italian: "Sono bellissimi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	Taely nods in agreement. "I am glad you can appreciate some of the things we have achieved here. It makes me think that you will appreciate some of my other projects too.|1067|0
units.english: Taely nods in agreement. "I am glad you can appreciate some of the things we have achieved here. It makes me think that you will appreciate some of my other projects too.
units.italian: Taely annuisce d'accordo. "Sono contenta che tu sappia apprezzare alcune delle cose che abbiamo ottenuto qui. Mi fa pensare che apprezzerai anche alcuni dei miei altri progetti.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|label|1068|0
units.english: turn down
units.italian: turn down

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"Historically, we have relied on Starlings to fill multiple light combat roles here in the Ember Waste. Reconnaissance, sentry duty, escort, picket, patrol... they have filled so many roles." She pauses, glancing at a departing Starling. "Of course, we could just make more Starlings, but our pool of specialized crew is not infinite either. The solution I have is these Mergansers. They are sufficiently advanced that they only require a single person to operate and have significant range, enough to patrol large portions of the Ember Waste. This makes them ideal for escorting Gulls on resource gathering expeditions, patrolling for incursions, and other uses. Perhaps most importantly, though, is that they are fast enough to chase down anything we have encountered out here so far."|1069|0
units.english: "Historically, we have relied on Starlings to fill multiple light combat roles here in the Ember Waste. Reconnaissance, sentry duty, escort, picket, patrol... they have filled so many roles." She pauses, glancing at a departing Starling. "Of course, we could just make more Starlings, but our pool of specialized crew is not infinite either. The solution I have is these Mergansers. They are sufficiently advanced that they only require a single person to operate and have significant range, enough to patrol large portions of the Ember Waste. This makes them ideal for escorting Gulls on resource gathering expeditions, patrolling for incursions, and other uses. Perhaps most importantly, though, is that they are fast enough to chase down anything we have encountered out here so far."
units.italian: "Storicamente ci siamo affidati agli Starling per coprire più ruoli nel combattimento leggero qui nella Distesa di Braci. Ricognizione, servizio di sentinella, scorta, picchetto, pattuglia... hanno coperto così tanti ruoli." Si ferma, guardando uno Starling che parte. "Certo, potremmo semplicemente fare più Starling, ma anche la nostra riserva di equipaggi specializzati non è infinita. La soluzione che ho sono questi Merganser. Sono abbastanza avanzati da richiedere una sola persona per essere operati e hanno un'autonomia notevole, sufficiente a pattugliare gran parte della Distesa di Braci. Questo li rende ideali per scortare i Gull nelle spedizioni di raccolta risorse, pattugliare contro le incursioni e altri usi. Forse la cosa più importante, però, è che sono abbastanza veloci da raggiungere qualunque cosa abbiamo incontrato qui finora."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	She frowns a bit at that. "Unfortunately, the weapons program is not moving as quickly as I would like, so the Merganser does not have the tackling ability that I was originally envisioning for it. But at least it is an adept hunter we can use to pursue our enemies."|1070|0
units.english: She frowns a bit at that. "Unfortunately, the weapons program is not moving as quickly as I would like, so the Merganser does not have the tackling ability that I was originally envisioning for it. But at least it is an adept hunter we can use to pursue our enemies."
units.italian: A quella frase fa una leggera smorfia. "Purtroppo il programma delle armi non procede veloce quanto vorrei, quindi il Merganser non ha la capacità di aggancio che avevo immaginato in origine. Ma almeno è un cacciatore abile, che possiamo usare per inseguire i nostri nemici."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"Interesting."|1072|0
units.english: "Interesting."
units.italian: "Interessante."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"What 'tackling ability?'"|1074|0
units.english: "What 'tackling ability?'"
units.italian: "Che cosa sarebbe la 'capacità di aggancio'?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"In space combat, 'tackling' refers to the tactic of pinning down an enemy to make them vulnerable to the rest of the fleet. It can also refer to hindering a target's ability to move, run, or escape. You are probably familiar with the idea of using missiles or weapons with an impact force to disrupt an opponent's hyperjump. This is a prime example of tackling." She pauses, thoughtfully. "Our inhibitors are tackling weapons, but they are not sufficiently effective as far as I am concerned."|1075|0
units.english: "In space combat, 'tackling' refers to the tactic of pinning down an enemy to make them vulnerable to the rest of the fleet. It can also refer to hindering a target's ability to move, run, or escape. You are probably familiar with the idea of using missiles or weapons with an impact force to disrupt an opponent's hyperjump. This is a prime example of tackling." She pauses, thoughtfully. "Our inhibitors are tackling weapons, but they are not sufficiently effective as far as I am concerned."
units.italian: "Nel combattimento spaziale, 'agganciare' indica la tattica di bloccare un nemico per renderlo vulnerabile al resto della flotta. Può anche indicare l'ostacolare la capacità di un bersaglio di muoversi, fuggire o scappare. Probabilmente conosci l'idea di usare missili o armi con forza d'urto per interrompere il salto iper di un avversario. Questo è un esempio perfetto di aggancio." Si ferma, pensierosa. "I nostri inibitori sono armi di aggancio, ma non sono sufficientemente efficaci, per quanto mi riguarda."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"Thanks for the explanation."|1077|0
units.english: "Thanks for the explanation."
units.italian: "Grazie della spiegazione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"What is the problem with them?"|1079|0
units.english: "What is the problem with them?"
units.italian: "Qual è il problema con loro?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"Decisive strike capability, mostly." Her gestures take on a conciliatory tone. "They are excellent weapons for swarms of ships, or when mounted on a ship that can carry many of them. But when one only has the opportunity to land a few hits, they are insufficient to pin down their target. But that is an aside. For now, we should celebrate our new ships, and see what they can do." She pets the nearest Merganser lovingly.|1080|0
units.english: "Decisive strike capability, mostly." Her gestures take on a conciliatory tone. "They are excellent weapons for swarms of ships, or when mounted on a ship that can carry many of them. But when one only has the opportunity to land a few hits, they are insufficient to pin down their target. But that is an aside. For now, we should celebrate our new ships, and see what they can do." She pets the nearest Merganser lovingly.
units.italian: "Soprattutto la capacità di colpire in modo decisivo." I suoi gesti prendono un tono conciliante. "Sono armi eccellenti contro sciami di navi, o montate su una nave che può portarne molte. Ma quando si ha l'occasione di mettere a segno solo pochi colpi, non bastano a bloccare il bersaglio. Ma questa è una digressione. Per ora dovremmo celebrare le nostre nuove navi e vedere di cosa sono capaci." Accarezza affettuosamente il Merganser più vicino.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|label|1081|0
units.english: merganser mission
units.italian: merganser mission

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"But enough of that." She shakes her head and assumes a business-like expression. "We would like you to lead a pair of shakedown runs. The first is a hunt for a crippled Korath ship that got stuck in <waypoints>. We will provide you with this Merganser to fly." She pats its nose fondly. "Along with a flight of four to accompany you. Of course you are free to fly your own ship if you prefer; the important part is that you all make it back intact. So, are you up for a test flight?"|1082|0
units.english: "But enough of that." She shakes her head and assumes a business-like expression. "We would like you to lead a pair of shakedown runs. The first is a hunt for a crippled Korath ship that got stuck in <waypoints>. We will provide you with this Merganser to fly." She pats its nose fondly. "Along with a flight of four to accompany you. Of course you are free to fly your own ship if you prefer; the important part is that you all make it back intact. So, are you up for a test flight?"
units.italian: "Ma basta con questo." Scuote la testa e assume un'espressione professionale. "Vorremmo che guidassi un paio di voli di prova. Il primo è una caccia a una nave Korath menomata che è rimasta bloccata a <waypoints>. Ti forniremo questo Merganser da pilotare." Gli dà affettuosamente una pacca sul naso. "Insieme a una squadriglia di quattro che ti accompagnerà. Naturalmente sei libero di pilotare la tua nave se preferisci; la parte importante è che torniate tutti interi. Allora, te la senti per un volo di prova?"

units.english: You have destroyed the Korath ship that Taely sent you to hunt down. Return to <destination> to report the Mergansers' performance.
units.italian: Hai distrutto la nave Korath che Taely ti aveva mandato a cacciare. Torna su <destination> per riferire sulle prestazioni dei Merganser.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|You disembark to the sight of Taely striding across the tarmac, but she veers away from you at the last minute to pat the nose of one of the Mergansers. She runs a finger gently along a weapon score for a moment, then turns to face you. "So, the Korath are still capable fighters, I see." She pauses, her eyes take on a distant look for a second before she continues. "But you have returned with the flock intact. Come, join us for a meal and tell me how they fared." She leads you into the hangar where a bunch of engineers and technicians are gathered in one corner with a rack full of food trays. They enthusiastically greet you and the Merganser pilots, and quickly pull you into discussions of how the Mergansers handled their first patrol.|1113|0
units.english: You disembark to the sight of Taely striding across the tarmac, but she veers away from you at the last minute to pat the nose of one of the Mergansers. She runs a finger gently along a weapon score for a moment, then turns to face you. "So, the Korath are still capable fighters, I see." She pauses, her eyes take on a distant look for a second before she continues. "But you have returned with the flock intact. Come, join us for a meal and tell me how they fared." She leads you into the hangar where a bunch of engineers and technicians are gathered in one corner with a rack full of food trays. They enthusiastically greet you and the Merganser pilots, and quickly pull you into discussions of how the Mergansers handled their first patrol.
units.italian: Sbarchi e vedi Taely attraversare la pista a grandi passi, ma all'ultimo momento devia verso di te per dare una pacca sul naso di uno dei Merganser. Passa un dito con delicatezza lungo un segno di arma per un momento, poi si volta verso di te. "Quindi i Korath sono ancora combattenti capaci, vedo." Si ferma, i suoi occhi prendono uno sguardo lontano per un secondo prima di continuare. "Ma sei tornato con lo stormo intatto. Vieni, unisciti a noi per un pasto e raccontami come se la sono cavata." Ti conduce nell'hangar dove un gruppo di ingegneri e tecnici è riunito in un angolo con uno scaffale pieno di vassoi di cibo. Accolgono con entusiasmo te e i piloti dei Merganser, e ti trascinano subito in discussioni su come i Merganser hanno affrontato la loro prima pattuglia.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	Before long the technicians and pilots are trading stories while the Mergansers overshadow the group. Sometimes they poke various engineers or technicians, and the technicians frequently share messages from their commlinks. Apparently they have them hooked up to the Mergansers, so the ships are sharing their own accounts of the patrol. After several hours of the festivities, Taely announces that everyone needs to get to sleep because tomorrow is a new day. As everyone bids their farewells, you note that they include the ships, with most people patting or stroking one or more of the ships on their way out.|1114|0
units.english: Before long the technicians and pilots are trading stories while the Mergansers overshadow the group. Sometimes they poke various engineers or technicians, and the technicians frequently share messages from their commlinks. Apparently they have them hooked up to the Mergansers, so the ships are sharing their own accounts of the patrol. After several hours of the festivities, Taely announces that everyone needs to get to sleep because tomorrow is a new day. As everyone bids their farewells, you note that they include the ships, with most people patting or stroking one or more of the ships on their way out.
units.italian: In poco tempo tecnici e piloti si scambiano storie mentre i Merganser sovrastano il gruppo. Ogni tanto danno colpetti a vari ingegneri o tecnici, e i tecnici condividono spesso messaggi dai loro commlink. A quanto pare li hanno collegati ai Merganser, così le navi raccontano la loro versione della pattuglia. Dopo diverse ore di festeggiamenti, Taely annuncia che tutti devono andare a dormire perché domani è un altro giorno. Mentre tutti si salutano, noti che i saluti includono le navi, con la maggior parte delle persone che dà una pacca o accarezza una o più navi andando via.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"Stop by the cafeteria tomorrow morning, <first>. Dusk and I will have more you can help with, if you are interested." With that, she gestures farewell and heads off at a brisk pace.|1117|0
units.english: "Stop by the cafeteria tomorrow morning, <first>. Dusk and I will have more you can help with, if you are interested." With that, she gestures farewell and heads off at a brisk pace.
units.italian: "Passa dalla mensa domani mattina, <first>. Io e Dusk avremo altro in cui potrai aiutarci, se ti interessa." Detto questo, ti saluta con un gesto e si allontana a passo svelto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 23|	"Stop by the cafeteria once your current work with Dusk is concluded; we will have more you can help with, if you are interested." With that, she gestures farewell and heads off at a brisk pace.|1120|0
units.english: "Stop by the cafeteria once your current work with Dusk is concluded; we will have more you can help with, if you are interested." With that, she gestures farewell and heads off at a brisk pace.
units.italian: "Passa dalla mensa quando avrai concluso il lavoro che stai facendo con Dusk; avremo altro in cui potrai aiutarci, se ti interessa." Detto questo, ti saluta con un gesto e si allontana a passo svelto.

units.english: Dusk needs a load of <cargo> picked up from Esquiline, then taken to Ssil Vida.
units.italian: Dusk ha bisogno di un carico di <cargo> prelevato da Esquiline e poi portato su Ssil Vida.

units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio da Dusk e Taely che indica che la prossima missione richiede spazio per <tons> di carico e <fare>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|When you enter the cafeteria you are greeted by Dusk and Taely signing at you from across the room to join them. Collecting a tray from the dispenser, you slide into an empty seat at their table, watching as Taely signs: "We were just exchanging news and discovered we can combine our next assignment."|1139|0
units.english: When you enter the cafeteria you are greeted by Dusk and Taely signing at you from across the room to join them. Collecting a tray from the dispenser, you slide into an empty seat at their table, watching as Taely signs: "We were just exchanging news and discovered we can combine our next assignment."
units.italian: Quando entri nella mensa, Dusk e Taely ti salutano con dei segni dall'altra parte della stanza perché tu ti unisca a loro. Prendi un vassoio dal distributore e ti infili in un posto libero al loro tavolo, guardando Taely che segna: "Stavamo giusto scambiandoci notizie e abbiamo scoperto che possiamo unire la nostra prossima assegnazione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	Dusk continues. "Based on the initial data we collected while we were at Ssil Vida, there is sufficient novel data to deserve a permanent research team there. Conveniently, the station is already habitable, but we will need several shipments of equipment to set up a self-contained section."|1140|0
units.english: Dusk continues. "Based on the initial data we collected while we were at Ssil Vida, there is sufficient novel data to deserve a permanent research team there. Conveniently, the station is already habitable, but we will need several shipments of equipment to set up a self-contained section."
units.italian: Dusk continua. "In base ai dati iniziali raccolti mentre eravamo su Ssil Vida, ci sono abbastanza dati nuovi da meritare una squadra di ricerca permanente sul posto. Per comodità, la stazione è già abitabile, ma avremo bisogno di diverse spedizioni di attrezzatura per allestire una sezione autonoma."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"Okay, clear enough."|1142|0
units.english: "Okay, clear enough."
units.italian: "Va bene, abbastanza chiaro."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"Why do you need to do that?"|1144|0
units.english: "Why do you need to do that?"
units.italian: "Perché dovete farlo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"For safety. The station might appear to be enduring and constant, but if we lacked independent facilities, the slightest failure could kill everyone. Given that we do not even understand how the station is running, depending on it moving forward would be foolish." Taely nods in agreement with Dusk, and adds, "We will, of course, be looking to do a full evaluation of the station eventually, but it is rather massive. It will be quite some time before we can finish that."|1145|0
units.english: "For safety. The station might appear to be enduring and constant, but if we lacked independent facilities, the slightest failure could kill everyone. Given that we do not even understand how the station is running, depending on it moving forward would be foolish." Taely nods in agreement with Dusk, and adds, "We will, of course, be looking to do a full evaluation of the station eventually, but it is rather massive. It will be quite some time before we can finish that."
units.italian: "Per sicurezza. La stazione può sembrare resistente e immutabile, ma se ci mancassero strutture indipendenti il minimo guasto potrebbe uccidere tutti. Dato che non capiamo nemmeno come funzioni la stazione, sarebbe sciocco dipenderne in futuro." Taely annuisce d'accordo con Dusk e aggiunge: "Certo, prima o poi vorremo fare una valutazione completa della stazione, ma è piuttosto enorme. Ci vorrà parecchio tempo prima di poterla completare."
