units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	Dusk gestures and their commlink sprays a holographic list into the air between you. "Basically, we would like you to load this set of equipment, then stop by Esquiline to pick up a technician by the name of Gavriil, who will be leading the establishment of the life support systems on Ssil Vida."|1147|0
units.english: Dusk gestures and their commlink sprays a holographic list into the air between you. "Basically, we would like you to load this set of equipment, then stop by Esquiline to pick up a technician by the name of Gavriil, who will be leading the establishment of the life support systems on Ssil Vida."
units.italian: Dusk gesticola e il suo commlink spruzza nell'aria tra voi una lista olografica. "In pratica, vorremmo che caricassi questa serie di attrezzature, poi passassi da Esquiline a prendere un tecnico di nome Gavriil, che guiderà l'installazione dei sistemi di supporto vitale su Ssil Vida."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"I know Gavriil."|1149|0
units.english: "I know Gavriil."
units.italian: "Gavriil lo conosco."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"Who is that?"|1151|0
units.english: "Who is that?"
units.italian: "Chi è?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"Gavriil is a technician with a knack for balancing life support systems, especially in situations with multiple environments that need to be kept in harmony. As I recall, you worked with them to set up Esquiline station."|1152|0
units.english: "Gavriil is a technician with a knack for balancing life support systems, especially in situations with multiple environments that need to be kept in harmony. As I recall, you worked with them to set up Esquiline station."
units.italian: "Gavriil è un tecnico con un talento per bilanciare i sistemi di supporto vitale, soprattutto in situazioni con più ambienti da mantenere in armonia. Se ben ricordo, hai lavorato con Gavriil per allestire la stazione di Esquiline."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|label|1154|0
units.english: know gavriil
units.italian: know gavriil

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"Excellent. They are looking forward to working with you again. Now that the multi-environment facet of Esquiline is on track, they are ready to move on to a new challenge."|1155|0
units.english: "Excellent. They are looking forward to working with you again. Now that the multi-environment facet of Esquiline is on track, they are ready to move on to a new challenge."
units.italian: "Eccellente. Gavriil non vede l'ora di lavorare di nuovo con te. Ora che l'aspetto multi-ambiente di Esquiline è in carreggiata, è pronto per una nuova sfida."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	Dusk scans down the list of equipment. "This will be enough to get things started. We will have regular supply runs start after you deliver these, so there should be just the initial load that we would like you to take. Can you do it?"|1157|0
units.english: Dusk scans down the list of equipment. "This will be enough to get things started. We will have regular supply runs start after you deliver these, so there should be just the initial load that we would like you to take. Can you do it?"
units.italian: Dusk scorre la lista dell'attrezzatura. "Questo basterà per cominciare. Dopo la tua consegna partiranno i rifornimenti regolari, quindi dovrebbe esserci solo il carico iniziale che vorremmo che portassi. Puoi farlo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	(Accept.)|1159|0
units.english: (Accept.)
units.italian: (Accetta.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	(Decline.)|1161|0
units.english: (Decline.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|As you slip into the dock on Esquiline it quickly becomes apparent that the station is rapidly returning to full functionality, or perhaps even expanding beyond its original design: people are everywhere, and most of them are moving with purpose or diligently working on something. Several technicians cling to the ceiling overhead as they install a new conduit. Despite the busy atmosphere, people frequently stop to glance out the windows, and a flutter of gestures break out whenever someone spots a void sprite. Seeing how busy it is, you understand the traffic controller's request that you refrain from taking up a berth for longer than necessary.|1165|0
units.english: As you slip into the dock on Esquiline it quickly becomes apparent that the station is rapidly returning to full functionality, or perhaps even expanding beyond its original design: people are everywhere, and most of them are moving with purpose or diligently working on something. Several technicians cling to the ceiling overhead as they install a new conduit. Despite the busy atmosphere, people frequently stop to glance out the windows, and a flutter of gestures break out whenever someone spots a void sprite. Seeing how busy it is, you understand the traffic controller's request that you refrain from taking up a berth for longer than necessary.
units.italian: Mentre ti infili nell'attracco di Esquiline, diventa subito evidente che la stazione sta rapidamente tornando alla piena funzionalità, o forse persino espandendosi oltre il progetto originale: la gente è ovunque, e la maggior parte si muove con uno scopo o lavora diligentemente a qualcosa. Diversi tecnici si aggrappano al soffitto sopra di te mentre installano un nuovo condotto. Nonostante l'atmosfera indaffarata, la gente si ferma spesso a guardare fuori dalle finestre, e scoppia un fremito di gesti ogni volta che qualcuno avvista uno spettro del vuoto. Vedendo quanto è affollata, capisci la richiesta del controllo del traffico di non occupare un posto di attracco più a lungo del necessario.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	You find Gavriil nearby, where they are going over a freshly installed hydroponics array with a pair of Remnant in tow. They quickly finish and gesture farewell to the other two before walking over to you. "Greetings, Captain <first>! Welcome back to Esquiline. It has changed a bit since you were here last." Their gestures have an overtone of pride. "Dusk told me that we have a new station to bring online again, so we should probably get moving."|1166|0
units.english: You find Gavriil nearby, where they are going over a freshly installed hydroponics array with a pair of Remnant in tow. They quickly finish and gesture farewell to the other two before walking over to you. "Greetings, Captain <first>! Welcome back to Esquiline. It has changed a bit since you were here last." Their gestures have an overtone of pride. "Dusk told me that we have a new station to bring online again, so we should probably get moving."
units.italian: Trovi Gavriil lì vicino, impegnato a rivedere un impianto idroponico appena installato con due Remnant al seguito. Finiscono in fretta e salutano gli altri due con un gesto prima di avvicinarsi a te. "Salve, capitano <first>! Ben tornato a Esquiline. È cambiata un po' da quando sei stato qui l'ultima volta." I suoi gesti hanno una sfumatura di orgoglio. "Dusk mi ha detto che abbiamo una nuova stazione da rimettere in funzione, quindi probabilmente dovremmo muoverci."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|The equipment is promptly unloaded as Gavriil scouts some of the nearby rooms. "I have picked a suitable area to start in. If you could help move these over to that room there" - they gesture toward one of the large rooms with the platforms in it - "it would be much appreciated."|1170|0
units.english: The equipment is promptly unloaded as Gavriil scouts some of the nearby rooms. "I have picked a suitable area to start in. If you could help move these over to that room there" - they gesture toward one of the large rooms with the platforms in it - "it would be much appreciated."
units.italian: L'attrezzatura viene scaricata in fretta mentre Gavriil perlustra alcune delle stanze vicine. "Ho scelto un'area adatta per cominciare. Se potessi aiutarmi a spostare queste cose in quella stanza là" - gesticola verso una delle grandi stanze con le piattaforme - "te ne sarei molto grato."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"I would rather not."|1172|0
units.english: "I would rather not."
units.italian: "Preferirei di no."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"Sure."|1173|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"Why the rush?"|1175|0
units.english: "Why the rush?"
units.italian: "Perché tanta fretta?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"Suit yourself, I have work to do." They quickly set to moving the equipment to the desired room.|1177|0
units.english: "Suit yourself, I have work to do." They quickly set to moving the equipment to the desired room.
units.italian: "Fai come preferisci, io ho lavoro da fare." Si mette subito a spostare l'attrezzatura verso la stanza desiderata.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"Thanks, many hands make light work." You quickly have all the equipment moved into the desired room.|1180|0
units.english: "Thanks, many hands make light work." You quickly have all the equipment moved into the desired room.
units.italian: "Grazie, molte mani rendono il lavoro leggero." In poco tempo hai spostato tutta l'attrezzatura nella stanza desiderata.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"Here, help me carry this and we can talk while we shift this." They hand you a lift and the two of you start moving the equipment. "Basically, we had a visitor out here. Not sure who they were, but they flew a Palavret with a wide mix of alien technology. Our scans said there was one Korath in charge, with a crew composed of both aliens and humans. And they came with enough firepower to make life miserable for everyone. We only had a few scouts in the area, so we stayed hidden and bargained. In the end, they gave us some 'inconsequential' data, and they got an hour to explore the station and take a few loose items. Our scans indicated that they took some stuff without much obvious value from these big halls." They gesture to the room around you with all the platforms.|1183|0
units.english: "Here, help me carry this and we can talk while we shift this." They hand you a lift and the two of you start moving the equipment. "Basically, we had a visitor out here. Not sure who they were, but they flew a Palavret with a wide mix of alien technology. Our scans said there was one Korath in charge, with a crew composed of both aliens and humans. And they came with enough firepower to make life miserable for everyone. We only had a few scouts in the area, so we stayed hidden and bargained. In the end, they gave us some 'inconsequential' data, and they got an hour to explore the station and take a few loose items. Our scans indicated that they took some stuff without much obvious value from these big halls." They gesture to the room around you with all the platforms.
units.italian: "Ecco, aiutami a portare questo e possiamo parlare mentre spostiamo." Ti porge un sollevatore e cominciate a spostare l'attrezzatura. "In pratica, abbiamo avuto un visitatore qui fuori. Non so bene chi fosse, ma pilotava un Palavret con un'ampia mistura di tecnologia aliena. Le nostre scansioni dicevano che al comando c'era un Korath, con un equipaggio composto sia da alieni sia da umani. E sono arrivati con abbastanza potenza di fuoco da rendere la vita miserabile a tutti. Avevamo solo qualche sonda nella zona, quindi siamo rimasti nascosti e abbiamo trattato. Alla fine ci hanno dato dei dati 'irrilevanti', e hanno avuto un'ora per esplorare la stazione e prendere qualche oggetto sciolto. Le nostre scansioni indicavano che hanno preso roba di scarso valore evidente da queste grandi sale." Fa un cenno verso la stanza intorno a voi con tutte le piattaforme.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"That is odd."|1185|0
units.english: "That is odd."
units.italian: "È strano."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"What did the Remnant get?"|1187|0
units.english: "What did the Remnant get?"
units.italian: "Che cosa hanno ottenuto i Remnant?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"What leverage did the Remnant use to bargain?"|1189|0
units.english: "What leverage did the Remnant use to bargain?"
units.italian: "Che leva hanno usato i Remnant per trattare?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	Gavriil smiles. "Well, it seems that the captain of that ship found it distressing that we could pinpoint and detail them and their crew with sufficient data that we could use their own appearance as fake video in our transmissions, not to mention that we successfully identified them among the rest of the crew on board the ship. And it was doubly distressing for them that, despite their impressive scanner arrays, they were not able to even catch the slightest emission that might hint at where or who we were." Gavriil pauses as they palm open a door to pull the loaded lift through, then continues. "They blustered initially, but when we started listing off precise defects and wear present on their various computer systems they decided it was better to make a deal."|1190|0
units.english: Gavriil smiles. "Well, it seems that the captain of that ship found it distressing that we could pinpoint and detail them and their crew with sufficient data that we could use their own appearance as fake video in our transmissions, not to mention that we successfully identified them among the rest of the crew on board the ship. And it was doubly distressing for them that, despite their impressive scanner arrays, they were not able to even catch the slightest emission that might hint at where or who we were." Gavriil pauses as they palm open a door to pull the loaded lift through, then continues. "They blustered initially, but when we started listing off precise defects and wear present on their various computer systems they decided it was better to make a deal."
units.italian: Gavriil sorride. "Beh, sembra che chi comandava quella nave trovasse angosciante che riuscissimo a individuarli e descriverli, loro e il loro equipaggio, con dati sufficienti a usare il loro stesso aspetto come falso video nelle nostre trasmissioni, per non parlare del fatto che li abbiamo identificati con successo tra il resto dell'equipaggio a bordo. Ed era doppiamente angosciante per loro che, nonostante i loro impressionanti apparati di scanner, non riuscissero a captare la minima emissione che potesse suggerire dove fossimo o chi fossimo." Gavriil si ferma mentre apre una porta col palmo per far passare il sollevatore carico, poi continua. "All'inizio hanno fatto i prepotenti, ma quando abbiamo cominciato a elencare difetti precisi e usura presenti sui loro vari sistemi informatici, hanno deciso che era meglio fare un accordo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"Clever!"|1192|0
units.english: "Clever!"
units.italian: "Astuto!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	"What did you get from them?"|1194|0
units.english: "What did you get from them?"
units.italian: "Che cosa avete ottenuto da loro?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|label|1195|0
units.english: remnant gain
units.italian: remnant gain

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	You finish unloading the equipment into the room before Gavriil continues. "Well, the Korath have been around for a comparatively long time. So we asked for their astronomical dataset. The data we received was raw, uncorrected, and continuous data covering multiple tens of thousands of years of stellar observations. The set even includes data that likely corresponds to the destruction of some of their worlds during their civil war." They pause, then continue. "Of course, we need to verify the data first. So far, though, it is checking out successfully against already trusted records. If it can be validated, the set will massively expand the data our researchers can use to model and study the universe."|1196|0
units.english: You finish unloading the equipment into the room before Gavriil continues. "Well, the Korath have been around for a comparatively long time. So we asked for their astronomical dataset. The data we received was raw, uncorrected, and continuous data covering multiple tens of thousands of years of stellar observations. The set even includes data that likely corresponds to the destruction of some of their worlds during their civil war." They pause, then continue. "Of course, we need to verify the data first. So far, though, it is checking out successfully against already trusted records. If it can be validated, the set will massively expand the data our researchers can use to model and study the universe."
units.italian: Finisci di scaricare l'attrezzatura nella stanza prima che Gavriil continui. "Beh, i Korath esistono da un tempo relativamente lungo. Quindi abbiamo chiesto il loro archivio astronomico. I dati che abbiamo ricevuto erano grezzi, non corretti e continui, e coprivano diverse decine di migliaia di anni di osservazioni stellari. L'insieme include persino dati che probabilmente corrispondono alla distruzione di alcuni dei loro mondi durante la loro guerra civile." Si ferma, poi continua. "Certo, prima dobbiamo verificare i dati. Finora però stanno passando con successo il confronto con registri già affidabili. Se riusciremo a validarli, l'insieme espanderà enormemente i dati che i nostri ricercatori possono usare per modellare e studiare l'universo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|label|1197|0
units.english: moving on
units.italian: moving on

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	Gavriil tucks the lifter away into a storage alcove. "Well, thank you for your help, <first>. That definitely sped up the process."|1198|0
units.english: Gavriil tucks the lifter away into a storage alcove. "Well, thank you for your help, <first>. That definitely sped up the process."
units.italian: Gavriil rimette il sollevatore in una nicchia di deposito. "Beh, grazie per il tuo aiuto, <first>. Ha decisamente accelerato il processo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|label|1199|0
units.english: gavriil end
units.italian: gavriil end

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 24|	They look around at the stacks of equipment, and turn to you. "This will keep me busy for a few days, but if you would be willing to do some patrols, it would be much appreciated. I will have details for you once I have a few things unpacked."|1200|0
units.english: They look around at the stacks of equipment, and turn to you. "This will keep me busy for a few days, but if you would be willing to do some patrols, it would be much appreciated. I will have details for you once I have a few things unpacked."
units.italian: Guarda le pile di attrezzatura e si volta verso di te. "Questo mi terrà occupato per qualche giorno, ma se fossi disposto a fare qualche pattuglia, te ne sarei molto grato. Avrò i dettagli per te appena avrò scartato un paio di cose."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 25|name|1206|0
units.english: Patrol systems near Postverta.
units.italian: Pattuglia i sistemi vicino a Postverta.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 25|description|1207|0
units.english: Gavriil has asked you to do a patrol through the nearby systems to make sure that a Palavret that passed by recently did not leave behind any surprises.
units.italian: Gavriil ti ha chiesto di fare una pattuglia nei sistemi vicini per assicurarti che un Palavret passato di recente non abbia lasciato sorprese.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 25|You have barely had a chance to finish your pre-flight checks on <ship> before Gavriil is tapping on your airlock. "Setting up a new environment is always an interesting challenge," Gavriil gestures. "But to the task at hand: Could you do a quick patrol through this collection of newly accessible systems? We have scouts en route with surveillance satellites to place in each of them, but I picked up the signature of a Palavret that was here recently, and I want to be sure that it left no surprises." They pause, then make a gesture you have come to recognize as meaning the accompanying message is intended as a summary. "So, visit each of the systems in this sector, and make sure that the Palavret did not leave anything behind." Their gestures switch to a tone of finality. "Can you help with this?"|1219|0
units.english: You have barely had a chance to finish your pre-flight checks on <ship> before Gavriil is tapping on your airlock. "Setting up a new environment is always an interesting challenge," Gavriil gestures. "But to the task at hand: Could you do a quick patrol through this collection of newly accessible systems? We have scouts en route with surveillance satellites to place in each of them, but I picked up the signature of a Palavret that was here recently, and I want to be sure that it left no surprises." They pause, then make a gesture you have come to recognize as meaning the accompanying message is intended as a summary. "So, visit each of the systems in this sector, and make sure that the Palavret did not leave anything behind." Their gestures switch to a tone of finality. "Can you help with this?"
units.italian: Hai appena il tempo di finire i controlli pre-volo sulla <ship> che Gavriil sta già bussando alla tua camera di equilibrio. "Allestire un ambiente nuovo è sempre una sfida interessante," gesticola Gavriil. "Ma veniamo al compito: potresti fare una rapida pattuglia in questo gruppo di sistemi diventati da poco accessibili? Abbiamo sonde in viaggio con satelliti di sorveglianza da piazzare in ognuno, ma ho captato la firma di un Palavret che era qui di recente, e voglio essere certo che non abbia lasciato sorprese." Si ferma, poi fa un gesto che hai imparato a riconoscere come indicante che il messaggio seguente è un riassunto. "Quindi, visita ognuno dei sistemi di questo settore e assicurati che il Palavret non abbia lasciato nulla dietro di sé." I suoi gesti passano a un tono di finalità. "Puoi aiutarci?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 25|	"Yes."|1221|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 25|	"No."|1223|0
units.english: "No."
units.italian: "No."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 25|dialog|1236|0
units.english: You have destroyed the ships that the Palavret left behind.
units.italian: Hai distrutto le navi che il Palavret ha lasciato dietro di sé.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 25|dialog|1238|0
units.english: You have patrolled all six systems.
units.italian: Hai pattugliato tutti e sei i sistemi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 25|dialog|1240|0
units.english: As soon as you enter the system, three 'olofezes begin targeting your ship. These are probably the surprises that Gavriil was worried about.
units.italian: Appena entri nel sistema, tre 'olofez cominciano a puntare la tua nave. Probabilmente sono le sorprese di cui Gavriil era preoccupato.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 25|dialog|1242|0
units.english: You have returned to Ssil Vida, but you have not ensured all the nearby systems are clear.
units.italian: Sei tornato su Ssil Vida, ma non ti sei assicurato che tutti i sistemi vicini fossero liberi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 25|Back on Ssil Vida, you check in with Gavriil and report the destruction of three 'olofezes that you located. "Three?" They sign quizzically. "That is an odd number. Palavrets only carry two at most. I will report this right away. But in the meantime, come take a look at what I have set up." They lead you off toward the spaceport.|1248|0
units.english: Back on Ssil Vida, you check in with Gavriil and report the destruction of three 'olofezes that you located. "Three?" They sign quizzically. "That is an odd number. Palavrets only carry two at most. I will report this right away. But in the meantime, come take a look at what I have set up." They lead you off toward the spaceport.
units.italian: Di nuovo su Ssil Vida, ti presenti a Gavriil e riferisci della distruzione di tre 'olofez che hai localizzato. "Tre?" segna con perplessità. "È un numero strano. I Palavret ne portano al massimo due. Lo segnalerò subito. Ma nel frattempo, vieni a vedere cosa ho allestito." Ti conduce verso lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 26|name|1253|0
units.english: Bring an Aeon Cell to Ssil Vida
units.italian: Porta una Cella Aeon su Ssil Vida

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 26|description|1254|0
units.english: Gavriil has asked you to go pick up an Aeon Cell from <stopovers> by <date>.
units.italian: Gavriil ti ha chiesto di andare a prendere una Cella Aeon su <stopovers> entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 26|Gavriil strides into the room with confidence. "Look at this!" they gesture at the smooth sheeting covering the walls while the new equipment quietly hums away off to the side. A large panel with a diagram of the station stands out in the middle of it.|1262|0
units.english: Gavriil strides into the room with confidence. "Look at this!" they gesture at the smooth sheeting covering the walls while the new equipment quietly hums away off to the side. A large panel with a diagram of the station stands out in the middle of it.
units.italian: Gavriil entra nella stanza a passi sicuri. "Guarda qua!" gesticola verso il rivestimento liscio che copre le pareti mentre la nuova attrezzatura ronza piano da parte. Un grande pannello con uno schema della stazione spicca al centro.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 26|	"Setting up the life support systems as a self-contained environment within the station was simple enough that I did some preliminary power tracing on the station itself. It seems that the station is currently being powered by an immense fusion reactor that is clearly reaching its end of life." They pause, then continue. "Not to mention it is basically running on the dregs of the dregs of the remains of its spent fuel. I do not know how much longer it will last, but likely no more than a few weeks. As best I can tell, it is still trying to power everything, but the main load" - they point to the glowing red sphere on the hologram - "seems to have simply shutdown once the power levels dropped below a certain threshold." They frown at the display.|1264|0
units.english: "Setting up the life support systems as a self-contained environment within the station was simple enough that I did some preliminary power tracing on the station itself. It seems that the station is currently being powered by an immense fusion reactor that is clearly reaching its end of life." They pause, then continue. "Not to mention it is basically running on the dregs of the dregs of the remains of its spent fuel. I do not know how much longer it will last, but likely no more than a few weeks. As best I can tell, it is still trying to power everything, but the main load" - they point to the glowing red sphere on the hologram - "seems to have simply shutdown once the power levels dropped below a certain threshold." They frown at the display.
units.italian: "Allestire i sistemi di supporto vitale come ambiente autonomo dentro la stazione è stato abbastanza semplice che ho fatto un po' di tracciamento preliminare dell'alimentazione della stazione stessa. Sembra che la stazione sia alimentata da un immenso reattore a fusione che sta chiaramente arrivando alla fine del suo ciclo di vita." Si ferma, poi continua. "Per non parlare del fatto che funziona praticamente con i fondi dei fondi dei resti del combustibile esaurito. Non so quanto durerà ancora, ma probabilmente non più di qualche settimana. Per quanto posso capire, sta ancora cercando di alimentare tutto, ma il carico principale" - indica la sfera rossa luminosa sull'ologramma - "sembra essersi semplicemente spento quando i livelli di energia sono scesi sotto una certa soglia." Aggrotta la fronte verso il display.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 26|	"I do not know what will happen to the station when the main reactor fails completely, and we are not interested in letting this station collapse before we have had the chance to thoroughly investigate it. As such, we need to take action now to give ourselves room to work." They turn toward you. "I have contacted Viminal, and they have an Aeon Cell ready for transport. Please go pick it up and transport it back here." They smile faintly. "Oh, and it does not matter whether you transport it installed on your ship or in your cargo, but make sure it is not your primary power source: I have the tools to uninstall it from your ship and set it up to connect to the station, but I do not have the equipment to install it back into your ship." They pause to check a readout on the display. "Remember: it is vital that I have the Aeon Cell by <date>."|1265|0
units.english: "I do not know what will happen to the station when the main reactor fails completely, and we are not interested in letting this station collapse before we have had the chance to thoroughly investigate it. As such, we need to take action now to give ourselves room to work." They turn toward you. "I have contacted Viminal, and they have an Aeon Cell ready for transport. Please go pick it up and transport it back here." They smile faintly. "Oh, and it does not matter whether you transport it installed on your ship or in your cargo, but make sure it is not your primary power source: I have the tools to uninstall it from your ship and set it up to connect to the station, but I do not have the equipment to install it back into your ship." They pause to check a readout on the display. "Remember: it is vital that I have the Aeon Cell by <date>."
units.italian: "Non so cosa succederà alla stazione quando il reattore principale cederà del tutto, e non abbiamo alcun interesse a lasciare che questa stazione crolli prima di aver avuto la possibilità di studiarla a fondo. Perciò dobbiamo agire ora per darci il tempo di lavorare." Si volta verso di te. "Ho contattato Viminal, e hanno una Cella Aeon pronta per il trasporto. Per favore, vai a prenderla e portala qui." Sorride appena. "Oh, e non importa se la trasporti installata sulla nave o nel carico, ma assicurati che non sia la tua fonte di energia principale: ho gli strumenti per disinstallarla dalla nave e collegarla alla stazione, ma non ho l'attrezzatura per rimetterla nella tua nave." Si ferma a controllare una lettura sul display. "Ricorda: è vitale che io abbia la Cella Aeon entro <date>."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 26|dialog|1269|0
units.english: The Remnant have an Aeon Cell ready when you land. They carefully move it to your ship, and several touch it reverently before they depart. You remind yourself to make sure that it is suitably stowed before taking off again.
units.italian: I Remnant hanno una Cella Aeon pronta quando atterri. La spostano con cura verso la tua nave, e diversi la toccano con reverenza prima di andarsene. Ti ricordi di assicurarti che sia sistemata adeguatamente prima di ripartire.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 26|Gavriil has you unload the Aeon Cell into a corner of a nearby bay. "Thank you, <first>! The station is running critically low on power, and this should help stabilize it. We will eventually need a full team out here as well as some fuel to get the main reactor running properly, but first we need to figure out exactly what it uses."|1274|0
units.english: Gavriil has you unload the Aeon Cell into a corner of a nearby bay. "Thank you, <first>! The station is running critically low on power, and this should help stabilize it. We will eventually need a full team out here as well as some fuel to get the main reactor running properly, but first we need to figure out exactly what it uses."
units.italian: Gavriil ti fa scaricare la Cella Aeon in un angolo di una baia vicina. "Grazie, <first>! La stazione ha un'energia pericolosamente bassa, e questo dovrebbe aiutare a stabilizzarla. Alla fine avremo bisogno di una squadra completa qui e anche di un po' di combustibile per far funzionare bene il reattore principale, ma prima dobbiamo capire esattamente cosa usa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 26|	They pull out their commlink and check a few things. "Go to Caelian and check in with Torza. He should have finished putting the team through their paces by the time you get there. See you soon, Captain!"|1275|0
units.english: They pull out their commlink and check a few things. "Go to Caelian and check in with Torza. He should have finished putting the team through their paces by the time you get there. See you soon, Captain!"
units.italian: Tira fuori il commlink e controlla un paio di cose. "Vai su Caelian e presentati a Torza. Dovrebbe aver finito di mettere alla prova la squadra quando arriverai. A presto, capitano!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 27|name|1281|0
units.english: Check in with Torza on <planet>
units.italian: Presentati a Torza su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 27|description|1282|0
units.english: Torza should have a team ready on <planet>.
units.italian: Torza dovrebbe avere una squadra pronta su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 28|name|1292|0
units.english: Recover equipment from Baianus
units.italian: Recupera l'attrezzatura da Baianus

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 28|description|1293|0
units.english: Torza has asked you to recover 280 tons of equipment and 20 personnel from <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Torza ti ha chiesto di recuperare 280 tonnellate di attrezzatura e 20 persone da <destination> entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 28|blocked|1296|0
units.english: Over the commlink Torza is a flurry of motion as he issues orders in several directions. "Right now, we need another ship that can evacuate 280 tons and 20 people. Return here when you have suitable capabilities."
units.italian: Sul commlink Torza è un turbine di movimento mentre impartisce ordini in più direzioni. "Al momento ci serve un'altra nave che possa evacuare 280 tonnellate e 20 persone. Torna qui quando avrai capacità adeguate."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 28|Your commlink springs to life as you enter final approach to Caelian, revealing Torza in a flurry of motion. He focuses momentarily on the camera. "Captain <first>, and flying a ship with a substantial lifting capacity, excellent! The Korath have discovered one of our forward operating bases, and we need help evacuating it now. It is located on Baianus in the Parca system. There are 20 people and 280 cubic meters of equipment to retrieve. The Korath have set up a blockade, so you will need something reasonably fast to get through it. You can fight them or not, as you wish, but the primary task is evacuating the outpost. Embers speed your flight, Captain."|1304|0
units.english: Your commlink springs to life as you enter final approach to Caelian, revealing Torza in a flurry of motion. He focuses momentarily on the camera. "Captain <first>, and flying a ship with a substantial lifting capacity, excellent! The Korath have discovered one of our forward operating bases, and we need help evacuating it now. It is located on Baianus in the Parca system. There are 20 people and 280 cubic meters of equipment to retrieve. The Korath have set up a blockade, so you will need something reasonably fast to get through it. You can fight them or not, as you wish, but the primary task is evacuating the outpost. Embers speed your flight, Captain."
units.italian: Il tuo commlink si accende mentre entri in avvicinamento finale a Caelian, rivelando Torza in un turbine di movimento. Si concentra un attimo sulla telecamera. "Capitano <first>, e con una nave dalla notevole capacità di sollevamento, eccellente! I Korath hanno scoperto una delle nostre basi operative avanzate, e ci serve aiuto per evacuarla subito. Si trova su Baianus, nel sistema Parca. Ci sono 20 persone e 280 metri cubi di attrezzatura da recuperare. I Korath hanno istituito un blocco, quindi ti servirà qualcosa di ragionevolmente veloce per attraversarlo. Puoi combatterli o no, come preferisci, ma il compito principale è evacuare l'avamposto. Che le Braci velocizzino il tuo volo, capitano."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 29|name|1325|0
units.english: Recover equipment from Baianus
units.italian: Recupera l'attrezzatura da Baianus

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 29|description|1326|0
units.english: Torza has asked you to return to <destination> with the recovered equipment and personnel by <date>.
units.italian: Torza ti ha chiesto di tornare su <destination> con l'attrezzatura e il personale recuperati entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 29|blocked|1329|0
units.english: The scene is one of organized chaos. One Remnant signs "We need a ship that can carry <tons> of cargo and 20 passengers."
units.italian: La scena è di caos organizzato. Un Remnant segna: "Ci serve una nave che possa portare <tons> di carico e 20 passeggeri."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 29|Punching through the Korath blockade finds you racing across the aurora-filled skies of Baianus. You quickly slide into the designated approach track and start to enter your IFF code as a barrage of anti-air fire erupts from the ground to lance over your shoulder. As you drop into evasive maneuvers you spot the wreckage of an 'olofez tumbling to the ice behind you, and a firelance beam sears the air where the <ship> had just been. Moments later you get the confirmation signal that they have accepted your ID and are tracking your position.|1339|0
units.english: Punching through the Korath blockade finds you racing across the aurora-filled skies of Baianus. You quickly slide into the designated approach track and start to enter your IFF code as a barrage of anti-air fire erupts from the ground to lance over your shoulder. As you drop into evasive maneuvers you spot the wreckage of an 'olofez tumbling to the ice behind you, and a firelance beam sears the air where the <ship> had just been. Moments later you get the confirmation signal that they have accepted your ID and are tracking your position.
units.italian: Sfondando il blocco Korath ti ritrovi a correre attraverso i cieli pieni di aurore di Baianus. Ti infili rapidamente nella rotta di avvicinamento designata e cominci a inserire il codice IFF mentre dalla terra esplode una sventagliata di fuoco antiaereo che ti passa sopra la spalla. Mentre scivoli in manovre evasive vedi il relitto di un 'olofez che ruzzola sul ghiaccio dietro di te, e un raggio di lanciafiamme brucia l'aria dove la <ship> era appena stata. Pochi istanti dopo arriva il segnale di conferma che hanno accettato il tuo ID e stanno tracciando la tua posizione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 29|label|1341|0
units.english: cleared orbit
units.italian: cleared orbit

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 29|Destroying the Korath ships blockading this system purchases some respite. However, it does not last long as some Korath ships were in the aurora-filled atmosphere and, having evaded your assault in space, now move to pursue you, intent on stopping you from reaching the Remnant base. As you transmit your IFF code, you are aided by an eruption of anti-air fire from below, which sends an 'olofez tumbling to the icy surface as its last breath of fire misses the <ship>. Along with confirmation of recognizing you, the Remnant at the base ahead inform you that their timetable has not changed despite the currently lessened Korath presence in the system; more ships are already on the way.|1342|0
units.english: Destroying the Korath ships blockading this system purchases some respite. However, it does not last long as some Korath ships were in the aurora-filled atmosphere and, having evaded your assault in space, now move to pursue you, intent on stopping you from reaching the Remnant base. As you transmit your IFF code, you are aided by an eruption of anti-air fire from below, which sends an 'olofez tumbling to the icy surface as its last breath of fire misses the <ship>. Along with confirmation of recognizing you, the Remnant at the base ahead inform you that their timetable has not changed despite the currently lessened Korath presence in the system; more ships are already on the way.
units.italian: Distruggere le navi Korath che bloccano questo sistema ti procura un po' di tregua. Però non dura molto, perché alcune navi Korath erano nell'atmosfera piena di aurore e, evaso il tuo assalto nello spazio, ora ti danno la caccia, decise a impedirti di raggiungere la base dei Remnant. Mentre trasmetti il tuo codice IFF, vieni aiutato da un'eruzione di fuoco antiaereo dal basso, che manda un 'olofez a ruzzolare sulla superficie ghiacciata mentre il suo ultimo soffio di fuoco manca la <ship>. Insieme alla conferma del riconoscimento, i Remnant della base davanti a te ti informano che i loro tempi non sono cambiati nonostante la presenza Korath attualmente ridotta nel sistema; altre navi sono già in arrivo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 29|	As you approach the entrance to the hidden starport, directions appear on your comm panel guiding you to a spot where a large stack of equipment surrounds the landing pad. You ease inside and have barely touched down when a technician is dropping from the ceiling onto your hull with a refueling hose and repair equipment. Meanwhile, a swarm of Remnant are prepping and moving various equipment, many with lifts and loaders. You quickly open the cargo hold doors, and the Remnant rush to load and board the <ship>.|1344|0
units.english: As you approach the entrance to the hidden starport, directions appear on your comm panel guiding you to a spot where a large stack of equipment surrounds the landing pad. You ease inside and have barely touched down when a technician is dropping from the ceiling onto your hull with a refueling hose and repair equipment. Meanwhile, a swarm of Remnant are prepping and moving various equipment, many with lifts and loaders. You quickly open the cargo hold doors, and the Remnant rush to load and board the <ship>.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini all'ingresso dello spazioporto nascosto, sul pannello delle comunicazioni compaiono indicazioni che ti guidano verso un punto dove una grande pila di attrezzatura circonda la piazzola. Ti infili dentro e hai appena toccato terra che un tecnico cala dal soffitto sullo scafo con una manichetta di rifornimento e attrezzatura per le riparazioni. Nel frattempo, uno sciame di Remnant prepara e sposta varie attrezzature, molti con sollevatori e caricatori. Apri in fretta le porte della stiva, e i Remnant si precipitano a caricare e a salire sulla <ship>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 29|	The Remnant move fast, but you can hear the battle approaching. Even through the <ship>'s dampeners you can feel the heavy thud of anti-air artillery. The whine of generators being pushed to the limit fills the air as the shields crackle with incoming fire. Through the cacophony the Remnant move with purpose, gesturing instructions silently through the din. Finally the last load is packed onboard, and one of them comes up to the cockpit. "Thank you for your assistance, Captain <last>. As the explosive charges have been set, I recommend we leave promptly." They nod respectfully, then strap themselves into the nearest harness.|1345|0
units.english: The Remnant move fast, but you can hear the battle approaching. Even through the <ship>'s dampeners you can feel the heavy thud of anti-air artillery. The whine of generators being pushed to the limit fills the air as the shields crackle with incoming fire. Through the cacophony the Remnant move with purpose, gesturing instructions silently through the din. Finally the last load is packed onboard, and one of them comes up to the cockpit. "Thank you for your assistance, Captain <last>. As the explosive charges have been set, I recommend we leave promptly." They nod respectfully, then strap themselves into the nearest harness.
units.italian: I Remnant si muovono in fretta, ma senti la battaglia avvicinarsi. Anche attraverso gli smorzatori della <ship> senti il tonfo pesante dell'artiglieria antiaerea. Il lamento dei generatori spinti al limite riempie l'aria mentre gli scudi crepitano sotto il fuoco in arrivo. In mezzo alla cacofonia i Remnant si muovono con determinazione, impartendo istruzioni silenziosamente a gesti nel frastuono. Alla fine l'ultimo carico è a bordo, e uno di loro sale all'abitacolo. "Grazie per l'assistenza, capitano <last>. Dato che le cariche esplosive sono state piazzate, consiglio di partire subito." Fa un cenno rispettoso, poi si allaccia al più vicino dei tiranti.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 29|	The shield opens one final time to allow you to leave, and you practically leap into the teeth of a Korath attack. The anti-air artillery continues its rhythmic barrage against the incoming ships, but it is evident that both it and the shields around the base are failing under the assault. As you head for orbit, the last image you see is the artillery pieces sag and collapse as they melt into the ground. Your sensors record a sudden explosion from the cavern, to which the Remnant give a sad but satisfied nod. "Take us back to Caelian please, Captain."|1346|0
units.english: The shield opens one final time to allow you to leave, and you practically leap into the teeth of a Korath attack. The anti-air artillery continues its rhythmic barrage against the incoming ships, but it is evident that both it and the shields around the base are failing under the assault. As you head for orbit, the last image you see is the artillery pieces sag and collapse as they melt into the ground. Your sensors record a sudden explosion from the cavern, to which the Remnant give a sad but satisfied nod. "Take us back to Caelian please, Captain."
units.italian: Lo scudo si apre un'ultima volta per lasciarti uscire, e ti lanci praticamente nelle fauci di un attacco Korath. L'artiglieria antiaerea continua il suo sbarramento ritmico contro le navi in arrivo, ma è evidente che sia lei sia gli scudi intorno alla base stanno cedendo sotto l'assalto. Mentre ti dirigi verso l'orbita, l'ultima immagine che vedi è quella dei pezzi di artiglieria che si afflosciano e crollano mentre si sciolgono nel terreno. I tuoi sensori registrano un'improvvisa esplosione dalla caverna, alla quale i Remnant rispondono con un cenno triste ma soddisfatto. "Riportaci su Caelian, per favore, capitano."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 29|The brutal sun of Caelian hits you like a hammer as you open the hatch to let the evacuees out. A few of the Remnant step into the sun as if relishing the heat, while others move quickly to the shade of a nearby structure to confer. Several, however, need to be carried out to waiting vehicles: it seems that they were hurt in one of the initial raids, and while adrenaline kept them going during the evacuation, their condition deteriorated during the flight back. The Remnant carry them with reverent haste, and then the vehicles they are loaded into vanish quickly into nearby structures.|1363|0
units.english: The brutal sun of Caelian hits you like a hammer as you open the hatch to let the evacuees out. A few of the Remnant step into the sun as if relishing the heat, while others move quickly to the shade of a nearby structure to confer. Several, however, need to be carried out to waiting vehicles: it seems that they were hurt in one of the initial raids, and while adrenaline kept them going during the evacuation, their condition deteriorated during the flight back. The Remnant carry them with reverent haste, and then the vehicles they are loaded into vanish quickly into nearby structures.
units.italian: Il sole brutale di Caelian ti colpisce come un martello quando apri il portello per far uscire gli evacuati. Alcuni Remnant entrano nel sole come se ne assaporassero il calore, mentre altri si spostano in fretta all'ombra di una struttura vicina per conferire. Diversi, però, devono essere portati fuori verso veicoli in attesa: sembra che siano rimasti feriti in una delle incursioni iniziali, e mentre l'adrenalina li ha sostenuti durante l'evacuazione, le loro condizioni sono peggiorate durante il volo di ritorno. I Remnant li trasportano con fretta reverente, e poi i veicoli su cui vengono caricati svaniscono in fretta tra le strutture vicine.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 29|	"The Embers saw you safely through," gestures Torza with a note of appreciation, appearing from a nearby hatch. "The loss of that outpost is unfortunate, but at least most of the Remnant there survived. Thank you for your assistance." He glances at his commlink. "Your logistics adjustment has been added to your account, of course, but I suspect that you are interested in pushing forward the progress in studying Ssil Vida. Meet me in the spaceport when you are ready."|1364|0
units.english: "The Embers saw you safely through," gestures Torza with a note of appreciation, appearing from a nearby hatch. "The loss of that outpost is unfortunate, but at least most of the Remnant there survived. Thank you for your assistance." He glances at his commlink. "Your logistics adjustment has been added to your account, of course, but I suspect that you are interested in pushing forward the progress in studying Ssil Vida. Meet me in the spaceport when you are ready."
units.italian: "Le Braci ti hanno portato in salvo," gesticola Torza con una nota di apprezzamento, comparendo da un portello vicino. "La perdita di quell'avamposto è un peccato, ma almeno la maggior parte dei Remnant laggiù è sopravvissuta. Grazie per l'assistenza." Dà un'occhiata al commlink. "Il tuo adeguamento logistico è stato aggiunto al tuo conto, naturalmente, ma sospetto che ti interessi portare avanti il progresso nello studio di Ssil Vida. Incontrami allo spazioporto quando sei pronto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|name|1369|0
units.english: Transport team to <planet>
units.italian: Trasporta la squadra su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|description|1370|0
units.english: Torza has tasked you with transporting a team of technicians to <destination>.
units.italian: Torza ti ha affidato il trasporto di una squadra di tecnici su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|blocked|1373|0
units.english: You check in with Torza, who glances at his commlink. "You will need a ship with space for 15 people and 30 tons of cargo."
units.italian: Ti presenti a Torza, che dà un'occhiata al commlink. "Ti servirà una nave con spazio per 15 persone e 30 tonnellate di carico."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|You walk into the cafeteria to find a group of Remnant looking tired but pleased with themselves. Torza is striding among them with a tray filled with bottles, handing them out. "Good work, everyone. Excellent pacing on that run." He turns towards you. "And right on schedule, the captain who will be transporting you over to Ssil Vida." He gestures for you to take a seat and offers you a bottle as well.|1380|0
units.english: You walk into the cafeteria to find a group of Remnant looking tired but pleased with themselves. Torza is striding among them with a tray filled with bottles, handing them out. "Good work, everyone. Excellent pacing on that run." He turns towards you. "And right on schedule, the captain who will be transporting you over to Ssil Vida." He gestures for you to take a seat and offers you a bottle as well.
units.italian: Entri nella mensa e trovi un gruppo di Remnant stanchi ma soddisfatti di sé. Torza va tra loro con un vassoio pieno di bottiglie, distribuendole. "Bel lavoro, gente. Ottimo ritmo in quella corsa." Si volta verso di te. "E proprio in orario, il capitano che vi porterà su Ssil Vida." Ti fa cenno di sederti e ti offre anche una bottiglia.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|	(Gesture that I am not thirsty.)|1382|0
units.english: (Gesture that I am not thirsty.)
units.italian: (Fai un gesto per dire che non hai sete.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|	(Take a bottle and gesture appreciation.)|1384|0
units.english: (Take a bottle and gesture appreciation.)
units.italian: (Prendi una bottiglia e fai un gesto di ringraziamento.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|	You sip from the bottle, and discover that it tastes like some kind of restorative sports drink. You can pick out hints of salt and a few other flavors, but most of it is an indeterminate taste you cannot quite identify. Torza nods in approval as you drink. "Especially in heat like this, hydration is important." He continues weaving around the group handing out the remaining bottles.|1385|0
units.english: You sip from the bottle, and discover that it tastes like some kind of restorative sports drink. You can pick out hints of salt and a few other flavors, but most of it is an indeterminate taste you cannot quite identify. Torza nods in approval as you drink. "Especially in heat like this, hydration is important." He continues weaving around the group handing out the remaining bottles.
units.italian: Sorvegli dalla bottiglia e scopri che ha il sapore di una specie di bevanda sportiva rinvigorente. Distingui sentori di sale e qualche altro aroma, ma il resto è un sapore indeterminato che non riesci a identificare. Torza annuisce con approvazione mentre bevi. "Soprattutto con un caldo così, l'idratazione è importante." Continua a girare per il gruppo distribuendo le bottiglie rimaste.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|	(Drink in silence.)|1387|0
units.english: (Drink in silence.)
units.italian: (Bevi in silenzio.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|	(Ask the Remnant next to me what just happened.)|1389|0
units.english: (Ask the Remnant next to me what just happened.)
units.italian: (Chiedi al Remnant accanto a te cosa è appena successo.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|	The Remnant smiles tiredly. "We did a ten kilometer run in just under thirty seven minutes, wearing our emergency environmental suits and carrying basic survival and maintenance gear. Torza set a hard pace, but we kept up." She takes a sip from her drink. "It is hard work, but endurance is rather important for survival, especially in an unknown environment like <planet>." She takes another sip. "It was an interesting change of pace. Normally I carry full engineering kit, so this was a 'fast scramble' in comparison. He" - she gestures at Torza - "likes to change things up. No two runs are the same when he sets the pace."|1390|0
units.english: The Remnant smiles tiredly. "We did a ten kilometer run in just under thirty seven minutes, wearing our emergency environmental suits and carrying basic survival and maintenance gear. Torza set a hard pace, but we kept up." She takes a sip from her drink. "It is hard work, but endurance is rather important for survival, especially in an unknown environment like <planet>." She takes another sip. "It was an interesting change of pace. Normally I carry full engineering kit, so this was a 'fast scramble' in comparison. He" - she gestures at Torza - "likes to change things up. No two runs are the same when he sets the pace."
units.italian: Il Remnant sorride stancamente. "Abbiamo fatto dieci chilometri in poco meno di trentasette minuti, indossando le tute ambientali di emergenza e portando equipaggiamento di sopravvivenza e manutenzione. Torza ha tenuto un ritmo duro, ma gli siamo stati dietro." Prende un sorso dalla bevanda. "È un duro lavoro, ma la resistenza è piuttosto importante per sopravvivere, soprattutto in un ambiente sconosciuto come <planet>." Prende un altro sorso. "È stato un cambio di ritmo interessante. Normalmente porto il kit completo da ingegneria, quindi questa volta è stata una 'corsa rapida' in confronto. Lui" - gesticola verso Torza - "ama cambiare le cose. Non ci sono due corse uguali quando detta il ritmo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|label|1392|0
units.english: not thirsty
units.italian: not thirsty

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|	Torza quickly continues his rounds, and soon everyone is sipping on a drink. Several have pulled up displays of Ssil Vida, while others are chatting as they go over inventory lists. Most of the conversation that you catch sounds like a group of technicians prepping for a mission.|1393|0
units.english: Torza quickly continues his rounds, and soon everyone is sipping on a drink. Several have pulled up displays of Ssil Vida, while others are chatting as they go over inventory lists. Most of the conversation that you catch sounds like a group of technicians prepping for a mission.
units.italian: Torza riprende in fretta il suo giro, e presto tutti sorseggiano una bevanda. Diversi hanno aperto display di Ssil Vida, mentre altri chiacchierano passando in rassegna liste di inventario. La maggior parte della conversazione che cogli suona come un gruppo di tecnici che si prepara a una missione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|label|1394|0
units.english: power briefing
units.italian: power briefing

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|	After a few minutes Torza gestures for everyone to pay attention. "Now, to review the parameters: <planet> appears to be a giant mechanism for doing something we do not yet know. The core systems have exhausted the capacity of the large fusion reactor to supply them. The installation of the Aeon Cell has reduced the strain on the system, but it cannot fully power the station. You need to focus on the power systems, and figure out how to fully stabilize the distribution. While you are doing that, <first> will be returning to Viminal for the next step in this operation. You will all be staying on <planet> for at least a few months, maybe longer, as the situation warrants. Agreed?" Around the room there are a variety of nods and gestures of affirmation.|1395|0
units.english: After a few minutes Torza gestures for everyone to pay attention. "Now, to review the parameters: <planet> appears to be a giant mechanism for doing something we do not yet know. The core systems have exhausted the capacity of the large fusion reactor to supply them. The installation of the Aeon Cell has reduced the strain on the system, but it cannot fully power the station. You need to focus on the power systems, and figure out how to fully stabilize the distribution. While you are doing that, <first> will be returning to Viminal for the next step in this operation. You will all be staying on <planet> for at least a few months, maybe longer, as the situation warrants. Agreed?" Around the room there are a variety of nods and gestures of affirmation.
units.italian: Dopo qualche minuto Torza fa un gesto perché tutti facciano attenzione. "Ora, per rivedere i parametri: <planet> sembra essere un gigantesco meccanismo che fa qualcosa che ancora non conosciamo. I sistemi del nucleo hanno esaurito la capacità del grande reattore a fusione di alimentarli. L'installazione della Cella Aeon ha ridotto lo sforzo sul sistema, ma non può alimentare la stazione da sola. Dovete concentrarvi sui sistemi di alimentazione e capire come stabilizzare del tutto la distribuzione. Mentre lo fate, <first> tornerà su Viminal per il passo successivo di questa operazione. Resterete tutti su <planet> per almeno qualche mese, forse di più, secondo come richiederà la situazione. D'accordo?" Nella stanza ci sono vari cenni e gesti di assenso.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|	Torza makes a gesture of respect. "Embers sharpen your sight, friends."|1396|0
units.english: Torza makes a gesture of respect. "Embers sharpen your sight, friends."
units.italian: Torza fa un gesto di rispetto. "Che le Braci aguzzino la vostra vista, amici."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|Gavriil is waiting at the dock when the <ship>'s hatches finish cycling. "Welcome," they gesture. "It is good to have fresh minds to share <planet> with." The Remnant onboard stream out of the ship in a rush, each carrying a heavy pack of equipment. They gesture respect, and head off in different directions. Evidently they have studied the maps prior to arrival, as they all seem to know where they are going. Several stay behind with Gavriil and help unload the rest of the equipment, some of which appears to include the core equipment of an outfitters.|1402|0
units.english: Gavriil is waiting at the dock when the <ship>'s hatches finish cycling. "Welcome," they gesture. "It is good to have fresh minds to share <planet> with." The Remnant onboard stream out of the ship in a rush, each carrying a heavy pack of equipment. They gesture respect, and head off in different directions. Evidently they have studied the maps prior to arrival, as they all seem to know where they are going. Several stay behind with Gavriil and help unload the rest of the equipment, some of which appears to include the core equipment of an outfitters.
units.italian: Gavriil aspetta all'attracco quando i portelli della <ship> finiscono il ciclo. "Benvenuti," gesticola. "È bello avere menti fresche con cui condividere <planet>." I Remnant a bordo si riversano fuori dalla nave in fretta, ognuno con un pesante zaino di attrezzatura. Fanno un gesto di rispetto e si dirigono in direzioni diverse. Evidentemente hanno studiato le mappe prima di arrivare, perché sembrano tutti sapere dove andare. Diversi restano con Gavriil ad aiutare a scaricare il resto dell'attrezzatura, parte della quale sembra includere l'equipaggiamento principale di un fornitore.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|	"We have made good progress since you were here last. We have managed to take over control of life support systems in several wings of rooms, and now those are run entirely from our own systems. Aside from relieving a tiny amount of load from the station's power core, it also means that the station could fail completely and we would still have safe living quarters to serve as our base of operations."|1403|0
units.english: "We have made good progress since you were here last. We have managed to take over control of life support systems in several wings of rooms, and now those are run entirely from our own systems. Aside from relieving a tiny amount of load from the station's power core, it also means that the station could fail completely and we would still have safe living quarters to serve as our base of operations."
units.italian: "Abbiamo fatto buoni progressi da quando sei stato qui l'ultima volta. Siamo riusciti a prendere il controllo dei sistemi di supporto vitale in diverse ali di stanze, e ora quelle sono gestite interamente dai nostri sistemi. Oltre a togliere un pochino di carico dal nucleo energetico della stazione, questo significa anche che la stazione potrebbe cedere del tutto e noi avremmo comunque alloggi sicuri da usare come base operativa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|	They pause, and their gestures take on a tone of disgust. "Of course, we are working to avoid such a failure. But having multiple backup systems is the key to survival in hostile conditions."|1404|0
units.english: They pause, and their gestures take on a tone of disgust. "Of course, we are working to avoid such a failure. But having multiple backup systems is the key to survival in hostile conditions."
units.italian: Si fermano, e i loro gesti prendono un tono di disgusto. "Certo, stiamo lavorando per evitare un cedimento del genere. Ma avere più sistemi di riserva è la chiave per sopravvivere in condizioni ostili."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 30|	They look around at the few Remnant who have yet to vanish into the rest of the station. "Thank you for bringing more explorers." They hand you a data crystal. "I have already transmitted this data to Viminal, but I would appreciate it if you could take this to them to ensure there are no errors or data corruption in the transmission."|1405|0
units.english: They look around at the few Remnant who have yet to vanish into the rest of the station. "Thank you for bringing more explorers." They hand you a data crystal. "I have already transmitted this data to Viminal, but I would appreciate it if you could take this to them to ensure there are no errors or data corruption in the transmission."
units.italian: Si guardano intorno verso i pochi Remnant che non sono ancora svaniti nel resto della stazione. "Grazie per aver portato altri esploratori." Ti porgono un cristallo di dati. "Ho già trasmesso questi dati a Viminal, ma ti sarei grato se potessi portarglieli per assicurarti che non ci siano errori o corruzione dei dati nella trasmissione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 31|name|1411|0
units.english: Deliver data crystal to <planet>
units.italian: Consegna il cristallo di dati su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 31|description|1412|0
units.english: Gavriil has asked you to take a data crystal to <destination>.
units.italian: Gavriil ti ha chiesto di portare un cristallo di dati su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 31|Not knowing who to deliver the data crystal to, you take it to the information desk. The Remnant currently working there gestures that they have been expecting it and thanks you for delivering it. As you leave the information desk, your commlink chimes with a message from Prefect Chilia: he would like to speak with you, and is currently in the spaceport cafeteria.|1419|0
units.english: Not knowing who to deliver the data crystal to, you take it to the information desk. The Remnant currently working there gestures that they have been expecting it and thanks you for delivering it. As you leave the information desk, your commlink chimes with a message from Prefect Chilia: he would like to speak with you, and is currently in the spaceport cafeteria.
units.italian: Non sapendo a chi consegnare il cristallo di dati, lo porti al banco informazioni. Il Remnant che ci lavora in questo momento gesticola che lo stavano aspettando e ti ringrazia per la consegna. Mentre ti allontani dal banco informazioni, il commlink trilla con un messaggio del Prefetto Chilia: vorrebbe parlarti, e al momento si trova nella mensa dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|name|1424|0
units.english: Pick Up Refined Fuel
units.italian: Preleva il combustibile raffinato

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|description|1425|0
units.english: Chilia has asked you to pick up 58 tons of refined fuel from <planet> by <date>.
units.italian: Chilia ti ha chiesto di prelevare 58 tonnellate di combustibile raffinato su <planet> entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|blocked|1428|0
units.english: Chilia and Taely look excited about something, but when you inquire, they shake their heads and say you need to have earned their capital license before they can tell you more.
units.italian: Chilia e Taely sembrano eccitati per qualcosa, ma quando chiedi, scuotono la testa e dicono che devi esserti guadagnato la loro licenza di capitale prima che possano dirti di più.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|Chilia and Taely look excited about something when you find them in the cafeteria, but they indicate that your other work with Dusk will need to be completed before you can continue your work here.|1443|0
units.english: Chilia and Taely look excited about something when you find them in the cafeteria, but they indicate that your other work with Dusk will need to be completed before you can continue your work here.
units.italian: Chilia e Taely sembrano eccitati per qualcosa quando li trovi nella mensa, ma indicano che dovrai completare il tuo altro lavoro con Dusk prima di poter continuare il lavoro qui.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|Chilia is just collecting his tray from the counter when you step into the cafeteria. Seeing you enter, he picks up a second and nods toward a pair of open seats at a table with Taely and Dusk. "We are glad you could make it, <first>." Taely looks happy, brimming with contained energy. "It is an exciting day, Captain, but Dusk should lead." She nods to Dusk, who sets down his fork to gesture.|1446|0
units.english: Chilia is just collecting his tray from the counter when you step into the cafeteria. Seeing you enter, he picks up a second and nods toward a pair of open seats at a table with Taely and Dusk. "We are glad you could make it, <first>." Taely looks happy, brimming with contained energy. "It is an exciting day, Captain, but Dusk should lead." She nods to Dusk, who sets down his fork to gesture.
units.italian: Chilia sta giusto ritirando il vassoio dal bancone quando entri nella mensa. Vedendoti entrare, prende un secondo vassoio e ti fa un cenno verso un paio di posti liberi a un tavolo con Taely e Dusk. "Siamo contenti che tu sia riuscito a venire, <first>." Taely sembra felice, traboccante di energia trattenuta. "È un giorno emozionante, capitano, ma Dusk dovrebbe guidare la presentazione." Fa un cenno a Dusk, che posa la forchetta per gesticolare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	"While Gavriil has been making excellent progress setting up facilities on Ssil Vida, I have been working with a team of xenolinguists on deciphering the data we have collected so far. Based on Gavriil's recommendations, we have been focusing on the power distribution system."|1447|0
units.english: "While Gavriil has been making excellent progress setting up facilities on Ssil Vida, I have been working with a team of xenolinguists on deciphering the data we have collected so far. Based on Gavriil's recommendations, we have been focusing on the power distribution system."
units.italian: "Mentre Gavriil ha fatto progressi eccellenti allestendo strutture su Ssil Vida, io ho lavorato con una squadra di xenolinguisti alla decifratura dei dati raccolti finora. In base alle raccomandazioni di Gavriil, ci siamo concentrati sul sistema di distribuzione dell'energia."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	A hologram of Ssil Vida appears in the air over the table, then fades away to leave a large highlighted object with a network of lines reaching around the station. "As Gavriil has told you, the station's primary power source appears to be a massive fusion reactor. As best we can tell, it is quite a simple design, albeit one built for totally automated functioning and bigger than the largest reactors ever built by humanity. Unfortunately, it has consumed its entire fuel supply and is currently using up the last of the fuel it is capable of extracting by refining spent fuel. Our current estimates is that it is producing less than ten percent of its nominal power. This is sufficiently low that it has already ceased powering the majority of the station's systems." He gestures to Chilia.|1450|0
units.english: A hologram of Ssil Vida appears in the air over the table, then fades away to leave a large highlighted object with a network of lines reaching around the station. "As Gavriil has told you, the station's primary power source appears to be a massive fusion reactor. As best we can tell, it is quite a simple design, albeit one built for totally automated functioning and bigger than the largest reactors ever built by humanity. Unfortunately, it has consumed its entire fuel supply and is currently using up the last of the fuel it is capable of extracting by refining spent fuel. Our current estimates is that it is producing less than ten percent of its nominal power. This is sufficiently low that it has already ceased powering the majority of the station's systems." He gestures to Chilia.
units.italian: Un ologramma di Ssil Vida appare nell'aria sopra il tavolo, poi svanisce lasciando un grande oggetto evidenziato con una rete di linee che si estendono intorno alla stazione. "Come ti ha detto Gavriil, la fonte di energia principale della stazione sembra essere un enorme reattore a fusione. Per quanto possiamo capire, è un progetto piuttosto semplice, anche se costruito per un funzionamento totalmente automatico e più grande dei più grandi reattori mai costruiti dall'umanità. Purtroppo ha consumato tutta la sua riserva di combustibile e al momento sta esaurendo l'ultimo combustibile che riesce a estrarre raffinando quello esaurito. Le nostre stime attuali sono che produca meno del dieci per cento della sua energia nominale. È così poco che ha già smesso di alimentare la maggior parte dei sistemi della stazione." Fa un cenno a Chilia.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	"Based on our analysis, the reactor appears to use a very specific isotope. Whether it is truly needed or others would suffice is unknown, but for now we are inclined to provide it with an exact match. While we will be able to produce it eventually, it will take time that we do not have." The diagram of Ssil Vida vanishes and is replaced by a map of the galaxy, which focuses in on <system>, near the juncture of the Rim and the South. "Dato che vieni dallo spazio ancestrale e conosci meglio la gente di là, vorremmo che andassi fin là e riportassi 58 metri cubi di combustibile lavorato per il reattore. Puoi farlo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	A hologram of Ssil Vida appears in the air over the table, then fades away to leave a large highlighted object with a network of lines reaching around the station. units.italian: Un ologramma di Ssil Vida appare nell'aria sopra il tavolo, poi svanisce lasciando un grande oggetto evidenziato con una rete di linee che si estendono intorno alla stazione. "Come ti ha detto Gavriil, la fonte di energia principale della stazione sembra essere un enorme reattore a fusione. In base alle nostre scansioni iniziali, sembra corrispondere al reattore Sheragi che hai scoperto di recente, anche se su una scala enormemente più grande. Purtroppo ha consumato tutta la sua riserva di combustibile e al momento sta esaurendo l'ultimo combustibile che riesce a estrarre raffinando quello esaurito. Le nostre stime attuali sono che produca meno del dieci per cento della sua energia nominale. È così poco che ha già smesso di alimentare la maggior parte dei sistemi della stazione." Fa un cenno a Chilia.
