units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	All four of them look pleased, and exchange looks that seem to indicate they expected that response. Taely gestures with a thankful tone. "We appreciate your willingness to help us explore this mystery, <first>. Given that time is of the essence here, this seems like an opportune time to reveal a new ship that has just reached production." She stands up, and gestures for you to accompany her to the shipyard.|1461|0
units.english: All four of them look pleased, and exchange looks that seem to indicate they expected that response. Taely gestures with a thankful tone. "We appreciate your willingness to help us explore this mystery, <first>. Given that time is of the essence here, this seems like an opportune time to reveal a new ship that has just reached production." She stands up, and gestures for you to accompany her to the shipyard.
units.italian: Tutti e quattro sembrano contenti e si scambiano sguardi che sembrano indicare che si aspettavano quella risposta. Taely gesticola con tono riconoscente. "Apprezziamo la tua disponibilità ad aiutarci a esplorare questo mistero, <first>. Dato che il tempo qui è essenziale, questo sembra il momento opportuno per rivelare una nuova nave appena entrata in produzione." Si alza e ti fa cenno di accompagnarla al cantiere navale.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	There, crouched next to <ship>, is what you can only describe as a predator: it has long sleek lines with flared wings that resemble feathers, and a massive engine array that suggest incomparable mobility in a ship of its size. As you approach you can see several Remnant working around it. One gestures, and, as the ship extends a wing, the Remnant reaches out to make some minor adjustment then steps back. The ship then runs through a range of twisting motions, strongly resembling a raptor preening its feathers.|1462|0
units.english: There, crouched next to <ship>, is what you can only describe as a predator: it has long sleek lines with flared wings that resemble feathers, and a massive engine array that suggest incomparable mobility in a ship of its size. As you approach you can see several Remnant working around it. One gestures, and, as the ship extends a wing, the Remnant reaches out to make some minor adjustment then steps back. The ship then runs through a range of twisting motions, strongly resembling a raptor preening its feathers.
units.italian: Lì, accovacciato accanto alla <ship>, c'è quello che puoi solo definire un predatore: ha linee lunghe e slanciate con ali spiegate che assomigliano a piume, e un enorme apparato di motori che suggerisce una mobilità incomparabile per una nave della sua dimensione. Mentre ti avvicini vedi diversi Remnant che lavorano intorno. Uno gesticola, e mentre la nave distende un'ala, il Remnant allunga la mano per fare un piccolo aggiustamento e poi fa un passo indietro. La nave esegue poi una serie di movimenti contorti, che assomigliano molto a un rapace che si liscia le piume.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	Taely walks right up to its nose, and the ship crouches down so she can put her hand on it. "Captain <first>, I would like to introduce you to the Peregrine. It is the first new capital warship design we have built in over a century, and is the result of decades of work on my part as well as many others. Hopefully, it is the first of many new ships that are successful." She pauses before continuing. "Initially, they will be assigned directly to specific captains, but they will eventually be available for requisition normally."|1463|0
units.english: Taely walks right up to its nose, and the ship crouches down so she can put her hand on it. "Captain <first>, I would like to introduce you to the Peregrine. It is the first new capital warship design we have built in over a century, and is the result of decades of work on my part as well as many others. Hopefully, it is the first of many new ships that are successful." She pauses before continuing. "Initially, they will be assigned directly to specific captains, but they will eventually be available for requisition normally."
units.italian: Taely va dritta fino al suo naso, e la nave si accovaccia perché lei possa appoggiarci la mano. "Capitano <first>, vorrei presentarti il Peregrine. È il primo nuovo progetto di nave da guerra capitale che costruiamo in oltre un secolo, ed è il risultato di decenni di lavoro mio e di molti altri. Speriamo che sia la prima di molte nuove navi di successo." Si ferma prima di continuare. "All'inizio saranno assegnati direttamente a capitani specifici, ma alla fine saranno disponibili per la requisizione normale."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	"Looks great. Let's fly!"|1465|0
units.english: "Looks great. Let's fly!"
units.italian: "Ha un bell'aspetto. Voliamo!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	"What sort of ship is it?"|1467|0
units.english: "What sort of ship is it?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di nave è?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	Taely gestures in reverence. "It is what we term a liveship." She scowls at you. "And before you start thinking about ships made of big piles of flesh and ooze, this is obviously not that." She runs her hand along the ship, obviously quite smooth and solid. "Liveships, as we are calling them, are spaceships that have a sufficient degree of self-awareness and self-control to be deemed alive. They are manufactured and have energy and fuel requirements just like any other ship. Likewise, they are largely made of materials similar to what you are familiar with. But they are conscious. They can move and flex in ways that would be impossible to precisely control with servos and traditional position reporting. They can feel where each tendril is as surely as most people can tell where their hand is, and each ripple of a wormhole vortex is as perceptible to them as the crest of a sand dune would be to you or I."|1468|0
units.english: Taely gestures in reverence. "It is what we term a liveship." She scowls at you. "And before you start thinking about ships made of big piles of flesh and ooze, this is obviously not that." She runs her hand along the ship, obviously quite smooth and solid. "Liveships, as we are calling them, are spaceships that have a sufficient degree of self-awareness and self-control to be deemed alive. They are manufactured and have energy and fuel requirements just like any other ship. Likewise, they are largely made of materials similar to what you are familiar with. But they are conscious. They can move and flex in ways that would be impossible to precisely control with servos and traditional position reporting. They can feel where each tendril is as surely as most people can tell where their hand is, and each ripple of a wormhole vortex is as perceptible to them as the crest of a sand dune would be to you or I."
units.italian: Taely gesticola con reverenza. "È quello che chiamiamo una nave viva." Ti guarda accigliata. "E prima che tu cominci a pensare a navi fatte di grandi mucchi di carne e melma, ovviamente non è questo." Passa la mano lungo la nave, evidentemente liscia e solida. "Le navi vive, come le chiamiamo, sono navi spaziali che hanno un grado sufficiente di autoconsapevolezza e autocontrollo da poter essere considerate vive. Sono fabbricate e hanno requisiti di energia e combustibile come qualsiasi altra nave. Allo stesso modo sono in gran parte fatte di materiali simili a quelli che conosci. Ma sono coscienti. Possono muoversi e flettersi in modi impossibili da controllare con precisione tramite servomeccanismi e la tradizionale segnalazione di posizione. Sanno dove si trova ogni tentacolo con la stessa sicurezza con cui la maggior parte delle persone sa dove si trova la propria mano, e ogni increspatura di un vortice di cunicolo è per loro percettibile come la cresta di una duna lo sarebbe per te o per me."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	She turns to you and pulls up a display, listing off various statistics. "From a technical standpoint, the Peregrine class starship is classified as a medium warship, built along the lines of the fast-attack cruisers from earlier eras. While it does not have the thickest armor or shields we could have installed, it makes up for it in unrivaled mobility and a neural system that has been hardened against some of the effects that could slow it down. It is also, so far, the largest production ship that has built-in cloaking."|1469|0
units.english: She turns to you and pulls up a display, listing off various statistics. "From a technical standpoint, the Peregrine class starship is classified as a medium warship, built along the lines of the fast-attack cruisers from earlier eras. While it does not have the thickest armor or shields we could have installed, it makes up for it in unrivaled mobility and a neural system that has been hardened against some of the effects that could slow it down. It is also, so far, the largest production ship that has built-in cloaking."
units.italian: Si volta verso di te e apre un display, elencando varie statistiche. "Da un punto di vista tecnico, la nave di classe Peregrine è classificata come nave da guerra media, costruita sulla linea degli incrociatori d'attacco rapido delle epoche precedenti. Anche se non ha l'armatura o gli scudi più spessi che avremmo potuto installare, compensa con una mobilità senza pari e un sistema neurale indurito contro alcuni degli effetti che potrebbero rallentarla. È anche, finora, la più grande nave di produzione con occultamento integrato."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|As if on cue, the ship vanishes from sight. There is a brief rustle and a whoosh of air, and the ship reappears on the other side of you. Several of the Remnant working on it look amused, then relocate to continue their tasks. Taely gestures amusement as well and continues. "Given your recent work with Plume, it may also be relevant to you that the Peregrine is what we term a 'gaslined' starship; meaning it is built to not only fly in atmosphere but also handle both the pressure and conditions found in the depths of gas giants and other high-pressure worlds."|1470|0
units.english: As if on cue, the ship vanishes from sight. There is a brief rustle and a whoosh of air, and the ship reappears on the other side of you. Several of the Remnant working on it look amused, then relocate to continue their tasks. Taely gestures amusement as well and continues. "Given your recent work with Plume, it may also be relevant to you that the Peregrine is what we term a 'gaslined' starship; meaning it is built to not only fly in atmosphere but also handle both the pressure and conditions found in the depths of gas giants and other high-pressure worlds."
units.italian: Come se fosse stato un segnale, la nave svanisce alla vista. Si sente un breve fruscio e un sibilo d'aria, e la nave riappare dall'altra parte rispetto a te. Diversi Remnant che ci lavorano sembrano divertiti, poi si spostano per continuare i loro compiti. Anche Taely gesticola divertita e continua. "Dato il tuo recente lavoro con Plume, potrebbe interessarti anche che il Peregrine è quello che chiamiamo una nave stellare 'con rivestimento per gas'; significa che è costruita non solo per volare in atmosfera, ma anche per sopportare sia la pressione sia le condizioni che si trovano nelle profondità dei giganti gassosi e di altri mondi ad alta pressione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|label|1471|0
units.english: lets fly
units.italian: lets fly

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	Taely smiles, and continues. "You should be able to take off shortly, but Chilia does have some final comments on this mission."|1472|0
units.english: Taely smiles, and continues. "You should be able to take off shortly, but Chilia does have some final comments on this mission."
units.italian: Taely sorride e continua. "Dovresti poter decollare a breve, ma Chilia ha qualche commento finale su questa missione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	She gestures to him, and he steps to the front. "Given recent events in ancestral space, the authorities are understandably suspicious of large volumes of refined nuclear fuel being transported around. Likewise, it would be extremely problematic if someone managed to scan the Peregrine. As such, you will need to avoid being scanned."|1473|0
units.english: She gestures to him, and he steps to the front. "Given recent events in ancestral space, the authorities are understandably suspicious of large volumes of refined nuclear fuel being transported around. Likewise, it would be extremely problematic if someone managed to scan the Peregrine. As such, you will need to avoid being scanned."
units.italian: Fa un cenno verso di lui, e Chilia si fa avanti. "Dati i recenti avvenimenti nello spazio ancestrale, le autorità sono comprensibilmente sospettose di grandi volumi di combustibile nucleare raffinato trasportati in giro. Allo stesso modo, sarebbe estremamente problematico se qualcuno riuscisse a scansionare il Peregrine. Perciò dovrai evitare di essere scansionato."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	He taps on his commlink. "We have inserted an order for the material into the hyperspace communication system under the company name 'Solar Winds Logistics Ltd.' The miners on <planet> are to have the shipment ready to load at a mining site just outside of the spaceport, far enough away to avoid the standard arrival and departure scans."|1474|0
units.english: He taps on his commlink. "We have inserted an order for the material into the hyperspace communication system under the company name 'Solar Winds Logistics Ltd.' The miners on <planet> are to have the shipment ready to load at a mining site just outside of the spaceport, far enough away to avoid the standard arrival and departure scans."
units.italian: Tocca il suo commlink. "Abbiamo inserito un ordine per il materiale nel sistema di comunicazione iperspaziale sotto il nome della società 'Solar Winds Logistics Ltd.' I minatori su <planet> devono avere la spedizione pronta da caricare in un sito estrattivo appena fuori dallo spazioporto, abbastanza lontano da evitare le scansioni standard di arrivo e partenza."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	"Sounds good. Time to go."|1476|0
units.english: "Sounds good. Time to go."
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene. È ora di andare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	"What about people seeing the ship?"|1478|0
units.english: "What about people seeing the ship?"
units.italian: "E la gente che vede la nave?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	Chilia grins. "Fortunately for us, the diversity of human preference lends itself to our cause. While there may be only a handful of ships available for sale, spaceships are a surprisingly diverse and unregulated industry. As such, shipyards have carried on the tradition dating back to the earliest of vehicles: if someone has the wealth to pay for it, there is a shipwright willing to build it.|1479|0
units.english: Chilia grins. "Fortunately for us, the diversity of human preference lends itself to our cause. While there may be only a handful of ships available for sale, spaceships are a surprisingly diverse and unregulated industry. As such, shipyards have carried on the tradition dating back to the earliest of vehicles: if someone has the wealth to pay for it, there is a shipwright willing to build it.
units.italian: Chilia sogghigna. "Per nostra fortuna, la diversità dei gusti umani gioca a nostro favore. Anche se le navi in vendita potrebbero essere poche, le navi spaziali sono un settore sorprendentemente vario e poco regolamentato. Perciò i cantieri hanno portato avanti la tradizione che risale ai primi veicoli: se qualcuno ha i mezzi per pagarla, c'è un costruttore navale disposto a costruirla.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	"In our time observing Ancestral space, we have seen replicas in flight of every spaceship that has ever graced popular culture or a media production. While many are barely able to manage interplanetary travel, a surprising number are in use as fully functional starships plying the hyperlanes. Given the similarity between our ships and those of certain productions, we are not concerned with being seen - only with being scanned."|1480|0
units.english: "In our time observing Ancestral space, we have seen replicas in flight of every spaceship that has ever graced popular culture or a media production. While many are barely able to manage interplanetary travel, a surprising number are in use as fully functional starships plying the hyperlanes. Given the similarity between our ships and those of certain productions, we are not concerned with being seen - only with being scanned."
units.italian: "Nel nostro tempo passato a osservare lo spazio Ancestrale, abbiamo visto in volo repliche di ogni nave spaziale che abbia mai calcato la cultura popolare o una produzione mediatica. Mentre molte riescono a malapena a fare viaggi interplanetari, un numero sorprendente è in uso come navi stellari pienamente funzionanti che percorrono le corsie iper. Data la somiglianza tra le nostre navi e quelle di certe produzioni, non ci preoccupa essere visti, solo essere scansionati."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 32|	A hatch opens on the Peregrine, and all the workers quickly finish their tasks and stow their equipment onboard. "Ready for departure when you are, Captain!" calls one from the hatch.|1482|0
units.english: A hatch opens on the Peregrine, and all the workers quickly finish their tasks and stow their equipment onboard. "Ready for departure when you are, Captain!" calls one from the hatch.
units.italian: Un portello si apre sul Peregrine, e tutti i lavoratori finiscono in fretta i loro compiti e ripongono l'attrezzatura a bordo. "Pronti a partire quando vuoi, capitano!" chiama uno dal portello.

units.italian: Hai rifiutato una missione essenziale dei Remnant, e questo conclude la campagna dei Remnant. Se non era tua intenzione, potresti voler ricaricare.

units.italian: Per la prossima missione della campagna dei Remnant devi avere almeno 58 unità di spazio nel carico libere.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 33|Your reception is as friendly as <origin>'s reputation suggests: no one is there to meet you, and no one arrives to help load the cargo. All that greets you is a forlorn security console near the pile of crates and a posted statement directing ships to depart as soon as they finish loading. You use the code Chilia had sent to unlock the crates, load the <ship>, and get ready to head to <planet>.|1510|0
units.english: Your reception is as friendly as <origin>'s reputation suggests: no one is there to meet you, and no one arrives to help load the cargo. All that greets you is a forlorn security console near the pile of crates and a posted statement directing ships to depart as soon as they finish loading. You use the code Chilia had sent to unlock the crates, load the <ship>, and get ready to head to <planet>.
units.italian: La tua accoglienza è amichevole come suggerisce la reputazione di <origin>: nessuno è lì ad aspettarti e nessuno arriva ad aiutare a caricare il carico. Tutto ciò che ti accoglie è una console di sicurezza desolata accanto alla pila di casse e un avviso affisso che invita le navi a partire appena finito il carico. Usi il codice che Chilia ti aveva mandato per aprire le casse, carichi la <ship> e ti prepari a dirigerti verso <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 33|	As you are completing your checks, your sensors alert you to the arrival of a small fleet that seems to be maintaining orbit over this area. It looks like you might have to take steps to avoid observers right away.|1511|0
units.english: As you are completing your checks, your sensors alert you to the arrival of a small fleet that seems to be maintaining orbit over this area. It looks like you might have to take steps to avoid observers right away.
units.italian: Mentre completi i controlli, i sensori ti avvisano dell'arrivo di una piccola flotta che sembra mantenere l'orbita sopra questa zona. Sembra che potresti dover prendere provvedimenti per evitare osservatori da subito.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 33|dialog|1514|0
units.english: Your comms pick up a crackling broadcast: "Don't know who you are, but there's a bounty on unaffiliated people picking up large volumes of weapons grade materials that I intend to collect!"
units.italian: Le comunicazioni captano una trasmissione crepitante: "Non so chi tu sia, ma c'è una taglia su chiunque non sia affiliato e prelevi grandi volumi di materiali di qualità militare, e intendo incassarla!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 33|When you contact <planet> to confirm where to unload your cargo you are greeted by Dusk, who directs you to a docking bay closer to the main reactor. As you open the hatch, though, it is Gavriil and a group of Remnant with lifters waiting. They welcome you cheerfully, but they definitely seem in a rush to get the processed fuel unloaded and shuttled into the depths of the station. Once the last unit is off your ship, Gavriil slows down enough to thank you for the prompt delivery, but apologizes as they rush off as there is not much time left. Their parting gesture suggests you talk to Dusk up in the control room.|1530|0
units.english: When you contact <planet> to confirm where to unload your cargo you are greeted by Dusk, who directs you to a docking bay closer to the main reactor. As you open the hatch, though, it is Gavriil and a group of Remnant with lifters waiting. They welcome you cheerfully, but they definitely seem in a rush to get the processed fuel unloaded and shuttled into the depths of the station. Once the last unit is off your ship, Gavriil slows down enough to thank you for the prompt delivery, but apologizes as they rush off as there is not much time left. Their parting gesture suggests you talk to Dusk up in the control room.
units.italian: Quando contatti <planet> per confermare dove scaricare il carico, ti risponde Dusk, che ti indirizza a una baia di attracco più vicina al reattore principale. Quando apri il portello, però, ci sono Gavriil e un gruppo di Remnant con i sollevatori che aspettano. Ti accolgono con allegria, ma sembrano decisamente di fretta di scaricare il combustibile lavorato e portarlo nelle profondità della stazione. Quando l'ultima unità è fuori dalla nave, Gavriil rallenta abbastanza da ringraziarti per la consegna puntuale, ma si scusa mentre corrono via perché non resta molto tempo. Il loro gesto di commiato suggerisce di parlare con Dusk nella sala di controllo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 34|name|1536|0
units.english: Observe changes in Postverta
units.italian: Osserva i cambiamenti a Postverta

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 34|description|1537|0
units.english: Something is going on outside, and Dusk would like you to take a look.
units.italian: Sta succedendo qualcosa là fuori, e Dusk vorrebbe che dessi un'occhiata.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 34|Up in the control station Dusk and a small team of Remnant are busily working at a bunch of consoles. Alarms blink and are quickly dealt with, only to have new ones appear elsewhere. There is so much motion that it seems like there are twice as many of them. From a glance at the readings, it appears you brought the shipment of fuel just in time: the Aeon Cell is overloaded trying to take over for the fusion reactor, and most of their efforts have been directed toward carefully orchestrating rolling brown outs across the systems to keep everything minimally functional.|1543|0
units.english: Up in the control station Dusk and a small team of Remnant are busily working at a bunch of consoles. Alarms blink and are quickly dealt with, only to have new ones appear elsewhere. There is so much motion that it seems like there are twice as many of them. From a glance at the readings, it appears you brought the shipment of fuel just in time: the Aeon Cell is overloaded trying to take over for the fusion reactor, and most of their efforts have been directed toward carefully orchestrating rolling brown outs across the systems to keep everything minimally functional.
units.italian: Nella stazione di controllo, Dusk e una piccola squadra di Remnant lavorano indaffarati a un mucchio di console. Gli allarmi lampeggiano e vengono gestiti in fretta, solo perché ne compaiano altri altrove. C'è così tanto movimento che sembrano essere il doppio. Dando un'occhiata alle letture, sembra che tu abbia portato la spedizione di combustibile appena in tempo: la Cella Aeon è sovraccarica nel tentativo di sostituire il reattore a fusione, e la maggior parte dei loro sforzi è stata indirizzata a orchestrare con cura interruzioni a rotazione nei sistemi per mantenere tutto minimamente funzionante.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 34|	Gavriil suddenly appears on a viewscreen, gesturing that the fuel injection process has begun, and Dusk anxiously scans a number of readings. There is a moment of stillness, then readings suddenly start to climb. The Remnant quickly recalibrate their sensors to the larger volumes of power being handled, and the readings continue to push the top of the charts upwards. Section by section, whole banks of indicators flicker and fade out. A minute or two later, and the last display ceases to indicate any problems remaining in the power grid.|1544|0
units.english: Gavriil suddenly appears on a viewscreen, gesturing that the fuel injection process has begun, and Dusk anxiously scans a number of readings. There is a moment of stillness, then readings suddenly start to climb. The Remnant quickly recalibrate their sensors to the larger volumes of power being handled, and the readings continue to push the top of the charts upwards. Section by section, whole banks of indicators flicker and fade out. A minute or two later, and the last display ceases to indicate any problems remaining in the power grid.
units.italian: All'improvviso Gavriil compare su uno schermo, gesticolando che il processo di iniezione del combustibile è iniziato, e Dusk scorre ansiosamente una serie di letture. C'è un momento di immobilità, poi le letture cominciano improvvisamente a salire. I Remnant ricalibrano in fretta i sensori ai volumi maggiori di energia gestita, e le letture continuano a spingere verso l'alto il fondo scala. Sezione dopo sezione, interi banchi di indicatori tremolano e si spengono. Un minuto o due dopo, l'ultimo display smette di segnalare problemi rimasti nella rete energetica.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 34|	Dusk turns towards you and the team with a satisfied gesture just beginning when there is a sudden shift as if everything had just went sideways. You almost feel like you can see a brief ripple, but it vanishes before you can focus on it. You are left with a feeling that something has changed. At the same time, the proximity sensors and systems monitoring the surrounding system light up. Someone looks up from a console. "The system is alive, Dusk! All those ghost life signs we were picking up just became much more solid!" Another gestures in clipped, fast tones. "And we have several large masses that have appeared as well. They look to be planetary in scale, but the readings seem to indicate something a bit more nebulous."|1545|0
units.english: Dusk turns towards you and the team with a satisfied gesture just beginning when there is a sudden shift as if everything had just went sideways. You almost feel like you can see a brief ripple, but it vanishes before you can focus on it. You are left with a feeling that something has changed. At the same time, the proximity sensors and systems monitoring the surrounding system light up. Someone looks up from a console. "The system is alive, Dusk! All those ghost life signs we were picking up just became much more solid!" Another gestures in clipped, fast tones. "And we have several large masses that have appeared as well. They look to be planetary in scale, but the readings seem to indicate something a bit more nebulous."
units.italian: Dusk si volta verso di te e la squadra con un gesto soddisfatto che appena comincia, quando c'è uno spostamento improvviso come se tutto fosse appena andato di traverso. Ti sembra quasi di vedere una breve increspatura, ma svanisce prima che tu possa metterla a fuoco. Ti resta la sensazione che qualcosa sia cambiato. Allo stesso tempo, i sensori di prossimità e i sistemi che monitorano il sistema circostante si accendono. Qualcuno alza lo sguardo da una console. "Il sistema è vivo, Dusk! Tutti quei segni di vita fantasma che captavamo sono appena diventati molto più solidi!" Un altro gesticola con toni rapidi e secchi. "E sono comparse anche diverse grandi masse. Sembrano di scala planetaria, ma le letture sembrano indicare qualcosa di un po' più nebuloso."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 34|	Dusk looks around, and then gestures. "Captain <first>, please go investigate what is going on out there. Just take a good look around and then report back."|1546|0
units.english: Dusk looks around, and then gestures. "Captain <first>, please go investigate what is going on out there. Just take a good look around and then report back."
units.italian: Dusk si guarda intorno, poi gesticola. "Capitano <first>, per favore vai a indagare cosa sta succedendo là fuori. Dai solo una buona occhiata in giro e poi riferisci."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 34|Just like the Remnant said, the system appears to be full of life. Where once there was just asteroids and a fairly empty system, there is now life signs everywhere. As you dodge among the asteroids, you note that most of them appear to have something growing on them: plants. Moss or fungus might be a better word, although you are fairly certain that nothing in the current classifications of life can adequately categorize what you can see outside. The sudden appearance of all this life is only compounded when your sensors light up to notify you that it is tracking several flocks of void sprites.|1551|0
units.english: Just like the Remnant said, the system appears to be full of life. Where once there was just asteroids and a fairly empty system, there is now life signs everywhere. As you dodge among the asteroids, you note that most of them appear to have something growing on them: plants. Moss or fungus might be a better word, although you are fairly certain that nothing in the current classifications of life can adequately categorize what you can see outside. The sudden appearance of all this life is only compounded when your sensors light up to notify you that it is tracking several flocks of void sprites.
units.italian: Proprio come dicevano i Remnant, il sistema sembra pieno di vita. Dove una volta c'erano solo asteroidi e un sistema piuttosto vuoto, ora ci sono segni di vita ovunque. Mentre schivi tra gli asteroidi, noti che la maggior parte sembra avere qualcosa che ci cresce sopra: piante. Muschio o funghi sarebbe forse un termine migliore, anche se sei abbastanza certo che nulla nelle attuali classificazioni della vita possa catalogare adeguatamente quello che vedi fuori. La comparsa improvvisa di tutta questa vita è solo accentuata quando i sensori si accendono per avvisarti che stanno tracciando diversi stormi di spettri del vuoto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 34|	As you move away from the station you continue to spot signs of life and activity everywhere: flitting among the rocks, soaring along the solar winds, and hunting amongst clouds. What is unclear, however, is where it came from. The only hint might be in the fact that your ship instruments report a sudden spike in the ambient energy in the surrounding area.|1552|0
units.english: As you move away from the station you continue to spot signs of life and activity everywhere: flitting among the rocks, soaring along the solar winds, and hunting amongst clouds. What is unclear, however, is where it came from. The only hint might be in the fact that your ship instruments report a sudden spike in the ambient energy in the surrounding area.
units.italian: Allontanandoti dalla stazione continui a scorgere segni di vita e attività ovunque: che svolazzano tra le rocce, si librano lungo i venti solari e cacciano tra le nuvole. Quello che non è chiaro, però, è da dove venga. L'unico indizio potrebbe essere il fatto che gli strumenti della nave riportano un picco improvviso di energia ambientale nella zona circostante.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 34|Back on the station Dusk, Gavriil, and many of the Remnant on the station meet you in the docking bay. Dusk and several of the others just came back from walking out on the hull of <origin>, and they report seeing void sprites passing close to the station. They quickly pull the data from your ship sensors and throw it up on a holographic display. Everyone gathers around, intently drinking in the data and footage. They stand, stare, and ponder with intense concentration as the data continues to stream in from the station.|1558|0
units.english: Back on the station Dusk, Gavriil, and many of the Remnant on the station meet you in the docking bay. Dusk and several of the others just came back from walking out on the hull of <origin>, and they report seeing void sprites passing close to the station. They quickly pull the data from your ship sensors and throw it up on a holographic display. Everyone gathers around, intently drinking in the data and footage. They stand, stare, and ponder with intense concentration as the data continues to stream in from the station.
units.italian: Di nuovo sulla stazione, Dusk, Gavriil e molti dei Remnant presenti ti aspettano nella baia di attracco. Dusk e diversi altri sono appena tornati da una passeggiata sullo scafo di <origin>, e riferiscono di aver visto spettri del vuoto passare vicino alla stazione. Estraggono in fretta i dati dai sensori della tua nave e li proiettano su un display olografico. Tutti si radunano intorno, bevendo con attenzione i dati e i filmati. Restano lì, fissano e riflettono con intensa concentrazione mentre i dati continuano ad arrivare dalla stazione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 34|	Without warning, something clicks in your mind. Suddenly there is a hum of hundreds of conversations crowding your thoughts and a momentary feeling of seeing the system through thousands of eyes. You feel a wave of curiosity, and a glimpse of <origin> as it might have been once - shiny and gleaming. The image ages like a fast-forward video of untold thousands of orbits as the station wears and the sky changes around it. Then the image freezes on what appears to be the present day. A feeling of appreciation replaces the sense of curiosity, followed by a blurry image of the <ship> leaving the station and heading in a dozen different directions simultaneously, as if watching it splinter into ghosts.|1559|0
units.english: Without warning, something clicks in your mind. Suddenly there is a hum of hundreds of conversations crowding your thoughts and a momentary feeling of seeing the system through thousands of eyes. You feel a wave of curiosity, and a glimpse of <origin> as it might have been once - shiny and gleaming. The image ages like a fast-forward video of untold thousands of orbits as the station wears and the sky changes around it. Then the image freezes on what appears to be the present day. A feeling of appreciation replaces the sense of curiosity, followed by a blurry image of the <ship> leaving the station and heading in a dozen different directions simultaneously, as if watching it splinter into ghosts.
units.italian: Senza preavviso, qualcosa scatta nella tua mente. All'improvviso c'è un brusio di centinaia di conversazioni che affolla i tuoi pensieri e una sensazione momentanea di vedere il sistema attraverso migliaia di occhi. Senti un'onda di curiosità e intravedi <origin> com'era forse un tempo: scintillante e splendente. L'immagine invecchia come un video accelerato di innumerevoli migliaia di orbite mentre la stazione si consuma e il cielo cambia intorno. Poi l'immagine si blocca su quello che sembra il presente. Una sensazione di apprezzamento sostituisce il senso di curiosità, seguita da un'immagine sfocata della <ship> che lascia la stazione e si dirige simultaneamente in una dozzina di direzioni diverse, come se la vedessi scomporsi in fantasmi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 34|	The final image is of the creature the Remnant termed the "Ember Node," floating in space. The image splinters the same way as the image of your ship, and fragments into multiple ghosts of itself that vanish into a rift of energy. The sense of curiosity returns, and then there is another click, and suddenly your mind is your own once again.|1560|0
units.english: The final image is of the creature the Remnant termed the "Ember Node," floating in space. The image splinters the same way as the image of your ship, and fragments into multiple ghosts of itself that vanish into a rift of energy. The sense of curiosity returns, and then there is another click, and suddenly your mind is your own once again.
units.italian: L'immagine finale è quella della creatura che i Remnant hanno chiamato "Nodo di Braci", sospesa nello spazio. L'immagine si scompone come quella della tua nave, e si frammenta in più fantasmi di se stessa che svaniscono in una frattura di energia. Il senso di curiosità ritorna, poi c'è un altro scatto, e all'improvviso la tua mente è di nuovo tua.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|name|1566|0
units.english: Postverta system sweep
units.italian: Pattugliamento del sistema di Postverta

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|description|1567|0
units.english: Conduct a sweep of nearby systems and return to <origin>.
units.italian: Esegui un pattugliamento dei sistemi vicini e torna a <origin>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|The Remnant have a shocked expression, and a couple of them are looking dazed. Most, however, seem to be handling the incursion fairly well. Dusk gestures eagerly to you. "Good to see you recovered quickly, <first>. We will take care of everyone here - we need you out there. Go do a sweep through each of the surrounding systems, and see if you can get a signal to any of the Remnant worlds. Our communicators have all lost connection, as have the isolated backups. So we need to re-establish communication promptly." He shakes his head. "I love meeting new beings, but they always manage to surprise."|1578|0
units.english: The Remnant have a shocked expression, and a couple of them are looking dazed. Most, however, seem to be handling the incursion fairly well. Dusk gestures eagerly to you. "Good to see you recovered quickly, <first>. We will take care of everyone here - we need you out there. Go do a sweep through each of the surrounding systems, and see if you can get a signal to any of the Remnant worlds. Our communicators have all lost connection, as have the isolated backups. So we need to re-establish communication promptly." He shakes his head. "I love meeting new beings, but they always manage to surprise."
units.italian: I Remnant hanno un'espressione sconvolta, e un paio sembrano storditi. La maggior parte, però, sembra gestire l'incursione piuttosto bene. Dusk ti fa un gesto impaziente. "Sono contento di vedere che ti sei ripreso in fretta, <first>. Ci occuperemo noi di tutti quelli qui: ci servi là fuori. Vai a fare un pattugliamento di ciascuno dei sistemi circostanti e vedi se riesci a metterti in contatto con qualcuno dei mondi dei Remnant. I nostri comunicatori hanno perso tutti la connessione, e così le copie di riserva isolate. Quindi dobbiamo ristabilire subito le comunicazioni." Scuote la testa. "Adoro incontrare nuovi esseri, ma riescono sempre a sorprendere."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|You have successfully visited all the nearby systems. Time to report back to <origin>.|1582|0
units.english: You have successfully visited all the nearby systems. Time to report back to <origin>.
units.italian: Hai visitato con successo tutti i sistemi vicini. È ora di riferire a <origin>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|Back in the control room the Remnant appear to have regained their composure. Remnant move quickly from station to station, and every sensor and tool is in use. It is as if the Remnant are afraid everything is going to vanish any moment. Which, you realize, might actually happen. You find Gavriil carefully tending a console, and they look up as you approach. "The Embers guided you back, I see. How does the outside world fare?"|1585|0
units.english: Back in the control room the Remnant appear to have regained their composure. Remnant move quickly from station to station, and every sensor and tool is in use. It is as if the Remnant are afraid everything is going to vanish any moment. Which, you realize, might actually happen. You find Gavriil carefully tending a console, and they look up as you approach. "The Embers guided you back, I see. How does the outside world fare?"
units.italian: Nella sala di controllo i Remnant sembrano aver ritrovato la calma. Si spostano in fretta da una postazione all'altra, e ogni sensore e strumento è in uso. È come se i Remnant temessero che tutto possa svanire da un momento all'altro. Il che, ti rendi conto, potrebbe davvero accadere. Trovi Gavriil che si occupa con cura di una console, e alza lo sguardo mentre ti avvicini. "Le Braci ti hanno guidato al ritorno, vedo. Come se la passa il mondo fuori?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	They listen intently as you described your flight through the surrounding systems, and nods when you mention that your navigation system is reporting no connections to the rest of the Ember Waste. Even predictions as to jump drive performance indicate no valid jumps.|1586|0
units.english: They listen intently as you described your flight through the surrounding systems, and nods when you mention that your navigation system is reporting no connections to the rest of the Ember Waste. Even predictions as to jump drive performance indicate no valid jumps.
units.italian: Ti ascoltano con attenzione mentre descrivi il tuo volo attraverso i sistemi circostanti, e annuiscono quando accenni che il tuo sistema di navigazione non segnala collegamenti con il resto della Distesa di Braci. Persino le previsioni sulle prestazioni del motore di salto non indicano salti validi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	"No connections whatsoever?" Gavriil looks thoughtful. "That actually makes sense." They gesture at a display of the area. "As best our sensors can pick up, the universe beyond this pocket of the Ember Waste just does not exist."|1587|0
units.english: "No connections whatsoever?" Gavriil looks thoughtful. "That actually makes sense." They gesture at a display of the area. "As best our sensors can pick up, the universe beyond this pocket of the Ember Waste just does not exist."
units.italian: "Nessun collegamento di alcun tipo?" Gavriil resta pensieroso. "In realtà ha senso." Gesticolano verso un display della zona. "Per quanto i nostri sensori riescano a captare, l'universo oltre questa sacca della Distesa di Braci semplicemente non esiste."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	They quickly continue. "Of course, we can see it out there. But it is like looking through a very thin film." Gavriil looks thoughtful. "The current leading theory is that we are in some kind of dimensional bubble. A pocket dimension of sorts. But we have not yet reached a consensus."|1588|0
units.english: They quickly continue. "Of course, we can see it out there. But it is like looking through a very thin film." Gavriil looks thoughtful. "The current leading theory is that we are in some kind of dimensional bubble. A pocket dimension of sorts. But we have not yet reached a consensus."
units.italian: Continuano in fretta. "Certo, riusciamo a vederlo là fuori. Ma è come guardare attraverso una pellicola molto sottile." Gavriil resta pensieroso. "La teoria principale al momento è che siamo in una specie di bolla dimensionale. Una dimensione tasca, per così dire. Ma non abbiamo ancora raggiunto un consenso."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	"What happened to us? Did we all see the same thing?"|1590|0
units.english: "What happened to us? Did we all see the same thing?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ci è successo? Abbiamo visto tutti la stessa cosa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	"Where did those feelings and images come from?"|1591|0
units.english: "Where did those feelings and images come from?"
units.italian: "Da dove venivano quelle sensazioni e quelle immagini?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	Gavriil frowns in thought. "Based on our initial survey, each person had a slightly different experience. We think that everyone had basically the same event, but as it was a series of impressions, images, and feelings, each person picked up on different aspects of it."|1592|0
units.english: Gavriil frowns in thought. "Based on our initial survey, each person had a slightly different experience. We think that everyone had basically the same event, but as it was a series of impressions, images, and feelings, each person picked up on different aspects of it."
units.italian: Gavriil aggrotta la fronte pensieroso. "In base alla nostra indagine iniziale, ogni persona ha avuto un'esperienza leggermente diversa. Pensiamo che tutti abbiano vissuto in fondo lo stesso evento, ma dato che era una serie di impressioni, immagini e sensazioni, ognuno ha colto aspetti diversi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	Their gestures take on a confident tone. "Which makes sense, since our life experiences shape our perceptions. Still, as to what it was..." They pause, gathering their thoughts. "Our best guess is that this was first contact with some sort of entity." They grin at that. "I know, stating the obvious. But anyway, Dusk thinks that it might be some sort of solitary entity, as it did not use words or meanings, despite having access to our minds. As such, it uses internals to convey meaning instead of words." They glance at a map of the system. "There is, however, no indication as to where it came from."|1593|0
units.english: Their gestures take on a confident tone. "Which makes sense, since our life experiences shape our perceptions. Still, as to what it was..." They pause, gathering their thoughts. "Our best guess is that this was first contact with some sort of entity." They grin at that. "I know, stating the obvious. But anyway, Dusk thinks that it might be some sort of solitary entity, as it did not use words or meanings, despite having access to our minds. As such, it uses internals to convey meaning instead of words." They glance at a map of the system. "There is, however, no indication as to where it came from."
units.italian: I loro gesti prendono un tono sicuro. "Il che ha senso, dato che le nostre esperienze di vita modellano le nostre percezioni. Resta il fatto che cos'era..." Si fermano, raccogliendo i pensieri. "La nostra ipotesi migliore è che sia stato un primo contatto con una specie di entità." Sogghignano. "Lo so, sto dicendo l'ovvio. Ma comunque, Dusk pensa che possa essere una specie di entità solitaria, dato che non ha usato parole o significati, pur avendo accesso alle nostre menti. Perciò usa elementi interni per trasmettere il significato invece delle parole." Danno un'occhiata a una mappa del sistema. "Non c'è però alcuna indicazione di dove sia venuta."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	"How do we get back?"|1595|0
units.english: "How do we get back?"
units.italian: "Come torniamo indietro?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	"What happened to the long range communication?"|1597|0
units.english: "What happened to the long range communication?"
units.italian: "Che cosa è successo alle comunicazioni a lungo raggio?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	"Well, that is a good question. We have, and still are, running diagnostics on them, and so far they are passing all their checks. The system safeties, isolation mechanisms, security monitoring, tamper-proofing, self-destruct systems, backup hardening..." They shake their head, stymied.|1598|0
units.english: "Well, that is a good question. We have, and still are, running diagnostics on them, and so far they are passing all their checks. The system safeties, isolation mechanisms, security monitoring, tamper-proofing, self-destruct systems, backup hardening..." They shake their head, stymied.
units.italian: "Beh, è una buona domanda. Abbiamo eseguito e stiamo ancora eseguendo diagnostiche, e finora superano tutti i controlli. Le sicurezze di sistema, i meccanismi di isolamento, il monitoraggio di sicurezza, le protezioni antimanomissione, i sistemi di autodistruzione, l'indurimento dei backup..." Scuotono la testa, bloccati.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	"Everything looks in perfect working order. The only problem is that the quantum pairs at the heart just do not seem to have a pair anymore. In terms of quantum mechanics, it seems that the rest of the universe quite simply does not exist."|1599|0
units.english: "Everything looks in perfect working order. The only problem is that the quantum pairs at the heart just do not seem to have a pair anymore. In terms of quantum mechanics, it seems that the rest of the universe quite simply does not exist."
units.italian: "Tutto sembra in perfetto stato di funzionamento. L'unico problema è che le coppie quantistiche al centro sembrano non avere più una coppia. In termini di meccanica quantistica, sembra che il resto dell'universo semplicemente non esista."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	"That seems problematic. How do we get back?"|1601|0
units.english: "That seems problematic. How do we get back?"
units.italian: "Sembra problematico. Come torniamo indietro?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	"Did we destroy the universe by powering up this station?"|1603|0
units.english: "Did we destroy the universe by powering up this station?"
units.italian: "Abbiamo distrutto l'universo accendendo questa stazione?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	Gavriil smiles with amusement. "It is certainly a possibility. However, the fact that it was, as best we can tell, powered up previously without destroying the universe suggests that it transported or isolated us rather than destroying everything else."|1604|0
units.english: Gavriil smiles with amusement. "It is certainly a possibility. However, the fact that it was, as best we can tell, powered up previously without destroying the universe suggests that it transported or isolated us rather than destroying everything else."
units.italian: Gavriil sorride divertito. "È certamente una possibilità. Tuttavia, il fatto che, per quanto possiamo capire, fosse già stata accesa in passato senza distruggere l'universo, suggerisce che ci abbia trasportati o isolati invece di distruggere tutto il resto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	They frown at the communication panel. "Although everything I know about quantum mechanics refuses to countenance something being able to leave the universe so absolutely like this." They smile again. "But that is the way of science! Finding new things in the universe that tells us that what we know is not so absolute."|1605|0
units.english: They frown at the communication panel. "Although everything I know about quantum mechanics refuses to countenance something being able to leave the universe so absolutely like this." They smile again. "But that is the way of science! Finding new things in the universe that tells us that what we know is not so absolute."
units.italian: Aggrottano la fronte verso il pannello delle comunicazioni. "Anche se tutto quello che so sulla meccanica quantistica si rifiuta di ammettere che qualcosa possa uscire dall'universo in modo così assoluto." Sorridono di nuovo. "Ma è così che funziona la scienza! Trovare nell'universo cose nuove che ci dicono che quello che sappiamo non è poi così assoluto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	"I think we should focus on getting back."|1607|0
units.english: "I think we should focus on getting back."
units.italian: "Credo che dovremmo concentrarci sul tornare indietro."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	"Should we be worried?"|1609|0
units.english: "Should we be worried?"
units.italian: "Dovremmo preoccuparci?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	Gavriil gestures neutrally. "Well, I am worried, of course. I would be devastated to find out I had destroyed humanity, and everything else in existence." They look somber, but then perk up again. "But if everything has been annihilated, there is nothing I can do about it. So I shall focus on learning what I can, doing what must be done, and enjoy the fact that the universe has inexplicably revealed once again that the sum of all our knowledge is merely the introductory metaphor to help us grasp how things work." Their gestures abruptly change tone. "Speaking of which, we need to report what we have learned to the rest, which means leaving this place."|1610|0
units.english: Gavriil gestures neutrally. "Well, I am worried, of course. I would be devastated to find out I had destroyed humanity, and everything else in existence." They look somber, but then perk up again. "But if everything has been annihilated, there is nothing I can do about it. So I shall focus on learning what I can, doing what must be done, and enjoy the fact that the universe has inexplicably revealed once again that the sum of all our knowledge is merely the introductory metaphor to help us grasp how things work." Their gestures abruptly change tone. "Speaking of which, we need to report what we have learned to the rest, which means leaving this place."
units.italian: Gavriil gesticola in modo neutro. "Beh, io sono preoccupato, certo. Sarei distrutto se scoprissi di aver distrutto l'umanità e tutto il resto dell'esistenza." Hanno un'aria cupa, ma poi si rianimano. "Però, se tutto è stato annientato, non posso farci nulla. Quindi mi concentrerò sull'imparare quello che posso, fare quello che va fatto e godermi il fatto che l'universo abbia inesplicabilmente rivelato ancora una volta che la somma di tutte le nostre conoscenze è solo la metafora introduttiva che ci aiuta a capire come funzionano le cose." I loro gesti cambiano bruscamente tono. "A proposito, dobbiamo riferire agli altri quello che abbiamo scoperto, il che significa lasciare questo posto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|label|1611|0
units.english: cut power
units.italian: cut power

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	Gavriil gestures at the control panel in front of them. "I do not know for sure, but based on events, I suspect that if we manually induce a power failure we should be able to reverse the process that transported us to this realm." They smile eagerly. "I have everything all set up, and we have people waiting across the station." They look confident. "We think that we can safely spin down the reactor and cut power across a number of these arrays in a controlled fashion. This should replicate the original power failure, except with fewer risks and less damage to the system."|1612|0
units.english: Gavriil gestures at the control panel in front of them. "I do not know for sure, but based on events, I suspect that if we manually induce a power failure we should be able to reverse the process that transported us to this realm." They smile eagerly. "I have everything all set up, and we have people waiting across the station." They look confident. "We think that we can safely spin down the reactor and cut power across a number of these arrays in a controlled fashion. This should replicate the original power failure, except with fewer risks and less damage to the system."
units.italian: Gavriil gesticola verso il pannello di controllo davanti a loro. "Non lo so per certo, ma in base agli eventi sospetto che, se induciamo manualmente un'interruzione di corrente, dovremmo poter invertire il processo che ci ha trasportati in questo reame." Sorridono con impazienza. "Ho già tutto pronto, e abbiamo gente che aspetta in tutta la stazione." Sembrano fiduciosi. "Pensiamo di poter arrestare in sicurezza il reattore e tagliare l'alimentazione a diversi di questi apparati in modo controllato. Questo dovrebbe replicare l'interruzione di corrente originale, ma con meno rischi e meno danni al sistema."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	They lead you over to a panel in the main loading dock. "I know, it says 'Job Board' on it. I reused the coding for our task list to improvise this mass-notification system." They smile in amusement. "When you are ready to go, just select the 'De-activate Array' option from the panel. That will notify everyone and begin the shutdown."|1613|0
units.english: They lead you over to a panel in the main loading dock. "I know, it says 'Job Board' on it. I reused the coding for our task list to improvise this mass-notification system." They smile in amusement. "When you are ready to go, just select the 'De-activate Array' option from the panel. That will notify everyone and begin the shutdown."
units.italian: Ti conducono a un pannello nel molo di carico principale. "Lo so, c'è scritto 'Bacheca degli incarichi'. Ho riutilizzato il codice della nostra lista di compiti per improvvisare questo sistema di notifica di massa." Sorridono divertiti. "Quando sei pronto a partire, seleziona l'opzione 'Disattiva apparato' dal pannello. Avviserà tutti e darà inizio allo spegnimento."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	They hand you a data crystal, and then a large case. "Here is an encrypted data crystal of all our data so far. The case has several sets, with the data stored in a variety of different mechanisms and encryptions. We do not know what happens when the station is activated or deactivated, so multiple formats for storing the data will give a better chance that at least some of it will remain intact to be delivered."|1614|0
units.english: They hand you a data crystal, and then a large case. "Here is an encrypted data crystal of all our data so far. The case has several sets, with the data stored in a variety of different mechanisms and encryptions. We do not know what happens when the station is activated or deactivated, so multiple formats for storing the data will give a better chance that at least some of it will remain intact to be delivered."
units.italian: Ti porgono un cristallo di dati e poi una grande custodia. "Ecco un cristallo di dati criptato con tutti i nostri dati finora. La custodia contiene diverse serie, con i dati archiviati in vari meccanismi e crittografie. Non sappiamo cosa succede quando la stazione viene attivata o disattivata, quindi più formati di archiviazione daranno maggiori possibilità che almeno una parte resti intatta da consegnare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 35|	They step back. "Well, I will return to the controls. Just give the signal when you are ready to leave. Embers light your path, Captain <first>."|1615|0
units.english: They step back. "Well, I will return to the controls. Just give the signal when you are ready to leave. Embers light your path, Captain <first>."
units.italian: Fanno un passo indietro. "Bene, torno ai comandi. Dà il segnale quando sei pronto a partire. Che le Braci illuminino il tuo cammino, capitano <first>."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 36|name|1622|0
units.english: De-activate Ssil Vida Power
units.italian: Disattiva l'energia di Ssil Vida

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 36|description|1623|0
units.english: Accept this to signal everyone to cut the power.
units.italian: Accetta per segnalare a tutti di tagliare l'alimentazione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 36|With a shudder that is felt in every fiber of your being, you glimpse the ripple that makes reality look like the surface of a pond after a single rain drop. Almost before it begins, everything is still again. You look at your sensors, and it looks like Postverta has once again returned to its prior, barren, form.|1633|0
units.english: With a shudder that is felt in every fiber of your being, you glimpse the ripple that makes reality look like the surface of a pond after a single rain drop. Almost before it begins, everything is still again. You look at your sensors, and it looks like Postverta has once again returned to its prior, barren, form.
units.italian: Con un brivido che senti in ogni fibra del tuo essere, intravedi l'increspatura che fa sembrare la realtà la superficie di uno stagno dopo una singola goccia di pioggia. Quasi prima che cominci, tutto è di nuovo immobile. Guardi i sensori, e sembra che Postverta sia tornato alla sua forma precedente e sterile.

units.english: Activate Ssil Vida Power

units.english: Accept this to signal everyone to restore the power.
units.italian: Accetta per segnalare a tutti di ripristinare l'alimentazione.

Almost before it begins, everything is still again. You look at your sensors, and it looks like Postverta is once again overflowing with life.|1673|0

Almost before it begins, everything is still again. You look at your sensors, and it looks like Postverta is once again overflowing with life.
units.italian: Con un brivido che senti in ogni fibra del tuo essere, intravedi l'increspatura che fa sembrare la realtà la superficie di uno stagno dopo una singola goccia di pioggia. Quasi prima che cominci, tutto è di nuovo immobile. Guardi i sensori, e sembra che Postverta sia di nuovo traboccante di vita.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|name|1701|0
units.english: Take data to <planet>
units.italian: Porta i dati su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|description|1702|0
units.english: The rest of the Remnant need to know what is happening. Take this data to them on <destination>.
units.italian: Il resto dei Remnant deve sapere cosa sta succedendo. Porta questi dati a loro su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|A crowd of Remnant cluster around your ship as you land, but it is just one who gestures quickly, asking if the rest of the team who went with you are safe. You nod, and a ripple of relief goes through the crowd. "So, what happened?" asks another.|1712|0
units.english: A crowd of Remnant cluster around your ship as you land, but it is just one who gestures quickly, asking if the rest of the team who went with you are safe. You nod, and a ripple of relief goes through the crowd. "So, what happened?" asks another.
units.italian: Una folla di Remnant si stringe intorno alla tua nave mentre atterri, ma solo uno gesticola in fretta, chiedendo se il resto della squadra che era con te è al sicuro. Annuisci, e un'onda di sollievo attraversa la folla. "Allora, cosa è successo?" chiede un altro.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	(Explain everything that happened.)|1714|0
units.english: (Explain everything that happened.)
units.italian: (Spiega tutto quello che è successo.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	"I think I should tell this to the prefects first."|1716|0
units.english: "I think I should tell this to the prefects first."
units.italian: "Credo che dovrei raccontarlo prima ai prefetti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	The Remnant around you look amused. "Do not be concerned, <first>. Everything you say will reach them. The sooner you tell us, the sooner we can start preparing for whatever is necessary."|1717|0
units.english: The Remnant around you look amused. "Do not be concerned, <first>. Everything you say will reach them. The sooner you tell us, the sooner we can start preparing for whatever is necessary."
units.italian: I Remnant intorno a te sembrano divertiti. "Non preoccuparti, <first>. Tutto quello che dirai arriverà a loro. Prima ce lo racconti, prima potremo cominciare a prepararci a ciò che serve."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	(Explain everything that happened.)|1719|0
units.english: (Explain everything that happened.)
units.italian: (Spiega tutto quello che è successo.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	"I thought the prefects were your leaders?"|1721|0
units.english: "I thought the prefects were your leaders?"
units.italian: "Pensavo che i prefetti fossero i vostri capi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	"They bear our executive responsibilities, it is true. Times of critical threats require the capacity for decisions to be made in the instant. But do not confuse the authority to make high-value decisions with being in charge of everything. The less immediate a decision is, the more likely it is to be the product of significant discussion among us all. Likewise, decisions about what constitute the policy and values of our society are things decided upon by the unified whole, not any one individual." She pauses, and smiles. "Admittedly, given your involvement in smaller projects and unfolding events, our society probably does have a certain autocratic appearance."|1722|0
units.english: "They bear our executive responsibilities, it is true. Times of critical threats require the capacity for decisions to be made in the instant. But do not confuse the authority to make high-value decisions with being in charge of everything. The less immediate a decision is, the more likely it is to be the product of significant discussion among us all. Likewise, decisions about what constitute the policy and values of our society are things decided upon by the unified whole, not any one individual." She pauses, and smiles. "Admittedly, given your involvement in smaller projects and unfolding events, our society probably does have a certain autocratic appearance."
units.italian: "Portano le nostre responsabilità esecutive, è vero. I momenti di minaccia critica richiedono la capacità di prendere decisioni nell'istante. Ma non confondere l'autorità di prendere decisioni di grande valore con l'essere a capo di tutto. Meno una decisione è immediata, più è probabile che sia il prodotto di una discussione approfondita tra tutti noi. Allo stesso modo, le decisioni su cosa costituisca la politica e i valori della nostra società sono cose decise dall'insieme unificato, non da un singolo individuo." Si ferma e sorride. "Va ammesso che, dato il tuo coinvolgimento in progetti più piccoli e in eventi in divenire, la nostra società abbia probabilmente un certo aspetto autocratico."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	"Okay, I will explain everything."|1724|0
units.english: "Okay, I will explain everything."
units.italian: "Va bene, spiegherò tutto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	"How can you reach consensus so easily?"|1726|0
units.english: "How can you reach consensus so easily?"
units.italian: "Come fate a raggiungere un consenso così facilmente?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	She looks around with an uncertain expression, then nods. "As I am sure has occurred to you, communication by gestures has some disadvantages. We still prefer it for some tasks, but it can be awkward to watch or gesture in the midst of some situations. While we have some vocabulary we can use without needing hands or arms, it is very limited.|1729|0
units.english: She looks around with an uncertain expression, then nods. "As I am sure has occurred to you, communication by gestures has some disadvantages. We still prefer it for some tasks, but it can be awkward to watch or gesture in the midst of some situations. While we have some vocabulary we can use without needing hands or arms, it is very limited.
units.italian: Si guarda intorno con un'espressione incerta, poi annuisce. "Come certo ti sarà venuto in mente, la comunicazione a gesti ha qualche svantaggio. Continuiamo a preferirla per certi compiti, ma può essere scomodo guardare o gesticolare nel mezzo di alcune situazioni. Abbiamo un certo vocabolario che possiamo usare senza bisogno di mani o braccia, ma è molto limitato.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	"Fortunately, one of the original abilities of our companions is related to the nervous system. I believe Dawn may have told you a little about it, but was scarce on details." She smiles wryly, then another Remnant takes up the conversation.|1730|0
units.english: "Fortunately, one of the original abilities of our companions is related to the nervous system. I believe Dawn may have told you a little about it, but was scarce on details." She smiles wryly, then another Remnant takes up the conversation.
units.italian: "Per fortuna, una delle capacità originali dei nostri compagni è legata al sistema nervoso. Credo che Dawn te ne abbia parlato un po', ma con pochi dettagli." Sorride con ironia, poi un altro Remnant riprende la conversazione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	"To put it simply, we can form ad-hoc neural networks between us, of varying levels of intensity. Without the necessity of speech or gestures, we can have entire conversations in the blink of an eye."|1731|0
units.english: "To put it simply, we can form ad-hoc neural networks between us, of varying levels of intensity. Without the necessity of speech or gestures, we can have entire conversations in the blink of an eye."
units.italian: "Per dirla semplicemente, possiamo formare reti neurali improvvisate tra noi, con vari livelli di intensità. Senza bisogno di parole o gesti, possiamo avere intere conversazioni in un batter d'occhio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	He gestures confidently. "A team of Remnant, for instance, could all review incoming data from an experiment, form their own analyses, and then hold what amounts to a conference where each fully presents their thoughts and ideas with supporting data and reasoning within the span of a few minutes."|1732|0
units.english: He gestures confidently. "A team of Remnant, for instance, could all review incoming data from an experiment, form their own analyses, and then hold what amounts to a conference where each fully presents their thoughts and ideas with supporting data and reasoning within the span of a few minutes."
units.italian: Gesticola con sicurezza. "Una squadra di Remnant, per esempio, potrebbe rivedere tutti insieme i dati in arrivo da un esperimento, formare le proprie analisi e poi tenere quella che equivale a una conferenza in cui ognuno presenta compiutamente i propri pensieri e le proprie idee, con dati e ragionamenti a supporto, nell'arco di pochi minuti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	His gestures take on a cautionary tone. "Of course, accelerating to that level takes effort, and it is a long process to learn to manage our thoughts in such a way as to have productive conversations. But the results speak for themselves." He gestures broadly at the group.|1733|0
units.english: His gestures take on a cautionary tone. "Of course, accelerating to that level takes effort, and it is a long process to learn to manage our thoughts in such a way as to have productive conversations. But the results speak for themselves." He gestures broadly at the group.
units.italian: I suoi gesti prendono un tono di avvertimento. "Certo, accelerare fino a quel livello richiede sforzo, ed è un processo lungo imparare a gestire i propri pensieri in modo da avere conversazioni produttive. Ma i risultati parlano da soli." Gesticola ampiamente verso il gruppo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	"One such benefit is that in a policy debate, each person can be heard in depth, including checking the veracity of data and sources. This has significant benefits for minimizing the numbers of decisions made with incomplete or erroneous data, and maximizes the amount of information available to any one of us."|1734|0
units.english: "One such benefit is that in a policy debate, each person can be heard in depth, including checking the veracity of data and sources. This has significant benefits for minimizing the numbers of decisions made with incomplete or erroneous data, and maximizes the amount of information available to any one of us."
units.italian: "Uno di questi vantaggi è che in un dibattito politico ognuno può essere ascoltato a fondo, compresa la verifica della veridicità dei dati e delle fonti. Questo porta vantaggi notevoli nel ridurre il numero di decisioni prese con dati incompleti o errati, e massimizza la quantità di informazioni disponibili a ognuno di noi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	A third Remnant steps up. "As to the matter at hand, this means that the sooner any of us hear your report, the sooner everyone will have heard it." They look at you expectantly.|1737|0
units.english: A third Remnant steps up. "As to the matter at hand, this means that the sooner any of us hear your report, the sooner everyone will have heard it." They look at you expectantly.
units.italian: Un terzo Remnant si fa avanti. "Quanto alla questione in corso, questo significa che prima qualcuno di noi ascolta il tuo rapporto, prima tutti l'avranno ascoltato." Ti guardano con aspettativa.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|label|1739|0
units.english: cognizance untrusted
units.italian: cognizance untrusted

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	The Remnant smiles mysteriously. "A society has to have some secrets, does it not? Let us just say that our communication networks are very effective. At this point, just know that the sooner you give the report, the sooner that everyone will be able to work on this information." They pause, then continue. "And that does, of course, include the prefects."|1740|0
units.english: The Remnant smiles mysteriously. "A society has to have some secrets, does it not? Let us just say that our communication networks are very effective. At this point, just know that the sooner you give the report, the sooner that everyone will be able to work on this information." They pause, then continue. "And that does, of course, include the prefects."
units.italian: Il Remnant sorride in modo misterioso. "Una società deve avere qualche segreto, no? Diciamo solo che le nostre reti di comunicazione sono molto efficaci. A questo punto, sappi solo che prima fai il rapporto, prima tutti potranno lavorare su queste informazioni." Si fermano, poi continuano. "E questo, naturalmente, include i prefetti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	"Okay, I will explain what happened."|1742|0
units.english: "Okay, I will explain what happened."
units.italian: "Va bene, spiegherò cosa è successo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	"Alright, you convinced me."|1743|0
units.english: "Alright, you convinced me."
units.italian: "Va bene, mi avete convinto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|label|1744|0
units.english: cognizance explanation
units.italian: cognizance explanation

units.id: mission:Remnant: Cognizance 38|	The Remnant watch you attentively as you explain everything that went on at Postverta and the surrounding area. units.english: The Remnant watch you attentively as you explain everything that went on at Postverta and the surrounding area. units.italian: Si guardano intorno verso i Remnant circostanti, e all'improvviso hai la sensazione che intorno a te stia avvenendo un intero livello di discussione. Vedi Aeolus farsi largo tra la folla verso il davanti, e gesticola con toni di apprezzamento. "Grazie per tutto il tuo lavoro su questo, <first>. Apprezziamo molto i rischi che hai corso insieme a noi, e spero che continueremo a esplorare insieme. Detto questo, sospetto che servirà uno sforzo collettivo notevole per determinare il nostro prossimo passo." Si guarda intorno, poi ti fa l'occhiolino. "Nel frattempo, ho sbloccato l'accesso a qualche altro pezzo di recupero Korath più raro, compreso l'accesso agli 'olofez catturati. Non è molto, ma potrebbe darti un po' più di agio nell'equipaggiare la <ship>."
